cultureNote.fa: GP پزشک عمومی محله است؛ باید در مطب نزدیک خانه ثبت‌نام کنی.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: A GP is the family doctor. Now, into bed! Get well soon, love.

translations.fa: GP دکتر خانواده‌ست. حالا، برو تو تخت! زود خوب شو عزیزم.

n1.speaker: okafor
n1.text: Good morning. Come in, take a seat. What seems to be the problem?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر. بیاید تو، بنشینید. مشکل چیه؟

branches.suggestion: I've got a bad cough.
My chest hurts when I breathe.
branches.suggestionFa: وقتی نفس می‌کشم سینه‌ام درد می‌کنه.

n2.speaker: okafor
n2.text: I see. How long have you had it?

translations.fa: متوجهم. چند وقته اینطوره؟

branches.suggestion: For about a week.
Since Monday.

n3.speaker: okafor
n3.text: Have you got a temperature? Any pain anywhere else?

translations.fa: تب دارید؟ جای دیگه‌ای درد دارید؟

branches.suggestion: I had a temperature on Monday.
My back hurts a little.

n4.speaker: okafor
n4.text: Let me listen to your chest. Breathe in… and out. Again, please.

translations.fa: بذارید به سینه‌تون گوش بدم. نفس بکشید تو… و بیرون. دوباره لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Like this?
Is everything OK, doctor?

n5.speaker: okafor
n5.text: It's a chest infection. Not serious. I'll give you a prescription for antibiotics.

translations.fa: عفونت ریه‌ست. جدی نیست. براتون نسخهٔ آنتی‌بیوتیک می‌نویسم.

branches.suggestion: How often do I take them?
Thank you. Where do I get them?

n6.speaker: okafor
n6.text: Three times a day, after food, for seven days. Take this to the chemist.

translations.fa: روزی سه بار، بعد از غذا، به مدت هفت روز. اینو ببرید داروخونه.

branches.suggestion: Three times a day for seven days.
branches.suggestionFa: روزی سه بار به مدت هفت روز.

branches.suggestion: Do I need to pay for it?

cultureNote.en: In England a prescription costs a fixed fee; in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland it's free.
cultureNote.fa: در انگلستان نسخه هزینهٔ ثابت دارد؛ در اسکاتلند، ولز و ایرلند شمالی رایگان است.

n7.speaker: okafor
n7.text: If you don't feel better in a week, book another appointment. Take care!

translations.fa: اگه تا یه هفته بهتر نشدید، یه نوبت دیگه بگیرید. مراقب باشید!

n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Oh, you poor thing. You've got a cold? You should have some chicken soup.

translations.fa: آخی، بیچاره. سرما خوردی؟ باید سوپ مرغ بخوری.

branches.suggestion: Chicken soup? Does it help?
Yes, I've got a terrible cold.

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: It always helps! And you shouldn't go out in the rain.

translations.fa: همیشه کمک می‌کنه! و نباید زیر بارون بیرون بری.

branches.suggestion: But I need to go to work.
OK, I'll stay inside today.

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: Work can wait, dear. You should rest. What do people do for a cold in your country?

translations.fa: کار می‌تونه صبر کنه عزیزم. باید استراحت کنی. تو کشور تو برای سرماخوردگی چی کار می‌کنن؟

branches.suggestion: We drink hot tea with ginger.
We eat soup too, with lots of garlic!
branches.suggestionFa: ما هم سوپ می‌خوریم، با سیر زیاد!

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Lovely! Ginger is very good. And you should go to bed early.

translations.fa: چه خوب! زنجبیل خیلی خوبه. و باید زود بخوابی.

branches.suggestion: I will. I'm very sleepy.
Should I take some medicine?

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: Ask the chemist, dear. They're very helpful. You shouldn't take too much.

translations.fa: از داروخونه بپرس عزیزم. خیلی کمک می‌کنن. نباید زیاد بخوری.

branches.suggestion: Good advice. Thank you, Nana.
I'll go to the chemist tomorrow.

cultureNote.en: Pharmacists in the UK can give free advice for small problems, no appointment needed.
cultureNote.fa: داروسازان بریتانیا بدون نوبت مشاورهٔ رایگان می‌دهند.

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: Here's your soup. Eat it all up! You'll be right as rain in no time.

translations.fa: اینم سوپت. همه‌اش را بخور! زود سرحال می‌شی.

n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Tea's ready! Sit down, everyone. It's fish pie tonight. Do you like fish?

translations.fa: شام آماده‌ست! همه بنشینید. امشب پای ماهیه. ماهی دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I love fish!
I don't really like fish, sorry.
branches.suggestionFa: راستش ماهی زیاد دوست ندارم، ببخشید.

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: Don't worry, there's plenty of mash and peas too. What food do you love?

translations.fa: نگران نباش، پورهٔ سیب‌زمینی و نخودفرنگی هم زیاده. چه غذایی را دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: I love rice with saffron.
I like spicy food a lot.

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: Saffron! Lovely. You must cook for us one day. Do you like cooking?

translations.fa: زعفران! چه خوب. باید یه روز برامون آشپزی کنی. آشپزی دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I love cooking for friends.
I like eating more than cooking!
branches.suggestionFa: خوردن را بیشتر از آشپزی دوست دارم!

cultureNote.en: Brits love trying food from around the world. Curry is one of the nation's favourite meals!
cultureNote.fa: بریتانیایی‌ها عاشق غذاهای دنیا هستند. کاری یکی از غذاهای محبوب ملی است!

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Pass the salt, please. And what do you like doing in the evenings?

translations.fa: نمک را بده لطفاً. عصرها دوست داری چی کار کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I like reading and listening to music.
branches.suggestionFa: دوست دارم کتاب بخونم و موسیقی گوش بدم.

branches.suggestion: I enjoy walking after dinner.
branches.suggestionFa: از پیاده‌روی بعد از شام لذت می‌برم.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: I like doing nothing. Nothing at all. It's my favourite hobby.

translations.fa: من دوست دارم هیچ کاری نکنم. هیچی. سرگرمی مورد علاقمه.

branches.suggestion: Doing nothing isn't a hobby, Ryan!
branches.suggestionFa: هیچ کاری نکردن سرگرمی نیست، رایان!

branches.suggestion: Ha! That sounds nice sometimes.
branches.suggestionFa: ها! گاهی خوب به نظر میاد.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Ryan, you love playing football! And who's washing up tonight?

translations.fa: رایان، تو عاشق فوتبال بازی کردنی! امشب کی ظرف‌ها را می‌شوره؟

branches.suggestion: I can wash up.
Ryan can do it!

cultureNote.en: British vs American: washing up (UK) = doing the dishes (US).
cultureNote.fa: washing up (بریتانیا) = doing the dishes (آمریکا).

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: What a treasure! Pudding first, though. Apple crumble and custard!

translations.fa: چه گنجی! ولی اول دسر. کرامبل سیب و کاستارد!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Whose phone is this? It's been ringing all evening.

translations.fa: این گوشی مال کیه؟ کل عصر داره زنگ می‌خوره.

branches.suggestion: It's Tom's phone.
I think it's yours, Ryan!

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Not mine. Mine's in my pocket. Ah, it's Dad's. Mum's calling him!

translations.fa: مال من نیست. مال من توی جیبمه. آه، مال باباست. مامان داره بهش زنگ می‌زنه!

branches.suggestion: Give it to your dad.
Funny — they're in the same house!
branches.suggestionFa: جالبه — هر دو تو یه خونه‌ان!

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Classic. And whose is this pink coat? Nicola's or Nana's?

translations.fa: کلاسیکه. این کت صورتی مال کیه؟ نیکولا یا نانا؟

branches.suggestion: It's too big for Nicola. It's Nana's.
branches.suggestionFa: برای نیکولا خیلی بزرگه. مال ناناست.

branches.suggestion: It's Nicola's school coat.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Yeah, Nana's. And these tiny socks are definitely William's.

translations.fa: آره، مال نانا. و این جوراب‌های کوچولو قطعاً مال ویلیامه.

branches.suggestion: They're so small and cute!
Put them in William's drawer.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: And this is your scarf, isn't it? The blue one.

translations.fa: و این شال‌گردن توئه، نه؟ آبیه.

branches.suggestion: Yes, it's mine. Thanks!
No, mine is red. That's Leslie's.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، مال من قرمزه. اون مال لزلیه.

cultureNote.en: Brits often add "isn't it?" or "aren't you?" at the end — question tags. "Lovely day, isn't it?"
cultureNote.fa: بریتانیایی‌ها اغلب «isn't it?» به آخر جمله اضافه می‌کنند.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Sorted. The hallway is tidy. Mum's going to be well chuffed.

translations.fa: ردیف شد. راهرو مرتبه. مامان خیلی کیف می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: What does "chuffed" mean?
Your mum's going to be very happy!

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Chuffed means really pleased. Well chuffed means really, really pleased!

translations.fa: chuffed یعنی خیلی راضی. well chuffed یعنی خیلی خیلی راضی!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: It's my birthday! I'm six today! Six!

translations.fa: تولدمه! امروز شش سالم شد! شش!

branches.suggestion: Happy birthday, Nicola!
Wow, six! You're so big now!
branches.suggestionFa: وای، شش! حالا خیلی بزرگ شدی!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: My birthday is the tenth of March. When's your birthday?

translations.fa: تولدم دهم مارسه. تولد تو کِیه؟

branches.suggestion: My birthday is in June.
It's the second of November.

cultureNote.en: Brits say "the tenth of March" and write 10/03 — day first! Americans write 03/10.
cultureNote.fa: بریتانیایی‌ها روز را اول می‌نویسند: 10/03.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Look at my cake! It's a unicorn! And there are six candles.

translations.fa: کیکم را ببین! تکشاخه! و شش‌تا شمع داره.

branches.suggestion: It's a beautiful cake!
Make a wish, then blow!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: I made a wish! I'm not going to tell you. It's a secret!

translations.fa: آرزو کردم! بهت نمی‌گم. رازه!

branches.suggestion: Good idea. Keep it secret!
branches.suggestionFa: فکر خوبیه. رازش را نگه دار!

branches.suggestion: Here's your present, Nicola.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: A present! Can I open it now? What is it?

translations.fa: کادو! الان می‌تونم بازش کنم؟ چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, open it!
It's a surprise. Open it and see!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: A book about dinosaurs! I love it! I'm going to read it tonight with Mr Buttons.

translations.fa: یه کتاب دربارهٔ دایناسورها! عاشقشم! امشب با آقای دکمه می‌خونمش.

branches.suggestion: I'm glad you like it.
Mr Buttons is going to love it too.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Now everyone sing! Happy birthday to me… Thank you for coming!

translations.fa: حالا همه بخونید! تولدم مبارک… ممنون که اومدی!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Finally, Friday! What are you doing at the weekend?

translations.fa: بالاخره جمعه! آخر هفته چی کار می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I'm going to visit a friend.
branches.suggestionFa: قراره به یه دوست سر بزنم.

branches.suggestion: Nothing much. Just relaxing.

cultureNote.en: British vs American: "at the weekend" (UK) = "on the weekend" (US).
cultureNote.fa: at the weekend (بریتانیا) = on the weekend (آمریکا).

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Sounds good. We're going to the seaside on Saturday. Do you want to come?

translations.fa: خوبه. ما شنبه می‌ریم کنار دریا. می‌خوای بیای؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please! Which beach?
I'd love to, but I'm busy.
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی دوست دارم، ولی سرم شلوغه.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Brighton. We're going to get fish and chips and walk on the pier.

translations.fa: برایتون. قراره فیش‌اند‌چیپس بخوریم و روی اسکله قدم بزنیم.

branches.suggestion: Fish and chips by the sea! Perfect.
What's a pier?

cultureNote.en: Seaside towns like Brighton and Blackpool have piers with games, rides and ice cream.
cultureNote.fa: شهرهای ساحلی مثل برایتون اسکله‌های تفریحی دارند.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Watch out for the seagulls — they steal your chips! What's the weather going to be like?

translations.fa: مواظب مرغ‌های دریایی باش — چیپست را می‌دزدن! هوا قراره چطور باشه؟

branches.suggestion: It's going to be sunny, I think.
The app says it's going to rain.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Rain? Ha, of course. We're going anyway. Brits go to the beach in any weather!

translations.fa: بارون؟ ها، معلومه. به هر حال می‌ریم. بریتانیایی‌ها تو هر هوایی می‌رن ساحل!

branches.suggestion: Then I'm going to bring my umbrella.
And I'm going to wear my wellies!

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Brilliant. And on Sunday, a roast and a lie-in. Leaving at nine — don't be late!

translations.fa: عالیه. و یکشنبه، کباب یکشنبه و دیر بیدار شدن. ساعت نه راه می‌افتیم — دیر نکنی!

branches.suggestion: I won't. See you at nine!
What's a lie-in?

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: A lie-in is staying in bed late. The best thing about Sundays! Have a great week, you've earned it!

translations.fa: lie-in یعنی دیر توی تخت موندن. بهترین چیز یکشنبه‌ها! هفتهٔ خوبی داشته باشی، حقته!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Morning! It's seven o'clock. What time do you usually get up?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر! ساعت هفته. معمولاً ساعت چند بیدار می‌شی؟

branches.suggestion: I usually get up at seven.
I get up at six. I like early mornings.
branches.suggestionFa: ساعت شش بیدار می‌شم. صبح زود را دوست دارم.

recasts.echo: Oh, you get up at six? Wow!

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Lovely. Do you have breakfast in the morning?

translations.fa: عالیه. صبح‌ها صبحونه می‌خوری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I have toast and tea.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، نون تست و چای می‌خورم.

branches.suggestion: No, I just have a coffee.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Tom has cereal. Nicola has porridge. And William has everything!

translations.fa: تام غلات صبحانه می‌خوره. نیکولا فرنی. و ویلیام همه چی!

branches.suggestion: Ha! William loves food.
What is porridge?

cultureNote.en: Porridge (hot oats with milk) is a classic British breakfast, especially in winter.
cultureNote.fa: فرنی جو صبحانهٔ کلاسیک بریتانیایی است.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Hot oats with milk. Now — Nicola! Brush your teeth, please! Do you brush your teeth before or after breakfast?

translations.fa: جو داغ با شیر. حالا — نیکولا! لطفاً مسواک بزن! قبل یا بعد از صبحونه مسواک می‌زنی؟

branches.suggestion: After breakfast.
Before breakfast, and at night.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Good. I leave at eight. I walk Nicola to school. What time do you leave the house?

translations.fa: خوبه. من ساعت هشت می‌رم. نیکولا را پیاده می‌برم مدرسه. تو ساعت چند از خونه می‌ری؟

branches.suggestion: I leave at half eight.
I work from home on Mondays.

cultureNote.en: "Half eight" means 8:30 in British English — not 7:30!
cultureNote.fa: half eight یعنی ۸:۳۰.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Oh, where are my keys? I always lose my keys! Can you see them?

translations.fa: آخ، کلیدهام کجان؟ همیشه کلیدهام را گم می‌کنم! می‌بینیشون؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, they're on the table.
Are they in your coat pocket?

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Found them! Thank you. Tom! Have you got your lunch?

translations.fa: پیداشون کردم! ممنون. تام! ناهارت را برداشتی؟

branches.suggestion: His lunch box is in the fridge.
I can take it to him.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: You're a star. Every morning is like this! What's your morning like?

translations.fa: تو یه ستاره‌ای. هر صبح همین‌طوره! صبح تو چطوره؟

branches.suggestion: My mornings are quiet. I read the news.
Busy! I always run for the bus.

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Ha! Same here. Right, coats on, everybody! Have a lovely day!

translations.fa: ها! منم همین‌طور. خب، همه کت‌ها را بپوشید! روز خوبی داشته باشید!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Right! It's Saturday. Chores first, football later. Can you help me?

translations.fa: خب! شنبه‌ست. اول کارهای خونه، بعد فوتبال. کمکم می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. What can I do?
Sure. I'll do the washing-up.

cultureNote.en: British "washing-up" = American "doing the dishes".
cultureNote.fa: washing-up یعنی ظرف شستن.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Can you hoover the hallway? The hoover's under the stairs.

translations.fa: می‌تونی راهرو را جارو برقی بکشی؟ جاروبرقی زیر پله‌هاست.

branches.suggestion: Yes. Where's the plug?
I'll do it now.

cultureNote.en: Brits often say "hoover" (a brand name) for vacuum cleaner.
cultureNote.fa: hoover یعنی جاروبرقی.

recasts.echo: You'll do it now? Brilliant!

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Next to the door. Ryan! Can you take the bins out? It's bin day on Monday.

translations.fa: کنار در. رایان! می‌تونی سطل‌ها را ببری بیرون؟ دوشنبه روز سطل زباله‌ست.

branches.suggestion: Which bin is for recycling?
I can help Ryan with the bins.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم به رایان با سطل‌ها کمک کنم.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: The blue bin is for recycling — paper, cans and plastic. The black bin is for rubbish.

translations.fa: سطل آبی برای بازیافته — کاغذ، قوطی و پلاستیک. سطل سیاه برای زباله.

branches.suggestion: And food waste?
OK, blue for recycling. Got it.

cultureNote.en: Many UK councils collect bins on different days, with separate bins for recycling and food waste.
cultureNote.fa: شوراها سطل‌های جدا دارند.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Food waste goes in the little brown caddy. Now, the washing. Can you hang it on the line?

translations.fa: پسماند غذا می‌ره تو سطل کوچیک قهوه‌ای. حالا، لباس‌ها. می‌تونی رو بند پهنشون کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Is it going to rain?
Yes. Where are the pegs?

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Good question! In Britain, always check the sky first. Hmm… it looks OK.

translations.fa: سؤال خوبیه! تو بریتانیا، همیشه اول آسمون را نگاه کن. هوم… خوبه.

branches.suggestion: I'll be quick, then!
Maybe we can use the dryer.
branches.suggestionFa: شاید بتونیم از خشک‌کن استفاده کنیم.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: The dryer is broken. Typical! I'll call someone on Monday. Can you water the plants too?

translations.fa: خشک‌کن خرابه. همیشه همین‌طوره! دوشنبه به یکی زنگ می‌زنم. گلدون‌ها را هم آب می‌دی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I'll water the plants.
Where's the watering can?

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: By the back door. Brilliant — you're better than Ryan! Do you do chores at home in your country?

translations.fa: کنار در پشتی. عالیه — از رایان بهتری! تو کشورت کارهای خونه را انجام می‌دی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I always help my mum.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، همیشه به مامانم کمک می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: Not much. My mum does everything!
branches.suggestionFa: زیاد نه. مامانم همه کار را می‌کنه!

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Ha! Mums are the same everywhere. Right — chores done. Cup of tea, then football?

translations.fa: ها! مامان‌ها همه جا یه جورن. خب — کارها تموم. یه چای، بعد فوتبال؟

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: That's the doorbell! It's probably my parcel. Can you get it? I'm in my pyjamas.

translations.fa: زنگ دره! احتمالاً بستهٔ منه. می‌تونی در را باز کنی؟ لباس خوابمه.

branches.suggestion: OK, I'll get it.
What's in the parcel?

cultureNote.en: British "pyjamas" = American "pajamas".
cultureNote.fa: املای بریتانیایی pyjamas است.

n2.speaker: courier
n2.text: Hiya! Parcel for Ryan Thompson?

translations.fa: سلام! بسته برای رایان تامپسون؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, he lives here.
Yes. Do I need to sign?

n3.speaker: courier
n3.text: Yeah, just sign here with your finger, mate. On the screen.

translations.fa: آره، فقط با انگشتت اینجا امضا کن رفیق. رو صفحه.

branches.suggestion: Here? Like this?
OK. Done.

n4.speaker: courier
n4.text: Perfect. There are two parcels, actually. There's one for Leslie too.

translations.fa: عالیه. راستش دو تا بسته‌ست. یکی هم برای لزلیه.

branches.suggestion: Two parcels? Thank you.
Is the big one for Leslie?

recasts.echo: There are two parcels, yeah!

n5.speaker: courier
n5.text: The big one's for Leslie. It's heavy! Shall I put it inside the door?

translations.fa: بزرگه مال لزلیه. سنگینه! بذارمش داخل در؟

branches.suggestion: Yes please, that's very kind.
No thanks, I can carry it.

n6.speaker: courier
n6.text: No problem. Oh — there's also one for next door. Number 14. They're out. Can you take it?

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست. اوه — یکی هم برای همسایه‌ست. پلاک ۱۴. خونه نیستن. می‌تونی تحویل بگیری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I can take it for them.
Sorry, I'm going out soon.

cultureNote.en: Couriers often leave parcels with neighbours, and post a card saying where it is.
cultureNote.fa: پیک‌ها بسته را پیش همسایه می‌گذارند.

n7.speaker: courier
n7.text: Cheers! I'll put a card through their door. Have a good one!

translations.fa: ممنون! یه کارت از لای درشون می‌ندازم. روز خوبی داشته باشی!

branches.suggestion: You too. Bye!
Thanks. Drive safely!

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Mate, is that my parcel? Brilliant! It's my new headphones!

translations.fa: رفیق، بستهٔ منه؟ عالیه! هدفون جدیدمه!

branches.suggestion: Here you go. And there's one for your mum.
branches.suggestionFa: بفرما. و یکی هم برای مامانت.

branches.suggestion: Yes! And one for next door.

n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Cheers! Put Mum's on the stairs. And don't tell her I spent all my birthday money!

translations.fa: مرسی! مال مامان را بذار رو پله‌ها. و بهش نگو همهٔ پول تولدم را خرج کردم!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Is it ten o'clock already? Mum says phones off at ten. That's so unfair!

translations.fa: ساعت ده شد؟ مامان می‌گه گوشی‌ها ساعت ده خاموش. خیلی ناعادلانه‌ست!

branches.suggestion: It's time for bed, Ryan.
Ten minutes more, then phone off.
branches.suggestionFa: ده دقیقهٔ دیگه، بعد گوشی خاموش.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Ten minutes! OK. I'm just finishing this game. Do you go to bed late?

translations.fa: ده دقیقه! باشه. دارم این بازی را تموم می‌کنم. تو دیر می‌خوابی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I go to bed at midnight.
No, I go to bed at eleven.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Lucky you. Have you got school tomorrow? I've got a maths test.

translations.fa: خوش به حالت. فردا مدرسه داری؟ من امتحان ریاضی دارم.

branches.suggestion: No, but I have work at nine.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، ولی ساعت نه کار دارم.

branches.suggestion: A maths test? Then you need sleep!
branches.suggestionFa: امتحان ریاضی؟ پس خواب لازم داری!

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: I know, I know. Is my alarm on? Can you check? Seven o'clock.

translations.fa: می‌دونم، می‌دونم. زنگ ساعتم روشنه؟ می‌تونی چک کنی؟ ساعت هفت.

branches.suggestion: Yes, your alarm is on for seven.
No, it's off. I'll set it for you.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Cheers. Oh no — my PE kit is still in the washing machine!

translations.fa: مرسی. ای وای — لباس ورزشم هنوز تو ماشین لباسشوییه!

branches.suggestion: Put it on the radiator. It'll be dry by morning.
branches.suggestionFa: بذارش رو شوفاژ. تا صبح خشک میشه.

branches.suggestion: Wear your old one tomorrow.

cultureNote.en: Drying clothes on radiators is very common in British homes, especially in winter.
cultureNote.fa: خشک کردن لباس روی شوفاژ رایج است.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Genius. Can you turn the big light off? I've got my lamp.

translations.fa: نابغه. می‌شه چراغ اصلی را خاموش کنی؟ آباژورم را دارم.

branches.suggestion: Sure. Goodnight, Ryan.
Lights off. Phone off too!

cultureNote.en: "The big light" is a funny British phrase for the main ceiling light.
cultureNote.fa: big light یعنی چراغ سقفی.

recasts.echo: Turn the light off, yeah.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Phone's off. See? I'm a good boy. What time do you get up tomorrow?

translations.fa: گوشی خاموشه. دیدی؟ پسر خوبیم. فردا ساعت چند بیدار می‌شی؟

branches.suggestion: At half seven. Same as you, nearly.
branches.suggestionFa: هفت و نیم. تقریباً مثل تو.

branches.suggestion: Early. I've got a long day.

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Night, then. Don't let the bedbugs bite! That's what Nana always says. Weird, innit?

translations.fa: پس شب بخیر. نذار ساس‌ها نیشت بزنن! نانا همیشه اینو می‌گه. عجیبه، نه؟

branches.suggestion: It's a funny thing to say! Night!
Night, Ryan. Good luck in your test.
branches.suggestionFa: شب بخیر رایان. تو امتحانت موفق باشی.

cultureNote.en: "Night night, sleep tight, don't let the bedbugs bite" is a traditional British bedtime rhyme.
cultureNote.fa: یک شعر سنتی قبل خواب است.

n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Cheers, mate. And thanks for the radiator trick. Night!

translations.fa: مرسی رفیق. و ممنون بابت ترفند شوفاژ. شب بخیر!

n1.speaker: mia
n1.text: Hello! I'm painting a house. Do you want to paint too?

translations.fa: سلام! دارم یه خونه نقاشی می‌کنم. تو هم می‌خوای نقاشی کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please! What can I paint?
Yes! Can I have a brush?
branches.suggestionFa: آره! می‌شه یه قلم‌مو داشته باشم؟

n2.speaker: mia
n2.text: Here's a brush. Paint the sun! What colour is the sun?

translations.fa: بیا این قلم‌مو. خورشید را بکش! خورشید چه رنگیه؟

branches.suggestion: The sun is yellow.
It's yellow, I think.

cultureNote.en: British English writes "colour"; American English writes "color".
cultureNote.fa: بریتانیایی colour، آمریکایی color.

n3.speaker: mia
n3.text: Yes! Yellow. Now the door. My door is red. What colour is your door?

translations.fa: آره! زرد. حالا در. در من قرمزه. در تو چه رنگیه؟

branches.suggestion: My door is blue.
My door is green.

recasts.echo: Your door is blue? Lovely!

n4.speaker: mia
n4.text: Oh no! I've got red paint on my hands!

translations.fa: وای نه! رنگ قرمز روی دستامه!

branches.suggestion: Don't worry. Let's wash them.
Ha ha! Your hands are red!

n5.speaker: mia
n5.text: Now we need a tree. Trees are green and brown. Can you paint the tree?

translations.fa: حالا یه درخت لازم داریم. درخت‌ها سبز و قهوه‌ای‌ان. می‌تونی درخت را بکشی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I can. Where's the brown paint?
OK. A big tree or a small tree?

n6.speaker: mia
n6.text: A big tree! Next to the house. That's lovely!

translations.fa: یه درخت بزرگ! کنار خونه. چه قشنگه!

branches.suggestion: Thank you! What's next?
Can we paint a cat?

cultureNote.en: "Lovely" is a very common British word for "nice" or "great".
cultureNote.fa: lovely در بریتانیا خیلی رایج است.

n7.speaker: mia
n7.text: A cat! My cat is black and white. His name is Biscuit.

translations.fa: یه گربه! گربهٔ من سیاه و سفیده. اسمش بیسکویته.

branches.suggestion: Biscuit! That's a funny name.
I like cats. Let's paint Biscuit.
branches.suggestionFa: من گربه دوست دارم. بیا بیسکویت را بکشیم.

n8.speaker: mia
n8.text: Look! The sky is blue, the sun is yellow, and Biscuit is in the garden.

translations.fa: ببین! آسمون آبیه، خورشید زرده، و بیسکویت تو باغه.

branches.suggestion: It's a beautiful picture!
Can we put it on the fridge?

n9.speaker: mia
n9.text: Yes! Mummy puts all my pictures on the fridge. Thank you for painting with me!

translations.fa: آره! مامان همهٔ نقاشی‌هامو روی یخچال می‌ذاره. ممنون که باهام نقاشی کردی!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Look at all these socks! Can you help me? We need to find the pairs.

translations.fa: این همه جوراب را ببین! کمکم می‌کنی؟ باید جفت‌ها را پیدا کنیم.

branches.suggestion: Of course. I can help.
Wow, that's a lot of socks!

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: This sock is blue with stars. Can you see another blue one?

translations.fa: این جوراب آبیه با ستاره. یه آبی دیگه می‌بینی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, here it is.
No, I can't see one.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Brilliant. Now, two pink socks. They're Nicola's.

translations.fa: عالی. حالا دو تا جوراب صورتی. مال نیکولان.

branches.suggestion: Here are two pink socks.
Pink? Is this one pink or red?

cultureNote.en: "Brilliant" in Britain often just means "great" or "thanks", not "very clever".
cultureNote.fa: brilliant یعنی عالی.

recasts.echo: Two pink socks? Yes, thanks.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: That one's red. These tiny white ones are William's. Aren't they sweet?

translations.fa: اون قرمزه. این سفیدای کوچولو مال ویلیامه. ناز نیستن؟

branches.suggestion: They're so small!
Yes, they're very sweet.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: And these big grey socks are Tom's. They've got a hole!

translations.fa: و این جوراب‌های طوسی بزرگ مال تامه. سوراخ دارن!

branches.suggestion: Ha! Tom needs new socks.
branches.suggestionFa: ها! تام جوراب نو لازم داره.

branches.suggestion: Shall I put them in the bin?

cultureNote.en: British "grey", American "gray". British "bin", American "trash can".
cultureNote.fa: grey/gray و bin/trash can.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Yes, in the bin! Now, one green sock. Where's the other green sock?

translations.fa: آره، سطل آشغال! حالا، یه جوراب سبز. اون یکی جوراب سبز کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: I don't know. Is it under the table?
Maybe it's in the washing machine.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Good idea! Yes, here it is, in the washing machine. Socks always disappear!

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه! آره، ایناهاش، تو ماشین لباسشویی. جوراب‌ها همیشه غیب می‌شن!

branches.suggestion: In my country, too!
Where do they go?

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Nobody knows! OK, how many pairs have we got? Can you count them?

translations.fa: هیچ‌کس نمی‌دونه! خب، چند جفت داریم؟ می‌تونی بشمری؟

branches.suggestion: One, two, three… eight pairs!
I think we've got eight pairs.

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Eight pairs! Thank you, love. Let's put them in the drawers. Then a cup of tea!

translations.fa: هشت جفت! ممنون عزیزم. بذاریمشون تو کشوها. بعد یه فنجون چای!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Let's play a game! Find a shape in the kitchen. I can see a circle!

translations.fa: بیا یه بازی کنیم! یه شکل تو آشپزخونه پیدا کن. من یه دایره می‌بینم!

branches.suggestion: Where? I can't see it.
Is it the clock?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Yes! The clock is a circle. Now you find one.

translations.fa: آره! ساعت دایره‌ست. حالا تو یکی پیدا کن.

branches.suggestion: The window is a square.
The plate is a circle, too.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Well done! My turn. The sandwich is a triangle!

translations.fa: آفرین! نوبت من. ساندویچ مثلثه!

branches.suggestion: Yes! Two triangles.
Can I eat the triangle?

cultureNote.en: British children often have sandwiches cut into triangles — "posh" sandwiches!
cultureNote.fa: ساندویچ مثلثی در بریتانیا رایج است.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: No! It's Ryan's sandwich. He gets cross. What shape is the table?

translations.fa: نه! ساندویچ رایانه. عصبانی می‌شه. میز چه شکلیه؟

branches.suggestion: The table is a rectangle.
I think it's a rectangle.

recasts.echo: It's a rectangle? Yes!

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: A rectangle! That's a hard word. What about the biscuits?

translations.fa: مستطیل! کلمهٔ سختیه. بیسکویت‌ها چی؟

branches.suggestion: They're circles.
Some are squares.

cultureNote.en: British "biscuit" = American "cookie". An American "biscuit" is like a British scone.
cultureNote.fa: biscuit/cookie.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Can I have a biscuit? Just one? Please?

translations.fa: می‌تونم یه بیسکویت بخورم؟ فقط یکی؟ لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Ask your mum first.
Just one, OK?

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Mummy says yes! A round one. Now, a star! Can you see a star?

translations.fa: مامان می‌گه آره! یه گرد. حالا، یه ستاره! یه ستاره می‌بینی؟

branches.suggestion: No. Is there a star in the kitchen?
Yes! On the fridge.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Yes! My gold star from school is on the fridge. I got it for reading.

translations.fa: آره! ستارهٔ طلایی مدرسه‌ام روی یخچاله. برای کتاب خوندن گرفتمش.

branches.suggestion: Well done, Nicola!
You're very clever!

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Thank you! You're good at this game. Let's play again after tea!

translations.fa: ممنون! تو این بازی خوبی. بیا بعد از شام دوباره بازی کنیم!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Mia and I are making a poster. It's about favourite things!

translations.fa: من و میا داریم یه پوستر درست می‌کنیم. دربارهٔ چیزهای مورد علاقه‌ست!

branches.suggestion: That's a good idea!
Can I help you?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Yes! What's your favourite colour?

translations.fa: آره! رنگ مورد علاقه‌ات چیه؟

branches.suggestion: My favourite colour is green.
I like blue. It's my favourite.

cultureNote.en: British "favourite", American "favorite".
cultureNote.fa: favourite/favorite.

recasts.echo: Your favourite colour is green? Nice!

n3.speaker: mia
n3.text: My favourite colour is purple. Nicola's is pink. Everything is pink!

translations.fa: رنگ مورد علاقهٔ من بنفشه. مال نیکولا صورتیه. همه چی صورتیه!

branches.suggestion: Your bag is pink!
And your shoes are pink, too.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: I love pink! Now, what's your favourite animal?

translations.fa: من عاشق صورتی‌ام! حالا، حیوون مورد علاقه‌ات چیه؟

branches.suggestion: I love horses.
My favourite animal is a cat.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Mine is a penguin! They're black and white and very funny.

translations.fa: مال من پنگوئنه! سیاه و سفیدن و خیلی بامزه‌ان.

branches.suggestion: Penguins are funny!
Have you seen a penguin?

n6.speaker: mia
n6.text: We saw penguins at the zoo! Now, favourite food. Mine is pizza.

translations.fa: تو باغ‌وحش پنگوئن دیدیم! حالا، غذای مورد علاقه. مال من پیتزاست.

branches.suggestion: My favourite food is rice.
I love kebabs.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Rice! Nana makes rice on Sundays. Can you write it on the poster?

translations.fa: برنج! نانا یکشنبه‌ها برنج درست می‌کنه. می‌تونی روی پوستر بنویسیش؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. R-I-C-E.
Can I write it in Persian, too?

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Yes! Persian is so pretty. It goes from right to left!

translations.fa: آره! فارسی خیلی قشنگه. از راست به چپ می‌ره!

branches.suggestion: That's right. You're very clever.
Do you want to learn a Persian word?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌خوای یه کلمهٔ فارسی یاد بگیری؟

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Our poster is finished! Pink, purple, green, penguins and pizza. It's the best poster ever!

translations.fa: پوسترمون تموم شد! صورتی، بنفش، سبز، پنگوئن و پیتزا. بهترین پوستر دنیاست!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Look! Ducks! Lots of ducks on the pond! Have you got the bag of food?

translations.fa: ببین! اردک! کلی اردک روی برکه! کیسهٔ غذا را آوردی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, here it is.
Yes. Is it bread?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: No! Not bread. Bread is bad for ducks. It's special duck food.

translations.fa: نه! نون نه. نون برای اردک‌ها بده. غذای مخصوص اردکه.

branches.suggestion: Oh, I didn't know that.
OK. What's in it?

cultureNote.en: Many British parks ask people not to feed ducks bread; oats, peas or duck pellets are better.
cultureNote.fa: به اردک‌ها نان ندهید.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Oats and seeds. How many ducks can you see?

translations.fa: جو دوسر و دونه. چند تا اردک می‌بینی؟

branches.suggestion: I can see seven ducks.
There are ten ducks, I think.
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم ده تا اردک هست.

recasts.echo: Ten ducks? Yes, there are ten!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: And one swan! It's big and white. Swans can be grumpy. Don't get too close!

translations.fa: و یه قو! بزرگ و سفیده. قوها ممکنه بداخلاق باشن. خیلی نزدیک نشو!

branches.suggestion: OK, I'll stay here.
Is it dangerous?

cultureNote.en: In Britain, many swans traditionally belong to the King!
cultureNote.fa: قوها در بریتانیا به‌طور سنتی مال پادشاهند.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: A bit. Throw the food in the water. Gently!

translations.fa: یه کم. غذا را بنداز تو آب. آروم!

branches.suggestion: Like this?
Here you are, ducks!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Yes! Look, the little brown duck is eating. She's got babies!

translations.fa: آره! ببین، اردک قهوه‌ای کوچولو داره می‌خوره. بچه داره!

branches.suggestion: How many babies has she got?
The babies are so small!

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: One, two, three, four, five! Five ducklings. Baby ducks are called ducklings.

translations.fa: یک، دو، سه، چهار، پنج! پنج جوجه اردک. به بچه اردک می‌گن جوجه اردک.

branches.suggestion: Ducklings. That's a nice word.
What do you call a baby swan?

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: A cygnet! Mrs Ellis taught us. Oh, the food is all gone.

translations.fa: سیگنت! خانم الیس یادمون داد. آه، غذا تموم شد.

branches.suggestion: Bye-bye, ducks!
Shall we go to the swings now?

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Yes! Race you to the swings! Bye, ducks! See you next week!

translations.fa: آره! مسابقه تا تاب‌ها! خداحافظ اردک‌ها! هفتهٔ بعد می‌بینیمتون!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: There's a cat in our hallway! It's orange with white paws. Is it yours?

translations.fa: یه گربه تو راهرومونه! نارنجیه با پنجه‌های سفید. مال توئه؟

branches.suggestion: No, it isn't my cat.
No. I haven't got a cat.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Maybe it's from next door. Let's look at the collar. What does it say?

translations.fa: شاید مال همسایه‌ست. بیا قلاده‌اش را ببینیم. چی نوشته؟

branches.suggestion: It says "Tiger".
There's a name and a number.
branches.suggestionFa: یه اسم و یه شماره هست.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Tiger! That's Mrs Khan's cat. She lives at number fourteen.

translations.fa: تایگر! گربهٔ خانم خانه. پلاک چهارده زندگی می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: Shall we take him home?
Can you call her?

n4.speaker: khan
n4.text: Hello, Leslie! Oh, Tiger! You naughty boy! I'm so sorry. Is he in your house again?

translations.fa: سلام لزلی! آه، تایگر! پسر شیطون! خیلی ببخشید. باز تو خونه‌تونه؟

branches.suggestion: It's OK. He's very friendly.
Yes, he's in the hallway.

n5.speaker: khan
n5.text: He loves your house. I think you give him food!

translations.fa: عاشق خونهٔ شماست. فکر کنم بهش غذا می‌دید!

branches.suggestion: No, we don't! Well… a little.
Nicola gives him milk, I think.
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم نیکولا بهش شیر می‌ده.

recasts.echo: You don't give him food? Ha ha!

n6.speaker: khan
n6.text: Milk isn't good for cats, you know. Have you got any pets?

translations.fa: شیر برای گربه‌ها خوب نیست، می‌دونی. حیوون خونگی دارید؟

branches.suggestion: No, but I'd like a dog.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، ولی دلم یه سگ می‌خواد.

branches.suggestion: I had a cat in Iran.

cultureNote.en: Britain is a nation of pet lovers: about half of homes have a pet.
cultureNote.fa: تقریباً نیمی از خانه‌ها حیوان خانگی دارند.

n7.speaker: khan
n7.text: Lovely! What was its name?

translations.fa: چه خوب! اسمش چی بود؟

branches.suggestion: Her name was Pishi.
I can't remember. I was very young.

n8.speaker: khan
n8.text: How sweet! Come on, Tiger. Home time. Thank you both. Come round for a cup of tea soon!

translations.fa: چه ناز! بیا تایگر. وقت خونه رفتنه. ممنون از هر دوتون. به زودی برای یه فنجون چای بیاید!

branches.suggestion: Thank you, Mrs Khan. See you soon!
branches.suggestionFa: ممنون خانم خان. به زودی می‌بینمتون!

branches.suggestion: Bye, Tiger!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Mrs Khan makes amazing samosas. We must go for that cup of tea!

translations.fa: خانم خان سمبوسه‌های فوق‌العاده‌ای درست می‌کنه. حتماً باید برای اون فنجون چای بریم!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Daddy, can we have a dog? Please, please, please!

translations.fa: بابا، می‌شه یه سگ داشته باشیم؟ لطفاً، لطفاً، لطفاً!

branches.suggestion: A dog? Ask your daddy!
Wow, a dog! That's exciting.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: A dog? Hmm. Dogs are a lot of work, Nicola. What do you think?

translations.fa: سگ؟ هوم. سگ‌ها خیلی کار دارن نیکولا. نظر تو چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Dogs are a lot of work.
I think a dog is a great idea!
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم سگ فکر خیلی خوبیه!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: See! I can walk the dog every day. Before school!

translations.fa: دیدی! هر روز می‌تونم سگ را ببرم بیرون. قبل از مدرسه!

branches.suggestion: Every day? Even in the rain?
That's very early, Nicola.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Who feeds the dog? Who cleans up the poo?

translations.fa: کی به سگ غذا می‌ده؟ کی کثیفی‌اش را تمیز می‌کنه؟

branches.suggestion: Nicola can feed the dog.
Ryan can clean up!

cultureNote.en: In the UK you must pick up your dog's poo in public places, or you can get a fine.
cultureNote.fa: باید فضولات سگ را جمع کنید.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Ha ha! Ryan won't do it. I can do it. With a bag.

translations.fa: ها ها! رایان این کار را نمی‌کنه. من می‌تونم. با یه کیسه.

branches.suggestion: Good girl, Nicola!
Are you sure?

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: What kind of dog do you want? A big dog or a small dog?

translations.fa: چه جور سگی می‌خوای؟ سگ بزرگ یا کوچیک؟

branches.suggestion: A small dog is better for the house.
What about a big, fluffy dog?
branches.suggestionFa: یه سگ بزرگ و پشمالو چطور؟

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: A small, brown, fluffy one. Called Muffin!

translations.fa: یه کوچیک، قهوه‌ای، پشمالو. به اسم مافین!

branches.suggestion: Muffin! That's a cute name.
You've got a name already!

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Hmm. William is very little. And Nana is scared of dogs.

translations.fa: هوم. ویلیام خیلی کوچیکه. و نانا از سگ می‌ترسه.

branches.suggestion: Is she? I didn't know.
Maybe when William is bigger.

recasts.echo: She's scared of dogs? Yes, a bit.

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Oh. Can we have a goldfish, then? Goldfish don't scare Nana.

translations.fa: آه. پس می‌شه یه ماهی قرمز داشته باشیم؟ ماهی قرمز نانا را نمی‌ترسونه.

branches.suggestion: A goldfish is a good idea.
Goldfish are easy!

n10.speaker: tom
n10.text: A goldfish… OK. Maybe for your birthday. Is that a deal?

translations.fa: ماهی قرمز… باشه. شاید برای تولدت. قبوله؟

branches.suggestion: That's a good deal, Nicola!
Say thank you to Daddy!

n11.speaker: nicola
n11.text: Yes! Thank you, Daddy! A goldfish called Muffin!

translations.fa: آره! ممنون بابا! یه ماهی قرمز به اسم مافین!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Welcome to the city farm! It's right here in Hackney. What can you see?

translations.fa: به مزرعهٔ شهری خوش اومدی! همین‌جا تو هاکنیه. چی می‌بینی؟

branches.suggestion: I can see sheep and goats.
There's a big pig!

cultureNote.en: London has several free "city farms" where children can meet farm animals.
cultureNote.fa: لندن مزرعه‌های شهری رایگان دارد.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Yes! That's Doris the pig. She's very old. What does a pig say?

translations.fa: آره! اون دوریس خوکه. خیلی پیره. خوک چی می‌گه؟

branches.suggestion: Oink oink!
In English? I don't know.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Oink! And a cow says "moo". What does a sheep say?

translations.fa: خرخر! و گاو می‌گه «ما». گوسفند چی می‌گه؟

branches.suggestion: Baa! Baa!
Is it the same in Persian?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Well done! Look, William loves the chickens. Chickens can't fly very well.

translations.fa: آفرین! ببین، ویلیام عاشق مرغ‌هاست. مرغ‌ها خوب نمی‌تونن پرواز کنن.

branches.suggestion: Can they fly a little?
Ducks can fly, but chickens can't.
branches.suggestionFa: اردک‌ها پرواز می‌کنن، ولی مرغ‌ها نه.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Just a little. Would you like to feed the goats? It's one pound for a bag.

translations.fa: فقط یه کم. می‌خوای به بزها غذا بدی؟ یه کیسه یه پونده.

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Here's a pound.
Do goats bite?

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: No, they don't bite. But they eat everything! Watch your coat!

translations.fa: نه، گاز نمی‌گیرن. ولی همه چی می‌خورن! مواظب کتت باش!

branches.suggestion: Oh no! He's eating my sleeve!
branches.suggestionFa: وای نه! داره آستینم را می‌خوره!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! Naughty goat!

recasts.echo: He's eating your coat? Oh dear!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Look over there! A horse. Do you like horses?

translations.fa: اونجا را ببین! یه اسب. اسب دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I love horses.
They're beautiful, but very big.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Now we must wash our hands. Always wash your hands at a farm!

translations.fa: حالا باید دستامون را بشوریم. تو مزرعه همیشه دستات را بشور!

branches.suggestion: OK. Where's the sink?
Good idea. Then an ice cream?

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Yes, an ice cream at the café! William wants to say goodbye to Doris the pig first. Bye, Doris!

translations.fa: آره، یه بستنی تو کافه! ویلیام اول می‌خواد با دوریس خوکه خداحافظی کنه. خداحافظ دوریس!

n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Right, Nicola, teeth time! Can you pass me her toothbrush, love? The pink one.

translations.fa: خب نیکولا، وقت دندون! عزیزم، مسواکش را بهم می‌دی؟ صورتیه.

branches.suggestion: Here you are, Nana.
This one? The pink one?

cultureNote.en: Many British people say "love" or "dear" to friends and family — it's warm, not romantic.
cultureNote.fa: love اینجا یعنی عزیزم.

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: Thank you. And the toothpaste. Just a little bit — the size of a pea.

translations.fa: ممنون. و خمیردندون. فقط یه کم — اندازهٔ یه نخود.

branches.suggestion: Like this?
That's very small!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: I can do it myself, Nana! I'm a big girl!

translations.fa: خودم می‌تونم نانا! دختر بزرگی‌ام!

branches.suggestion: OK, you do it.
Good girl! Show us.

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Up and down, Nicola. Not too fast. Brush the back teeth, too.

translations.fa: بالا و پایین نیکولا. نه خیلی تند. دندون‌های عقب را هم بشور.

branches.suggestion: Up and down, up and down!
branches.suggestionFa: بالا و پایین، بالا و پایین!

branches.suggestion: How long do we brush?

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: Two minutes. Let's sing a song. Two minutes is two songs!

translations.fa: دو دقیقه. بیا یه آهنگ بخونیم. دو دقیقه یعنی دو تا آهنگ!

branches.suggestion: Which song?
I don't know any English songs.

cultureNote.en: The NHS advises brushing twice a day for two minutes with fluoride toothpaste.
cultureNote.fa: دو بار در روز، دو دقیقه.

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star"! Everybody knows that. Don't swallow the toothpaste, Nicola!

translations.fa: «چشمک بزن ستاره کوچولو»! همه بلدن. خمیردندون را قورت نده نیکولا!

branches.suggestion: Spit it out, Nicola!
Don't swallow! Spit!

recasts.echo: Don't swallow it? That's right!

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Done! Look, Nana! My teeth are shiny!

translations.fa: تموم شد! ببین نانا! دندونام برق می‌زنه!

branches.suggestion: Very shiny! Well done!
Let me see. Open your mouth!
branches.suggestionFa: بذار ببینم. دهنت را باز کن!

n8.speaker: weda
n8.text: Lovely. Now rinse your toothbrush and put it in the cup.

translations.fa: عالی. حالا مسواکت را آب بکش و بذارش تو لیوان.

branches.suggestion: Where's the cup?
And now bed?

n9.speaker: weda
n9.text: Yes, bed! One story, then sleep. Thank you for helping, love. My knees don't like this bathroom floor!

translations.fa: آره، خواب! یه قصه، بعد خواب. ممنون که کمک کردی عزیزم. زانوهام از این کف حموم خوششون نمیاد!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: My hands are dirty! I was in the garden. Look — mud!

translations.fa: دستام کثیفه! تو باغ بودم. ببین — گِل!

branches.suggestion: Wash your hands, Nicola.
Oh dear! Very dirty!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Can you help me? I can't reach the tap.

translations.fa: کمکم می‌کنی؟ دستم به شیر آب نمی‌رسه.

branches.suggestion: Stand on this stool.
I'll turn on the tap for you.
branches.suggestionFa: من شیر را برات باز می‌کنم.

cultureNote.en: British "tap" = American "faucet".
cultureNote.fa: tap/faucet.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Brr! It's cold! I want warm water.

translations.fa: برر! سرده! آب گرم می‌خوام.

branches.suggestion: Wait a moment. Now it's warm.
branches.suggestionFa: یه لحظه صبر کن. حالا گرمه.

branches.suggestion: Is that better?

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: First water, then soap. Mummy says twenty seconds.

translations.fa: اول آب، بعد صابون. مامان می‌گه بیست ثانیه.

branches.suggestion: Let's count to twenty.
Rub your hands together.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: One, two, three… twenty! Bubbles everywhere!

translations.fa: یک، دو، سه… بیست! همه جا حباب!

branches.suggestion: Now rinse off the soap.
Don't forget your nails!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: All clean! Where's the towel?

translations.fa: همه تمیز! حوله کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: It's on the hook.
Here's the towel. Dry your hands.
branches.suggestionFa: این حوله. دستات را خشک کن.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: When do you wash your hands? I wash them before lunch.

translations.fa: تو کِی دستات را می‌شوری؟ من قبل از ناهار می‌شورم.

branches.suggestion: I wash my hands before I eat.
branches.suggestionFa: قبل از غذا دستام را می‌شورم.

branches.suggestion: After the toilet and before cooking.
branches.suggestionFa: بعد از دستشویی و قبل از آشپزی.

cultureNote.en: British people say "the toilet" or "the loo"; Americans say "the bathroom" or "the restroom".
cultureNote.fa: toilet/loo و bathroom/restroom.

recasts.echo: Before you eat? Me too!
recasts.better: I wash my hands before I eat.
recasts.betterFa: قبل از غذا دستام را می‌شورم.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Me too! And after I touch Tiger the cat. Can I have a biscuit now?

translations.fa: منم! و بعد از اینکه به تایگر گربه دست می‌زنم. حالا می‌تونم بیسکویت بخورم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, one biscuit.
Ask Mummy first.

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Mummy! Can I have a biscuit? She says yes! A chocolate one!

translations.fa: مامان! می‌تونم بیسکویت بخورم؟ می‌گه آره! یه شکلاتی!

n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: William's bath is ready. Can you check the water? Not too hot!

translations.fa: حموم ویلیام آماده‌ست. آب را چک می‌کنی؟ نه خیلی داغ!

branches.suggestion: It's warm. It's fine.
It's a bit hot. Add some cold water.
branches.suggestionFa: یه کم داغه. یه کم آب سرد اضافه کن.

cultureNote.en: Test a child's bath with your elbow — it should feel warm, not hot.
cultureNote.fa: آب حمام بچه را با آرنج امتحان کنید.

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: Good. Now the bubble bath. Just a little. Oh! Nicola! That's too much!

translations.fa: خوبه. حالا کف حموم. فقط یه کم. آه! نیکولا! خیلی زیاده!

branches.suggestion: Stop, Nicola! That's enough!
Oh no! Look at all the bubbles!
branches.suggestionFa: وای نه! این همه حباب را ببین!

recasts.echo: Too many bubbles? Yes, far too many!

n3.speaker: william
n3.text: Bubbles! I want more bubbles!

translations.fa: حباب! حباب بیشتر می‌خوام!

branches.suggestion: No more bubbles, William!
He loves the bubbles!

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Ha! I can't see William. Where's William? There he is!

translations.fa: ها! ویلیام را نمی‌بینم. ویلیام کجاست؟ اوناهاش!

branches.suggestion: Peekaboo, William!
He's under the bubbles!

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: Can you pass me the duck? The yellow rubber duck.

translations.fa: اردک را بهم می‌دی؟ اردک لاستیکی زرد.

branches.suggestion: Here's the duck. Quack quack!
Is this the duck?

n6.speaker: william
n6.text: Splash! My duck is swimming!

translations.fa: شلپ! اردکم داره شنا می‌کنه!

branches.suggestion: Oh! I'm all wet!
Not too much splashing, William!

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: Oh dear, you're wet! And the floor is wet. Can you get a towel for the floor?

translations.fa: ای وای، خیس شدی! و زمین خیسه. یه حوله برای زمین میاری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Which towel?
The old blue one?

n8.speaker: weda
n8.text: Yes, the old blue one. Now wash his hair. Gently. He doesn't like water in his eyes.

translations.fa: آره، آبی قدیمیه. حالا موهاش را بشور. آروم. دوست نداره آب بره تو چشماش.

branches.suggestion: Close your eyes, William.
Look up at the ceiling!

n9.speaker: weda
n9.text: Clever! He's all clean now. Out you come, little man. Bath time is the best time, isn't it?

translations.fa: زرنگی! حالا تمیز تمیزه. بیا بیرون مرد کوچولو. وقت حموم بهترین وقته، نه؟

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Nicola's out of the bath. Can you find her pyjamas? They're in the bedroom.

translations.fa: نیکولا از حموم اومد بیرون. پیژامه‌اش را پیدا می‌کنی؟ تو اتاق خوابه.

branches.suggestion: Where in the bedroom?
Are they on the bed?

cultureNote.en: British "pyjamas", American "pajamas".
cultureNote.fa: pyjamas/pajamas.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: They're under her pillow. The ones with rainbows.

translations.fa: زیر بالشش‌ان. همونایی که رنگین‌کمون دارن.

branches.suggestion: Got them!
Here they are!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: I'm cold! Wrap me in the big towel!

translations.fa: سردمه! منو تو حولهٔ بزرگه بپیچ!

branches.suggestion: Here you are. Snug as a bug!
branches.suggestionFa: بفرما. مثل یه حشره تو پیله!

branches.suggestion: Is that better?

cultureNote.en: "Snug as a bug in a rug" is a cosy British bedtime phrase.
cultureNote.fa: عبارت خودمانی برای گرم و نرم.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Now dry your hair, Nicola. Where's the hairdryer?

translations.fa: حالا موهات را خشک کن نیکولا. سشوار کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: Is it in the drawer?
I think it's next to the mirror.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Yes, it's next to the mirror. Can you plug it in? The socket is behind the door.

translations.fa: آره، کنار آینه‌ست. می‌تونی بزنیش به برق؟ پریز پشت دره.

branches.suggestion: OK. It's on now.
In Britain, plugs are different!

cultureNote.en: British plugs have three square pins. Bathrooms usually have no normal sockets for safety.
cultureNote.fa: دوشاخهٔ بریتانیایی سه پایهٔ مربعی دارد.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Too hot! Too loud!

translations.fa: خیلی داغه! خیلی سروصدا داره!

branches.suggestion: Sorry! Is this better?
Sit still, Nicola. Nearly done.

recasts.echo: It's too loud? I'll turn it down.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Now pyjamas on. Where are her slippers?

translations.fa: حالا پیژامه بپوش. دمپایی‌هاش کجان؟

branches.suggestion: They're by the door.
I can't see them. Are they under the bed?

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Here! In the bath! Oops. They're wet now.

translations.fa: اینجا! تو وان! اوپس. حالا خیسن.

branches.suggestion: Oh, Nicola!
Never mind. Wear your socks.

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Clean, dry and in pyjamas! Thank you, love. Now, warm milk and a story. You choose the book, Nicola!

translations.fa: تمیز، خشک و با پیژامه! ممنون عزیزم. حالا شیر گرم و یه قصه. تو کتاب را انتخاب کن نیکولا!

n1.speaker: mia
n1.text: That's my doll! Nicola has got my doll!

translations.fa: اون عروسک منه! نیکولا عروسکم را برداشته!

branches.suggestion: Let's share the toys, girls.
branches.suggestionFa: دخترا، بیاید اسباب‌بازی‌ها را با هم استفاده کنیم.

branches.suggestion: Nicola, can Mia have her doll?
branches.suggestionFa: نیکولا، می‌شه میا عروسکش را داشته باشه؟

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: But I want to play with it! Mia has got lots of dolls.

translations.fa: ولی من می‌خوام باهاش بازی کنم! میا کلی عروسک داره.

branches.suggestion: You can take turns.
First Mia, then you.

cultureNote.en: "Taking turns" and "sharing nicely" are big lessons in British nurseries and schools.
cultureNote.fa: نوبت و اشتراک در مهدکودک‌ها مهم است.

n3.speaker: mia
n3.text: OK. Five minutes for me, then five minutes for Nicola. Can you count?

translations.fa: باشه. پنج دقیقه برای من، بعد پنج دقیقه برای نیکولا. می‌تونی بشمری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. I've got a timer on my phone.
OK. Five minutes. Go!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: What can I play with now? I'm bored.

translations.fa: حالا با چی بازی کنم؟ حوصله‌ام سر رفته.

branches.suggestion: What about the teddy bear?
Let's build a tower with the blocks.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا با مکعب‌ها یه برج بسازیم.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: A tower! A very tall tower! You put a red block on top.

translations.fa: یه برج! یه برج خیلی بلند! تو یه مکعب قرمز بذار بالاش.

branches.suggestion: Like this?
It's very tall now!

n6.speaker: mia
n6.text: Can I play too? I can put the yellow one on.

translations.fa: منم می‌تونم بازی کنم؟ من می‌تونم زرده را بذارم.

branches.suggestion: Of course! Careful!
Yes, it's your turn, Mia.

recasts.echo: Your turn? Yes, it's Mia's turn!

n7.speaker: mia
n7.text: Oh no! It fell down! Sorry!

translations.fa: وای نه! افتاد! ببخشید!

branches.suggestion: Never mind! Let's build it again.
That's OK. It was fun!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Ding! Five minutes! It's my turn with the doll now!

translations.fa: دینگ! پنج دقیقه! حالا نوبت منه با عروسک!

branches.suggestion: Mia, can Nicola have the doll now?
branches.suggestionFa: میا، الان نیکولا می‌تونه عروسک را برداره؟

branches.suggestion: Well done for waiting, Nicola.

n9.speaker: mia
n9.text: Here you are, Nicola. You can brush her hair. I'll play with the teddy bear. Sharing is nice!

translations.fa: بیا نیکولا. می‌تونی موهاش را شونه کنی. من با خرس عروسکی بازی می‌کنم. شریک شدن خوبه!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Let's play hide and seek! You count, and I hide. Count to twenty!

translations.fa: بیا قایم‌باشک بازی کنیم! تو بشمر، من قایم می‌شم. تا بیست بشمر!

branches.suggestion: OK. Close my eyes… one, two, three…
branches.suggestionFa: باشه. چشمامو می‌بندم… یک، دو، سه…

branches.suggestion: Can I count in Persian?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: No, in English! Ready or not, here I come! You say that.

translations.fa: نه، انگلیسی! «حاضر باشی یا نه، دارم میام!» تو اینو بگو.

branches.suggestion: Ready or not, here I come!
branches.suggestionFa: حاضر باشی یا نه، دارم میام!

branches.suggestion: Nineteen, twenty! Coming!

cultureNote.en: "Ready or not, here I come!" is what British children shout before seeking.
cultureNote.fa: جملهٔ سنتی قایم‌باشک.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Hee hee! You can't find me!

translations.fa: هی هی! نمی‌تونی پیدام کنی!

branches.suggestion: Is she behind the sofa?
Nicola? Where are you?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: She isn't behind the sofa. I can hear her laughing!

translations.fa: پشت مبل نیست. صدای خندیدنش را می‌شنوم!

branches.suggestion: Is she under the table?
Is she in the cupboard?

recasts.echo: Is she under the table? Let's look!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Let's look… no, not under the table. Shall we look behind the curtains?

translations.fa: ببینیم… نه، زیر میز نیست. پشت پرده‌ها را ببینیم؟

branches.suggestion: I can see two feet!
Yes, behind the curtains!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: You found me! How did you find me?

translations.fa: پیدام کردی! چطوری پیدام کردی؟

branches.suggestion: I saw your feet!
You were laughing!

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Now you hide! I'm good at finding. I'll count to twenty.

translations.fa: حالا تو قایم شو! من تو پیدا کردن خوبم. تا بیست می‌شمرم.

branches.suggestion: OK. No looking!
Close your eyes!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Eighteen, nineteen, twenty! Are you in the kitchen? Are you in the garden?

translations.fa: هجده، نوزده، بیست! تو آشپزخونه‌ای؟ تو باغی؟

branches.suggestion: (quietly) I'm not telling!
Cold! You're cold!

cultureNote.en: "You're getting warmer / colder" helps the seeker: warm means close, cold means far.
cultureNote.fa: گرم یعنی نزدیک، سرد یعنی دور.

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Found you! You're behind the door! My turn again! This is the best game ever!

translations.fa: پیدات کردم! پشت دری! باز نوبت منه! این بهترین بازی دنیاست!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: My jigsaw is nearly finished! It's a picture of a castle. But one piece is missing!

translations.fa: پازلم تقریباً تمومه! عکس یه قلعه‌ست. ولی یه تیکه نیست!

branches.suggestion: Oh no! What colour is it?
Where did you last see it?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: It's a blue piece. Part of the sky. Have you seen it?

translations.fa: یه تیکهٔ آبیه. یه قسمت از آسمون. دیدیش؟

branches.suggestion: No, I haven't seen it.
Is it on the floor?

recasts.echo: You haven't seen it? Let's look.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: I can't find it on the floor. Can you look under the sofa?

translations.fa: رو زمین پیداش نمی‌کنم. می‌تونی زیر مبل را نگاه کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I can see a pen and a crisp.
branches.suggestionFa: یه خودکار و یه چیپس می‌بینم.

branches.suggestion: There's lots of dust!

cultureNote.en: British "crisps" are American "chips"; British "chips" are American "fries".
cultureNote.fa: crisps/chips و chips/fries.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: A crisp! Yuck! Ryan eats crisps on the sofa. Is it in the box?

translations.fa: یه چیپس! ایش! رایان رو مبل چیپس می‌خوره. تو جعبه‌ست؟

branches.suggestion: No, the box is empty.
Let me shake the box.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Maybe William has got it. He puts things in his mouth!

translations.fa: شاید ویلیام برداشته. چیزها را می‌ذاره تو دهنش!

branches.suggestion: Oh no! Let's check!
Is it in his hand?

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Don't worry. William's got his toy bus, not the jigsaw. Have you looked in your pocket, Nicola?

translations.fa: نگران نباشید. ویلیام اتوبوس اسباب‌بازیش را داره، نه پازل را. جیبت را نگاه کردی نیکولا؟

branches.suggestion: Check your pocket, Nicola.
Good idea!

cultureNote.en: British "jigsaw" (or "jigsaw puzzle") = American "puzzle".
cultureNote.fa: jigsaw = puzzle.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: My pocket… YES! Here it is! Silly me!

translations.fa: جیبم… آره! ایناهاش! چه خنگم!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! Well done!
Put it in, Nicola!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Click! Finished! Look at my castle! Can we take a photo for Nana?

translations.fa: تق! تموم شد! قلعه‌ام را ببین! می‌شه یه عکس برای نانا بگیریم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Smile, Nicola!
It's a beautiful castle!

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Send it to Nana! Now let's do another jigsaw. A thousand pieces! Just joking!

translations.fa: برای نانا بفرستش! حالا یه پازل دیگه درست کنیم. هزار تیکه! شوخی کردم!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: OK, everybody! It's tidy-up time. Look at this room!

translations.fa: خب همگی! وقت مرتب کردنه. این اتاق را ببینید!

branches.suggestion: Wow, it's very messy!
Shall I help?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Do I have to? I'm tired!

translations.fa: باید؟ خسته‌ام!

branches.suggestion: Yes. Let's do it together.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. بیا با هم انجامش بدیم.

branches.suggestion: It's quick if we all help.
branches.suggestionFa: اگه همه کمک کنیم زود تموم میشه.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Thank you. Put the blocks in the big box, please.

translations.fa: ممنون. مکعب‌ها را بذار تو جعبهٔ بزرگ، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: All the blocks?
In the red box?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Yes, the red box. Nicola, put your books on the shelf.

translations.fa: آره، جعبهٔ قرمز. نیکولا، کتاب‌هات را بذار رو قفسه.

branches.suggestion: Nicola, the books go on the shelf.
I'll help you with the books.

recasts.echo: On the shelf? Yes, please.
recasts.better: Put the books on the shelf.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Let's make it a race! Who can tidy fastest? Go!

translations.fa: بیا مسابقه‌اش کنیم! کی سریع‌تر مرتب می‌کنه؟ شروع!

branches.suggestion: Ready, steady, go!
I'm faster than you!

cultureNote.en: British children say "Ready, steady, go!"; Americans say "Ready, set, go!".
cultureNote.fa: Ready, steady, go در بریتانیا.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Where does the teddy go?

translations.fa: خرس عروسکی کجا می‌ره؟

branches.suggestion: On Nicola's bed.
In the toy box, I think.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: On her bed, please. And put the pens away. Not in your pocket, Nicola!

translations.fa: روی تختش، لطفاً. و خودکارها را جمع کن. نه تو جیبت نیکولا!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! Put them in the pot.
Where's the pen pot?

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Finished! I won! The room is clean!

translations.fa: تموم! من بردم! اتاق تمیزه!

branches.suggestion: Well done, everybody!
It looks lovely now.

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Brilliant! Thank you both. Who wants a reward? Ice lollies from the freezer!

translations.fa: عالی! ممنون از هر دوتون. کی جایزه می‌خواد؟ بستنی یخی از فریزر!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: This is Raj's shop. His fruit and veg are the best on the high street. What do we need?

translations.fa: این مغازهٔ راجه. میوه و سبزی‌اش بهترینِ خیابون اصلیه. چی لازم داریم؟

branches.suggestion: We need apples and bananas.
Let me look at the list.

cultureNote.en: "Veg" is short for vegetables. "Fruit and veg" is a very common British phrase.
cultureNote.fa: veg مخفف vegetables است.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Apples, bananas, carrots and potatoes. Can you ask for the apples?

translations.fa: سیب، موز، هویج و سیب‌زمینی. تو سیب‌ها را می‌خوای؟

branches.suggestion: Excuse me, can I have six apples, please?
branches.suggestionFa: ببخشید، می‌شه شش تا سیب بدید؟

branches.suggestion: Hello! Six green apples, please.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام! شش تا سیب سبز، لطفاً.

n3.speaker: baker
n3.text: Six apples. Red or green? The red ones are very sweet today.

translations.fa: شش تا سیب. قرمز یا سبز؟ قرمزها امروز خیلی شیرینن.

branches.suggestion: Just the red ones.
Three red and three green, please.
branches.suggestionFa: سه تا قرمز و سه تا سبز، لطفاً.

n4.speaker: baker
n4.text: There you go. Anything else, love?

translations.fa: بفرما. چیز دیگه، عزیزم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. How much are the bananas?
A bunch of bananas, please.

recasts.echo: How much are the bananas? Eighty pence.

n5.speaker: baker
n5.text: Bananas are eighty pence a bunch. These are ripe. Those are a bit green.

translations.fa: موزها شونه‌ای هشتاد پنی‌ان. اینا رسیده‌ان. اونا یه کم کالن.

branches.suggestion: I'll take the ripe ones.
The green ones, please. They last longer.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Good thinking. Now, a kilo of carrots and two kilos of potatoes.

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. حالا یه کیلو هویج و دو کیلو سیب‌زمینی.

branches.suggestion: A kilo of carrots and two kilos of potatoes, please.
branches.suggestionFa: یه کیلو هویج و دو کیلو سیب‌زمینی، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Can I have carrots and potatoes, please?

cultureNote.en: The UK uses kilos in shops, but many older people still think in pounds (lb) and ounces.
cultureNote.fa: فروشگاه‌ها کیلو، ولی سالمندان پوند.

n7.speaker: baker
n7.text: Lovely. Would you like a bag? It's ten pence.

translations.fa: عالی. کیسه می‌خواید؟ ده پنیه.

branches.suggestion: No, thanks. I've got a bag.
Yes, please.

cultureNote.en: British shops charge for plastic bags, so people bring their own "bag for life".
cultureNote.fa: فروشگاه‌ها برای کیسه پول می‌گیرند.

n8.speaker: baker
n8.text: That's five pounds forty altogether.

translations.fa: جمعاً پنج پوند و چهل میشه.

branches.suggestion: Here's a ten-pound note.
Can I pay by card?

n9.speaker: baker
n9.text: Of course. Tap here… Done. Thanks, love! See you next week, Leslie! Have a lovely day!

translations.fa: البته. اینجا بزنید… تموم. ممنون عزیزم! هفتهٔ بعد می‌بینمت لزلی! روز خوبی داشته باشید!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: At school we learnt about "five a day". Do you know it?

translations.fa: تو مدرسه دربارهٔ «پنج در روز» یاد گرفتیم. می‌دونی چیه؟

branches.suggestion: No. What is it?
Five fruit and vegetables every day!
branches.suggestionFa: پنج تا میوه و سبزی هر روز!

cultureNote.en: The NHS "5 A Day" campaign tells people to eat five portions of fruit and veg daily.
cultureNote.fa: کمپین ۵ در روز.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Five fruit and vegetables every day! Let's count. What did you eat today?

translations.fa: پنج تا میوه و سبزی هر روز! بیا بشمریم. امروز چی خوردی؟

branches.suggestion: An apple and a banana.
I had an orange for breakfast.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: That's two! I had strawberries. Strawberries are my favourite.

translations.fa: این دو تا! من توت‌فرنگی خوردم. توت‌فرنگی مورد علاقه‌مه.

branches.suggestion: Strawberries are delicious!
Do you like grapes?

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Yes! Green grapes. But Mummy cuts them in half for William.

translations.fa: آره! انگور سبز. ولی مامان برای ویلیام نصفشون می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: Why does she cut them?
That's safer for babies.

cultureNote.en: Parents in the UK are told to cut grapes lengthways for small children to prevent choking.
cultureNote.fa: انگور را برای کودکان از طول ببرید.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Yes, it's safer. What vegetables do you like?

translations.fa: آره، امن‌تره. چه سبزی‌هایی دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: I like tomatoes and cucumbers.
I love aubergines!

cultureNote.en: British "aubergine", "courgette"; American "eggplant", "zucchini".
cultureNote.fa: aubergine/eggplant و courgette/zucchini.

recasts.echo: You like tomatoes? Me too!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Aubergines are purple! I don't like them. I like peas and sweetcorn.

translations.fa: بادمجون بنفشه! دوستش ندارم. نخود فرنگی و ذرت دوست دارم.

branches.suggestion: Peas and sweetcorn are vegetables, too.
Do you eat carrots?

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Yes! Carrots help you see in the dark. Nana says so.

translations.fa: آره! هویج کمک می‌کنه تو تاریکی ببینی. نانا این‌جوری می‌گه.

branches.suggestion: Ha! Is that true?
Maybe a little!

cultureNote.en: The "carrots help you see in the dark" story comes from the Second World War.
cultureNote.fa: این داستان از جنگ جهانی دوم است.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: So, how many have you got today?

translations.fa: خب، تو امروز چند تا داری؟

branches.suggestion: I've got three. I need two more.
branches.suggestionFa: سه تا دارم. دو تای دیگه لازم دارم.

branches.suggestion: Five! I had salad at lunch.

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Well done! You get a gold star! Tonight Mummy is making soup. That's lots of vegetables!

translations.fa: آفرین! یه ستارهٔ طلایی می‌گیری! امشب مامان سوپ درست می‌کنه. کلی سبزی!

n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Would you like an orange? I'll peel one for you. My hands are a bit stiff today, though.

translations.fa: پرتقال می‌خوای؟ برات یکی پوست می‌کنم. ولی دستام امروز یه کم خشکه.

branches.suggestion: Thank you. Can I help you?
I can peel it, Maggie.

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: Lovely. First, wash your hands. Then take a small knife.

translations.fa: عالی. اول دستات را بشور. بعد یه چاقوی کوچیک بردار.

branches.suggestion: OK. This small knife?
My hands are clean. Where are the knives?

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: In the drawer. Next, cut the top off. Carefully!

translations.fa: تو کشو. بعدش، سرش را ببر. با احتیاط!

branches.suggestion: Like this?
It smells lovely!

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Perfect. Then pull the peel off with your fingers. Round and round.

translations.fa: عالی. بعد پوست را با انگشتات بکن. دور تا دور.

branches.suggestion: The peel is very thick.
It's coming off in one piece!

recasts.echo: Very thick? Yes, it's a big one!

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: One piece! When I was a girl, we made a wish if the peel came off in one piece.

translations.fa: یه تیکه! وقتی بچه بودم، اگه پوست یه تیکه کنده میشد آرزو می‌کردیم.

branches.suggestion: What did you wish for?
Can I make a wish?

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: Oh, a bicycle, usually! Now, finally, break it into segments.

translations.fa: آه، معمولاً یه دوچرخه! حالا، در آخر، پره‌پره‌اش کن.

branches.suggestion: Here's one for you, Maggie.
How many pieces are there?

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: Thank you, love. Ooh, it's juicy! Oranges always make me think of Christmas.

translations.fa: ممنون عزیزم. اوه، چه آبداره! پرتقال همیشه منو یاد کریسمس می‌ندازه.

branches.suggestion: Why Christmas?
In Iran we eat oranges at Yalda.
branches.suggestionFa: تو ایران شب یلدا پرتقال می‌خوریم.

cultureNote.en: Many older Britons remember getting an orange in their Christmas stocking as a special treat.
cultureNote.fa: پرتقال در جوراب کریسمس، هدیهٔ قدیمی.

n8.speaker: weda
n8.text: We got an orange in our Christmas stocking. It was a big treat back then! Tell me about Yalda.

translations.fa: تو جوراب کریسمس‌مون یه پرتقال می‌گرفتیم. اون موقع خیلی چیز ویژه‌ای بود! از یلدا بگو.

branches.suggestion: It's the longest night. We eat fruit and read poems.
branches.suggestionFa: طولانی‌ترین شبه. میوه می‌خوریم و شعر می‌خونیم.

branches.suggestion: We stay up late with family and eat pomegranates.
branches.suggestionFa: با خانواده تا دیروقت بیدار می‌مونیم و انار می‌خوریم.

n9.speaker: weda
n9.text: Poems and pomegranates — how lovely! We must have a Yalda night here this year. I'll make the tea!

translations.fa: شعر و انار — چه قشنگ! امسال حتماً باید اینجا شب یلدا بگیریم. من چای درست می‌کنم!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Yuck! Sprouts! I don't like sprouts. They're green and smelly!

translations.fa: ایش! کلم بروکسل! کلم بروکسل دوست ندارم. سبزه و بوی بد می‌ده!

branches.suggestion: Just try one, Nicola.
I don't like them much, either.

cultureNote.en: Brussels sprouts are a famous Christmas vegetable in Britain — people love them or hate them.
cultureNote.fa: کلم بروکسل غذای معروف کریسمس است.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: One sprout, Nicola. Then you can have pudding.

translations.fa: یه دونه نیکولا. بعد می‌تونی دسر بخوری.

branches.suggestion: That's fair. One sprout!
What's for pudding?

cultureNote.en: In Britain, "pudding" or "pud" often means any dessert.
cultureNote.fa: pudding یعنی هر نوع دسر.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: What's for pudding, Daddy?

translations.fa: دسر چیه بابا؟

branches.suggestion: Let me guess. Ice cream?
I hope it's chocolate cake!

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Apple crumble and custard! Now, one sprout. What do you like, {you}? Do you like sprouts?

translations.fa: کرامبل سیب با کاستارد! حالا، یه دونه. تو چی دوست داری {you}؟ کلم بروکسل دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: I like them with butter.
Not really. But I like carrots.
branches.suggestionFa: نه چندان. ولی هویج دوست دارم.

recasts.echo: You don't like them? Fair enough!

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: See! {you} doesn't like them either. Can I give mine to Daddy?

translations.fa: دیدی! {you} هم دوستشون نداره. می‌شه مال منو بدم بابا؟

branches.suggestion: Nice try, Nicola!
Eat one first!

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: OK, let's make a deal. Cut it in half. Eat half with gravy.

translations.fa: خب، بیا یه قرار بذاریم. نصفش کن. نصفش را با سس گوشت بخور.

branches.suggestion: Half is easy, Nicola!
Gravy makes everything better.
branches.suggestionFa: سس همه چی را بهتر می‌کنه.

cultureNote.en: Gravy, a sauce made from meat juices, goes on almost everything at a British dinner.
cultureNote.fa: گریوی سس پرطرفدار بریتانیایی است.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Mmm… hmm… It's not bad! It's a bit like cabbage.

translations.fa: ممم… هوم… بد نیست! یه کم مثل کلمه.

branches.suggestion: Well done, Nicola!
See? It's not so bad!

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Brilliant! Now you can have crumble. What do you think of crumble, {you}?

translations.fa: عالی! حالا می‌تونی کرامبل بخوری. نظرت دربارهٔ کرامبل چیه {you}؟

branches.suggestion: I love it! It's delicious.
Is it hot or cold?

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Hot crumble with cold custard! The best! Sprouts — one. Nicola — one hundred points!

translations.fa: کرامبل گرم با کاستارد سرد! بهترین! کلم بروکسل — یک. نیکولا — صد امتیاز!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: I'm thirsty! Can I have a drink, please?

translations.fa: تشنمه! می‌شه یه نوشیدنی بخورم، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. What would you like?
Would you like some water?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Not water. Squash, please! Orange squash.

translations.fa: آب نه. شربت، لطفاً! شربت پرتقال.

branches.suggestion: What's squash?
Where's the squash?

cultureNote.en: "Squash" is a sweet fruit syrup you mix with water — very British. Americans don't really have it.
cultureNote.fa: اسکواش شربت غلیظ بریتانیایی است.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: It's in the cupboard. A little squash, then lots of water. Not too strong!

translations.fa: تو کابینته. یه کم شربت، بعد کلی آب. نه خیلی غلیظ!

branches.suggestion: Like this?
Is this too strong?

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Mmm, perfect! Do you want some squash too?

translations.fa: ممم، عالی! تو هم شربت می‌خوای؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Just a little.
No, thank you. I'd like a glass of milk.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، ممنون. یه لیوان شیر می‌خوام.

recasts.echo: You'd like milk? Here you are.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Milk is in the fridge. Ryan drinks milk from the bottle! Mummy gets cross.

translations.fa: شیر تو یخچاله. رایان از بطری شیر می‌خوره! مامان عصبانی میشه.

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! Not from the bottle!
That's not very nice!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Which milk do you want? Blue, green or red?

translations.fa: کدوم شیر را می‌خوای؟ آبی، سبز یا قرمز؟

branches.suggestion: What do the colours mean?
Green, please.

cultureNote.en: British milk bottle tops are colour-coded: blue = whole, green = semi-skimmed, red = skimmed.
cultureNote.fa: آبی پرچرب، سبز نیم‌چرب، قرمز بدون چربی.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Blue is full fat. Green is half. Red is no fat. Daddy likes blue!

translations.fa: آبی پرچربه. سبز نصفه. قرمز بی‌چربی. بابا آبی دوست داره!

branches.suggestion: I'll have the green one.
Green, please. Half is good.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Cheers! That's what grown-ups say. Cheers!

translations.fa: به سلامتی! اینو بزرگ‌ترها می‌گن. به سلامتی!

branches.suggestion: Cheers, Nicola!
Cheers! Clink!

cultureNote.en: "Cheers" means "to your health" when drinking, but Brits also use it to mean "thanks" or "bye".
cultureNote.fa: cheers یعنی ممنون یا خداحافظ هم.

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Clink! Oops — I spilled a bit. Don't tell Mummy! Can I have a biscuit with it?

translations.fa: جرینگ! اوپس — یه کم ریختم. به مامان نگو! می‌شه باهاش یه بیسکویت بخورم؟

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Shall I put the kettle on? Fancy a cuppa?

translations.fa: کتری را بذارم؟ یه چای می‌چسبه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please! I'd love one.
Can I make it? I want to learn.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم من درستش کنم؟ می‌خوام یاد بگیرم.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Ooh, lovely! OK, first fill the kettle. Not too full.

translations.fa: اوه، عالی! خب، اول کتری را پر کن. نه خیلی پر.

branches.suggestion: How much water?
Is this enough water?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: That's perfect. Turn it on. Now, a teabag in each mug.

translations.fa: عالیه. روشنش کن. حالا، یه چای کیسه‌ای تو هر ماگ.

branches.suggestion: Where are the teabags?
Which mugs?

cultureNote.en: Most British people make tea with a teabag in a mug, not loose tea in a teapot.
cultureNote.fa: بیشتر بریتانیایی‌ها چای کیسه‌ای در ماگ درست می‌کنند.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: The tin next to the kettle. The kettle's boiled! Pour the water on the teabag.

translations.fa: قوطی کنار کتری. کتری جوش اومد! آب را روی چای کیسه‌ای بریز.

branches.suggestion: Like this? It's very hot.
Careful… done!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Now wait two or three minutes. Then take the teabag out. How do you take your tea?

translations.fa: حالا دو سه دقیقه صبر کن. بعد چای کیسه‌ای را دربیار. چایت را چطوری می‌خوری؟

branches.suggestion: With milk, please. No sugar.
Black, with one sugar.

recasts.echo: Milk, no sugar? Coming up!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: I like mine milky with one sugar. Nana likes it strong — "builder's tea"!

translations.fa: من مال خودمو پرشیر با یه قند دوست دارم. نانا پررنگ دوست داره — «چای بنّایی»!

branches.suggestion: What's builder's tea?
Like Persian tea!

newWords.fa: چای پررنگ با شیر و شکر

cultureNote.en: "Builder's tea" is strong tea with milk and usually sugar, the kind builders drink on their break.
cultureNote.fa: چای پررنگ کارگری.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Strong, with lots of milk and two sugars. How do you drink tea in Iran?

translations.fa: پررنگ، با کلی شیر و دو تا قند. تو ایران چای را چطوری می‌خورید؟

branches.suggestion: In small glasses, without milk.
We drink it with a sugar cube in our mouth.
branches.suggestionFa: با یه حبه قند تو دهن می‌خوریم.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: In your mouth? How clever! I must try that. Biscuit?

translations.fa: تو دهن؟ چه هوشمندانه! باید امتحانش کنم. بیسکویت؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. A digestive.
I'd love one. Can I dunk it?
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی دوست دارم. می‌تونم بزنمش تو چای؟

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Of course! Dunking is a national sport here. Don't leave it in too long, or it falls in! Cheers, love!

translations.fa: البته! زدن بیسکویت تو چای اینجا ورزش ملیه! زیاد نگهش ندار، وگرنه می‌افته! به سلامتی عزیزم!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Ow! My coffee's too hot! I burnt my tongue!

translations.fa: آخ! قهوه‌ام خیلی داغه! زبونم سوخت!

branches.suggestion: Oh no! Drink some cold water.
branches.suggestionFa: وای نه! یه کم آب سرد بخور.

branches.suggestion: Wait a minute. Let it cool down.
branches.suggestionFa: یه دقیقه صبر کن. بذار خنک بشه.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: I can't wait. I'm late for school! Can I put an ice cube in it?

translations.fa: نمی‌تونم صبر کنم. برای مدرسه دیرم شده! می‌شه یه تیکه یخ بندازم توش؟

branches.suggestion: Coffee with ice? That's strange!
Put some cold milk in it.
branches.suggestionFa: یه کم شیر سرد بریز توش.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Good idea. Milk… Oh no! Now it's too cold! And it's too milky!

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. شیر… وای نه! حالا خیلی سرده! و خیلی شیری شد!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! You can't win!
Heat it in the microwave.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Twenty seconds… there. Ugh! Now it's too sweet. Who put three sugars in it?

translations.fa: بیست ثانیه… بفرما. اه! حالا خیلی شیرینه. کی سه تا قند ریخت توش؟

branches.suggestion: Not me!
Maybe it was Nicola!

recasts.echo: It's too sweet? Poor Ryan!

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Nicola! She always does that. OK, I'll make a new one. Do you want one?

translations.fa: نیکولا! همیشه این کار را می‌کنه. باشه، یکی دیگه درست می‌کنم. تو هم می‌خوای؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Not too strong.
No, thanks. I've got tea.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Instant coffee. One spoon. Is one spoon too much?

translations.fa: قهوهٔ فوری. یه قاشق. یه قاشق زیاده؟

branches.suggestion: No, one spoon is fine.
Maybe half a spoon.

cultureNote.en: Instant coffee is still very popular in British homes, though coffee shops are everywhere.
cultureNote.fa: قهوهٔ فوری در خانه‌ها رایج است.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Right. Hot water, a bit of milk, no sugar. Now it's just right!

translations.fa: خب. آب داغ، یه کم شیر، بی‌شکر. حالا درست درسته!

branches.suggestion: Like Goldilocks!
Finally! Enjoy it.

cultureNote.en: "Goldilocks and the Three Bears": porridge too hot, too cold, then "just right".
cultureNote.fa: قصهٔ موطلایی و سه خرس.

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Ha! Goldilocks! Oh no — look at the time! I'm too late! Can you drink it for me? Bye!

translations.fa: ها! موطلایی! وای نه — ساعت را ببین! خیلی دیرم شد! می‌تونی تو برام بخوریش؟ خداحافظ!

branches.suggestion: Bye, Ryan! Run!
OK! Thanks for the coffee!
