recasts.echo: You haven't got an umbrella? Take Tom's!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Take Tom's. It's in the hall stand. Ready? Let's go! Mind the puddles!

translations.fa: مال تام را بردار. تو جاچتریه. آماده‌ای؟ بریم! مواظب چاله‌های آب باش!

branches.suggestion: Nicola is jumping in the puddles!
Ugh, my feet are wet!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: That's what wellies are for, Nicola! Jump! Here's school. Now, take your wellies off. Put your shoes on.

translations.fa: چکمه برای همینه نیکولا! بپر! اینم مدرسه. حالا، چکمه‌هات را دربیار. کفش‌هات را بپوش.

branches.suggestion: Here are her school shoes.
Where shall I put her wellies?

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: In the wellie rack, by the classroom door. Lots of wellies in a row!

translations.fa: تو جاچکمه‌ای، کنار در کلاس. کلی چکمه تو یه ردیف!

branches.suggestion: They're all different colours!
Bye, Nicola! Have a good day!
branches.suggestionFa: خداحافظ نیکولا! روز خوبی داشته باشی!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Right, home time for us. Don't take your wellies off yet — it's still raining. Typical British weather!

translations.fa: خب، وقت خونه رفتن ماست. هنوز چکمه‌هات را درنیار — هنوز بارون میاد. آب‌وهوای معمولی بریتانیا!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: We need to cross the road to get to the park. Nicola, hold my hand, please.

translations.fa: باید از خیابون رد بشیم که بریم پارک. نیکولا، دستم را بگیر، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Hold hands, Nicola.
Is there a crossing?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Yes, there's a zebra crossing. Black and white stripes, like a zebra!

translations.fa: آره، یه خط عابر پیاده‌ست. راه‌راه سیاه و سفید، مثل گورخر!

branches.suggestion: Ha! Like a zebra!
Do cars stop for us?

cultureNote.en: At a British zebra crossing, drivers must stop if someone is waiting to cross. The orange lights are "Belisha beacons".
cultureNote.fa: راننده‌ها در خط عابر باید بایستند.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: They should stop. But always look first. Remember: in Britain, cars drive on the left!

translations.fa: باید وایستن. ولی همیشه اول نگاه کن. یادت باشه: تو بریتانیا ماشین‌ها از سمت چپ می‌رن!

branches.suggestion: So I look right first?
branches.suggestionFa: پس اول سمت راست را نگاه کنم؟

branches.suggestion: In Iran, cars drive on the right.
branches.suggestionFa: تو ایران ماشین‌ها از سمت راست می‌رن.

cultureNote.en: In London, the ground often says "LOOK RIGHT" or "LOOK LEFT" to help visitors.
cultureNote.fa: روی زمین نوشته «به راست نگاه کن».

recasts.echo: Look right first? Exactly!

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Exactly! Look right, look left, look right again. Nicola, what's the rule?

translations.fa: دقیقاً! راست، چپ، دوباره راست. نیکولا، قانونش چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Tell us the rule, Nicola!
Do you know the rule, Nicola?

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Stop, look and listen!

translations.fa: بایست، نگاه کن و گوش کن!

branches.suggestion: Well done, Nicola!
Good girl! Is it safe now?

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: A bus is coming. Wait… Now the driver is waving. It's safe. Let's cross.

translations.fa: یه اتوبوس داره میاد. صبر کن… حالا راننده داره دست تکون می‌ده. امنه. بیا رد شیم.

branches.suggestion: Thank you!
Wave to the driver, Nicola!
branches.suggestionFa: برای راننده دست تکون بده نیکولا!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Here's the next road. This one has traffic lights. We wait for the green man.

translations.fa: اینم خیابون بعدی. این یکی چراغ راهنمایی داره. منتظر آدمک سبز می‌مونیم.

branches.suggestion: What's the green man?
Shall I press the button?

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Yes, press the button! The red man means stop. The green man means go.

translations.fa: آره، دکمه را فشار بده! آدمک قرمز یعنی بایست. آدمک سبز یعنی برو.

branches.suggestion: It's beeping! Green man!
We can go now.

cultureNote.en: At many UK pedestrian crossings, a beeping sound tells blind people when it's safe to cross.
cultureNote.fa: صدای بوق برای نابینایان است.

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Well done, both of you. Here's the park! Nicola, you can let go of my hand now. Run to the swings!

translations.fa: آفرین به هر دوتون. اینم پارک! نیکولا، حالا می‌تونی دستم را ول کنی. بدو سمت تاب‌ها!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: The playground! Come on! Push me on the swing, please!

translations.fa: زمین بازی! بیا! هلم بده روی تاب، لطفاً!

branches.suggestion: OK. Hold on tight!
Higher or lower?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Higher! Higher! I'm flying!

translations.fa: بالاتر! بالاتر! دارم پرواز می‌کنم!

branches.suggestion: Not too high!
Wow, you're very high!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Now the slide! Watch me. I'm going up the ladder… and down the slide! Wheee!

translations.fa: حالا سرسره! منو ببین. دارم از نردبون می‌رم بالا… و از سرسره می‌آم پایین! وییی!

branches.suggestion: Brilliant!
Again! Up and down!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Now you go on the slide! Go on!

translations.fa: حالا تو برو رو سرسره! برو دیگه!

branches.suggestion: I'm too big!
OK, just once!

recasts.echo: You're too big? No you're not!

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Ha ha ha! You got stuck! You're too big!

translations.fa: ها ها ها! گیر کردی! خیلی بزرگی!

branches.suggestion: Help! Pull me out!
I told you!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Now let's go through the tunnel. Can you crawl?

translations.fa: حالا بیا از تونل رد بشیم. می‌تونی چهار دست و پا بری؟

branches.suggestion: Through the tunnel? I'll try.
I'll wait at the end.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Then over the bridge and onto the climbing frame! Follow me!

translations.fa: بعد از روی پل و رو داربست بازی! دنبالم بیا!

branches.suggestion: Wait for me!
Be careful on the bridge!

cultureNote.en: British "climbing frame", American "jungle gym".
cultureNote.fa: climbing frame/jungle gym.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: I'm at the top! I'm the queen of the castle! You're the dirty rascal!

translations.fa: من بالام! من ملکهٔ قلعه‌ام! تو بچه‌شیطونِ کثیفی!

branches.suggestion: Ha ha! What does that mean?
Can I be the king?

cultureNote.en: "I'm the king of the castle, and you're the dirty rascal!" is an old British playground rhyme.
cultureNote.fa: شعر قدیمی زمین بازی.

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: It's a game! Now the roundabout. You push, I spin. Then ice cream!

translations.fa: یه بازیه! حالا چرخ‌وفلک. تو هل بده، من می‌چرخم. بعد بستنی!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Look! Big puddles! The rain stopped. Can we jump in them?

translations.fa: ببین! چاله‌های آب بزرگ! بارون بند اومد. می‌تونیم توشون بپریم؟

branches.suggestion: Have you got your wellies on?
Yes! Let's jump!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Yes! Wellies on! Ready? One, two, three… SPLASH!

translations.fa: آره! چکمه پامه! آماده‌ای؟ یک، دو، سه… شلپ!

branches.suggestion: What a big splash!
You're all wet!

cultureNote.en: Jumping in muddy puddles is a famous British childhood joy — thanks to the cartoon "Peppa Pig"!
cultureNote.fa: پریدن در چاله آب، مثل کارتون پپاپیگ.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Like Peppa Pig! Now you jump! In the big one!

translations.fa: مثل پپا پیگ! حالا تو بپر! تو اون بزرگه!

branches.suggestion: OK. Here I go… SPLASH!
I haven't got wellies!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Ha ha ha! Your trousers are muddy! What a mess!

translations.fa: ها ها ها! شلوارت گِلی شد! چه افتضاحی!

branches.suggestion: Oh no! Very muddy!
What a mess! Never mind.

recasts.echo: What a mess! Ha!

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Look! A rainbow! Over there, above the trees!

translations.fa: ببین! رنگین‌کمون! اونجا، بالای درخت‌ها!

branches.suggestion: What a beautiful rainbow!
How many colours can you see?

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue… and purple! Six!

translations.fa: قرمز، نارنجی، زرد، سبز، آبی… و بنفش! شش تا!

branches.suggestion: There are seven colours.
Well done! Indigo is missing.

cultureNote.en: British children remember rainbow colours with "Richard Of York Gave Battle In Vain" — ROYGBIV.
cultureNote.fa: جمله‌ای برای حفظ رنگ‌های رنگین‌کمان.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Seven! Brrr. I'm cold now. My socks are wet inside my wellies.

translations.fa: هفت تا! بررر. الان سردمه. جوراب‌هام تو چکمه خیس شدن.

branches.suggestion: Oh no! Let's go home.
Did water go in your wellies?

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Yes! I jumped too high! Silly me! Let's go home for a warm bath and hot chocolate!

translations.fa: آره! خیلی بالا پریدم! چه خنگم! بیا بریم خونه یه حموم گرم و هات چاکلت!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Home at last! My legs are tired. That was a long walk! Did you enjoy it?

translations.fa: بالاخره خونه! پاهام خسته‌ان. پیاده‌روی طولانی‌ای بود! خوش گذشت؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I loved it!
Yes, but my feet hurt.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Tom! We're back! Tom wants to know about our walk. What did we do?

translations.fa: تام! برگشتیم! تام می‌خواد دربارهٔ پیاده‌رویمون بدونه. چی کار کردیم؟

branches.suggestion: We went to the park.
We walked by the canal.

recasts.echo: You went to the park? Lovely!

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: The canal? Lovely. What did you see?

translations.fa: کانال؟ عالی. چی دیدید؟

branches.suggestion: We saw lots of boats.
We saw a heron!

cultureNote.en: London's canals have colourful "narrowboats" where some people live all year round.
cultureNote.fa: در قایق‌های کانال‌های لندن مردم زندگی می‌کنند.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Narrowboats! People live on them. I always wanted one. Did Nicola behave?

translations.fa: قایق‌های باریک! مردم توشون زندگی می‌کنن. همیشه یکی می‌خواستم. نیکولا خوب رفتار کرد؟

branches.suggestion: She was very good.
She jumped in every puddle!

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Ha! Typical. Did you stop for a drink?

translations.fa: ها! معمولی. برای نوشیدنی وایستادید؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, we had a coffee at the café.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، تو کافه یه قهوه خوردیم.

branches.suggestion: We had ice cream.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: In October! Nicola wanted ice cream. It was freezing! How was your day, Tom?

translations.fa: تو اکتبر! نیکولا بستنی خواست. یخ‌بندون بود! روزت چطور بود تام؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, how was your day?
Did you work today, Tom?

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Quiet. I drove the 38 all morning. Then I made soup for everyone! Leek and potato.

translations.fa: آروم. کل صبح ۳۸ را روندم. بعد برای همه سوپ درست کردم! تره‌فرنگی و سیب‌زمینی.

branches.suggestion: Mmm! That smells good.
Perfect after a long walk!
branches.suggestionFa: بعد از یه پیاده‌روی طولانی عالیه!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Perfect! Boots off, coats on the hooks, and soup on the table. Thank you for a lovely walk!

translations.fa: عالی! چکمه‌ها درآورده، کت‌ها رو آویز، و سوپ رو میز. ممنون بابت یه پیاده‌روی قشنگ!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Oh look, it's Mrs Khan from number fourteen. Have you met her?

translations.fa: آه ببین، خانم خان از پلاک چهارده‌ست. باهاش آشنا شدی؟

branches.suggestion: No, not yet.
Yes, I met her last week.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Mrs Khan, this is our friend. They live next door to us.

translations.fa: خانم خان، این دوستمونه. بغل خونهٔ ما زندگی می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: Hello, Mrs Khan.
Good morning!

n3.speaker: khan
n3.text: Hello! Nice to meet you. Welcome to Mare Street!

translations.fa: سلام! از آشنایی‌تون خوشبختم. به خیابون مِر خوش اومدید!

branches.suggestion: Nice to meet you too, Mrs Khan.
branches.suggestionFa: منم از آشنایی‌تون خوشبختم خانم خان.

branches.suggestion: Hello! Please call me {you}.

cultureNote.en: Older British people may prefer "Mrs Khan" until they say "Call me Amina". It's polite to wait.
cultureNote.fa: صبر کنید تا اجازهٔ نام کوچک بدهند.

n4.speaker: khan
n4.text: And please call me Amina. Where are you from?

translations.fa: و لطفاً منو آمینا صدا کنید. اهل کجایید؟

branches.suggestion: I'm Iranian.
I'm from Tehran, in Iran.

recasts.echo: From Iran? How lovely!

n5.speaker: khan
n5.text: Tehran! My husband went there for work, years ago. He loved the food! How long have you been here?

translations.fa: تهران! شوهرم سال‌ها پیش برای کار رفت اونجا. عاشق غذاش شد! چند وقته اینجایید؟

branches.suggestion: Just three months.
Not long. Since the summer.

n6.speaker: khan
n6.text: Only three months! And how do you like London?

translations.fa: فقط سه ماه! لندن را چطور دوست دارید؟

branches.suggestion: I like it, but it's very expensive!
I love it. Everyone is very friendly.

n7.speaker: khan
n7.text: Ha! Very expensive, yes. Do you need anything? I've lived here for thirty years.

translations.fa: ها! خیلی گرون، آره. چیزی لازم دارید؟ سی ساله اینجا زندگی می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: Where's a good doctor's?
Is there a mosque near here?

n8.speaker: khan
n8.text: The GP on the corner is very good. Dr Okafor. And the mosque is on Hackney Road. Ten minutes' walk.

translations.fa: مطب سر نبش خیلی خوبه. دکتر اوکافور. و مسجد تو خیابون هاکنیه. ده دقیقه پیاده.

branches.suggestion: Thank you. That's really helpful.
Ten minutes? That's close.

cultureNote.en: You need to register with a GP (local doctor's surgery) near your home in the UK.
cultureNote.fa: باید نزد پزشک محل ثبت‌نام کنید.

n9.speaker: khan
n9.text: Any time! Come for tea one day. I'm always in. Number fourteen, the green door.

translations.fa: هر وقت! یه روز برای چای بیاید. همیشه خونه‌ام. پلاک چهارده، در سبز.

branches.suggestion: I'd love to. Thank you, Amina.
Thank you! See you soon.

n10.speaker: leslie
n10.text: You've got a friend for life now! Amina knows everyone and everything on this street.

translations.fa: حالا یه دوست مادام‌العمر داری! آمینا همه کس و همه چیز این خیابون را می‌شناسه.

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Oh, hello! What a surprise. Come in! Is everything OK?

translations.fa: آه، سلام! چه غافلگیری‌ای. بیا تو! همه چی مرتبه؟

branches.suggestion: Sorry to bother you, Tom.
Yes, fine. But I have a small problem.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، خوبه. ولی یه مشکل کوچیک دارم.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: No bother at all! What's the problem?

translations.fa: اصلاً مزاحمتی نیست! مشکل چیه؟

branches.suggestion: I've got no milk for my tea.
Could I borrow some milk, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم یه کم شیر قرض بگیرم، لطفاً؟

cultureNote.en: Borrowing milk or sugar from a neighbour is a classic British friendly gesture.
cultureNote.fa: قرض گرفتن شیر از همسایه رسم دوستانه است.

recasts.echo: Some milk? Of course!
recasts.better: Could I borrow some milk, please?
recasts.betterFa: می‌تونم یه کم شیر قرض بگیرم؟

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Of course! Tea without milk — that's a disaster! How much do you need?

translations.fa: البته! چای بدون شیر — این یه فاجعه‌ست! چقدر لازم داری؟

branches.suggestion: Just a little. For one cup.
branches.suggestionFa: فقط یه کم. برای یه فنجون.

branches.suggestion: Half a pint, maybe?

cultureNote.en: Milk in the UK is still sold in pints (568 ml) — one of the few things not in metric.
cultureNote.fa: شیر هنوز با پاینت فروخته می‌شود.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Take the whole bottle. We've got three. Leslie buys too much!

translations.fa: کل بطری را ببر. سه تا داریم. لزلی زیادی می‌خره!

branches.suggestion: Are you sure?
Thank you so much!

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Definitely. Have you got sugar? Tea bags?

translations.fa: قطعاً. شکر داری؟ چای کیسه‌ای؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I've got tea bags.
I've got some, thanks.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Good. Why didn't you go to the shop? It's open until ten.

translations.fa: خوبه. چرا نرفتی مغازه؟ تا ده بازه.

branches.suggestion: It's raining, and I'm tired.
I didn't know it was open.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Ha! Fair enough. Mr Patel's corner shop never closes. He's like a superhero.

translations.fa: ها! منطقیه. مغازهٔ سر نبش آقای پاتل هیچ‌وقت نمی‌بنده. مثل ابرقهرمانه.

branches.suggestion: I'll buy you milk tomorrow.
Can I give you some money?

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Don't be silly! That's what neighbours are for. You can bring me a biscuit sometime!

translations.fa: مسخره نشو! همسایه برای همینه. یه وقتی یه بیسکویت برام بیار!

branches.suggestion: Deal! Thanks, Tom.
You're very kind.

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Any time, mate. Enjoy your cuppa! And close the gate — Mrs Khan's cat gets out!

translations.fa: هر وقت رفیق. چایت نوش جان! و در حیاط را ببند — گربهٔ خانم خان در میره!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: There's a removal van outside number sixteen! A new family is moving in. Shall we say hello?

translations.fa: یه ماشین اسباب‌کشی جلوی پلاک شونزده‌ست! یه خانوادهٔ جدید دارن میان. بریم سلام کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, let's go.
Should we take something?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Good idea! Some biscuits. People bring food for new neighbours here.

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه! یه کم بیسکویت. اینجا مردم برای همسایه‌های جدید خوراکی می‌برن.

branches.suggestion: In Iran too! We bring sweets.
That's a nice tradition.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Hello! Welcome to the street! I'm Leslie, from number twelve. This is our friend.

translations.fa: سلام! به خیابون خوش اومدید! من لزلی‌ام، از پلاک دوازده. این دوستمونه.

branches.suggestion: Hello! Welcome!
Hi! These biscuits are for you.

n4.speaker: khan
n4.text: Yoo-hoo! Leslie! Is that the new family? Ask them their names!

translations.fa: هوهو! لزلی! این خانوادهٔ جدیده؟ اسمشون را بپرس!

branches.suggestion: Ha! Mrs Khan wants to know everything!
branches.suggestionFa: ها! خانم خان می‌خواد همه چی را بدونه!

branches.suggestion: What are your names?

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Ha! Sorry. That's Mrs Khan. Their names are Femi and Grace. They've got two children.

translations.fa: ها! ببخشید. اون خانم خانه. اسمشون فمی و گریسه. دو تا بچه دارن.

branches.suggestion: How old are the children?
Are they boys or girls?

recasts.echo: How old are they? Let's ask!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: A boy and a girl. Tunde is seven and Ada is five. Ada can play with Nicola!

translations.fa: یه پسر و یه دختر. تونده هفت سالشه و آدا پنج. آدا می‌تونه با نیکولا بازی کنه!

branches.suggestion: That's perfect!
Where did they live before?

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: In Manchester. Femi's got a new job at the hospital. They don't know London at all.

translations.fa: تو منچستر. فمی یه کار جدید تو بیمارستان گرفته. اصلاً لندن را نمی‌شناسن.

branches.suggestion: I'm new here too!
We can show them around.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونیم همه جا را نشونشون بدیم.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Lovely. Do they need help with the boxes?

translations.fa: عالی. برای جعبه‌ها کمک لازم دارن؟

branches.suggestion: Shall we carry some boxes?
I can help. I'm strong!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: They said yes, please! Come on, let's help. Then I'll invite them for tea on Sunday.

translations.fa: گفتن آره، لطفاً! بیا کمک کنیم. بعد یکشنبه برای چای دعوتشون می‌کنم.

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Did you hear? Mr Bailey at number six is moving to the seaside. He's leaving tomorrow.

translations.fa: شنیدی؟ آقای بیلی از پلاک شش داره می‌ره کنار دریا. فردا می‌ره.

branches.suggestion: Oh no! He's very nice.
Where is he going?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: To Brighton. To be near his daughter. Let's go and say goodbye.

translations.fa: به برایتون. که نزدیک دخترش باشه. بیا بریم خداحافظی کنیم.

branches.suggestion: Shall we take a card?
Good idea. Let's go now.

cultureNote.en: Brighton is a lively seaside city on the south coast, about an hour from London by train.
cultureNote.fa: برایتون شهر ساحلی نزدیک لندن است.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Yes, Nicola made a card. Look — a picture of him and his dog. Hello, Mr Bailey!

translations.fa: آره، نیکولا یه کارت درست کرده. ببین — عکس خودش و سگش. سلام آقای بیلی!

branches.suggestion: Hello! We came to say goodbye.
This card is from Nicola.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: He says thank you. He'll put it on his new fridge. He's lived here for forty years!

translations.fa: می‌گه ممنون. می‌ذارتش رو یخچال جدیدش. چهل ساله اینجا زندگی کرده!

branches.suggestion: Forty years! That's a long time.
You'll miss him.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: We will. He always gave Ryan sweets. Ask him about his new home.

translations.fa: تنگ میشه. همیشه به رایان شکلات می‌داد. ازش دربارهٔ خونهٔ جدیدش بپرس.

branches.suggestion: Is your new house near the sea?
Are you excited about Brighton?

cultureNote.en: British "sweets", American "candy".
cultureNote.fa: sweets/candy.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: He can see the sea from his bedroom! And he's going to swim every morning. At eighty!

translations.fa: از اتاق خوابش دریا را می‌بینه! و قراره هر روز صبح شنا کنه. تو هشتاد سالگی!

branches.suggestion: Amazing!
Good for him!

recasts.echo: He's going to swim every morning? Brilliant!
recasts.better: He's going to swim every morning.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Right. Let's say goodbye. What do you say to someone who's leaving?

translations.fa: خب. بیا خداحافظی کنیم. به کسی که داره می‌ره چی می‌گی؟

branches.suggestion: Take care, Mr Bailey! Keep in touch!
branches.suggestionFa: مراقب خودتون باشید آقای بیلی! در تماس باشیم!

branches.suggestion: Good luck in Brighton!

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Perfect. He says, "Come and visit! Bring a bucket and spade!" The street won't be the same.

translations.fa: عالی. می‌گه «بیاید دیدنم! سطل و بیلچه بیارید!» خیابون دیگه مثل قبل نمی‌شه.

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: The phone's ringing! My hands are wet. Can you answer it, please?

translations.fa: تلفن داره زنگ می‌زنه! دستام خیسه. می‌تونی جواب بدی، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Hello, who's calling?
Good morning, the Thompsons' house.

cultureNote.en: Some British families answer the home phone with their number or "Hello, the Thompsons'".
cultureNote.fa: گاهی با شماره یا نام خانواده جواب می‌دهند.

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: Hello, love. It's Maggie. Who's speaking?

translations.fa: الو عزیزم. مگی‌ام. شما؟

branches.suggestion: Hi, Maggie! It's {you}.
Hello, Maggie. This is {you} speaking.

cultureNote.en: On the phone, English speakers say "It's Tom" or "This is Tom", not "I am Tom".
cultureNote.fa: پشت تلفن می‌گویند It's Tom.

recasts.echo: It's you? Hello, love!

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: Oh, hello, dear! Is Tom there?

translations.fa: آه، سلام عزیزم! تام اونجاست؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, he's here. One moment, please.
He's busy. His hands are wet!

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Never mind. Can you give him a message?

translations.fa: عیب نداره. می‌تونی یه پیغام بهش بدی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. What's the message?
Yes. Let me get a pen.

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: I can't come on Thursday. George has a hospital appointment.

translations.fa: پنجشنبه نمی‌تونم بیام. جورج وقت بیمارستان داره.

branches.suggestion: Not Thursday. OK.
Is George OK?

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: Yes, just a check-up. His heart. Can I come on Friday instead?

translations.fa: آره، فقط معاینه‌ست. قلبش. می‌تونم به جاش جمعه بیام؟

branches.suggestion: I'll ask Tom.
Friday instead. I'm writing it down.

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: Thank you, love. Tell him to call me back after six.

translations.fa: ممنون عزیزم. بهش بگو بعد از شش بهم زنگ بزنه.

branches.suggestion: Call you back after six. Got it.
branches.suggestionFa: بعد از شش بهتون زنگ بزنه. فهمیدم.

branches.suggestion: OK. Does he have your number?

n8.speaker: weda
n8.text: Of course he has! Thank you, dear. Bye-bye!

translations.fa: البته که داره! ممنون عزیزم. خداحافظ!

branches.suggestion: Bye, Maggie! Take care!
Bye-bye! Love to George.

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Who was that? Mum? What did she say? Ah, Thursday — Dad's heart check. Thanks for taking the message, mate.

translations.fa: کی بود؟ مامان؟ چی گفت؟ آه، پنجشنبه — معاینهٔ قلب بابا. ممنون که پیغام را گرفتی رفیق.

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Can you ring the surgery for me? I'm driving. Ask to speak to the nurse about William's injections.

translations.fa: می‌تونی برام به مطب زنگ بزنی؟ دارم رانندگی می‌کنم. بخواه با پرستار دربارهٔ واکسن‌های ویلیام صحبت کنی.

branches.suggestion: OK. What's the number?
Sure. Is the number on the fridge?

cultureNote.en: In Britain, a "surgery" is a doctor's office, not only an operation.
cultureNote.fa: surgery یعنی مطب هم.

n2.speaker: receptionist
n2.text: Good morning, Mare Street Surgery. Tracy speaking. How can I help?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر، مطب مِر استریت. تریسی هستم. چطور کمک کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Good morning. Can I speak to the nurse, please?
branches.suggestionFa: صبح بخیر. می‌تونم با پرستار صحبت کنم، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Hello. I'm calling about William Thompson.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام. دربارهٔ ویلیام تامپسون زنگ می‌زنم.

recasts.echo: The nurse? Of course.
recasts.better: Can I speak to the nurse, please?

n3.speaker: receptionist
n3.text: I'm sorry, the nurse is busy at the moment. Can I take a message?

translations.fa: متأسفم، پرستار الان مشغوله. می‌تونم پیغام بگیرم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. It's about William's injections.
When is she free?

n4.speaker: receptionist
n4.text: How old is William? And what's his date of birth?

translations.fa: ویلیام چند سالشه؟ و تاریخ تولدش چیه؟

branches.suggestion: He's three. Let me ask his mum.
branches.suggestionFa: سه سالشه. بذار از مامانش بپرسم.

branches.suggestion: He's three years old. His mum is here.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Tell her the fifth of March! Three years ago!

translations.fa: بهش بگو پنجم مارس! سه سال پیش!

branches.suggestion: The fifth of March, three years ago.
His birthday is the fifth of March.

n6.speaker: receptionist
n6.text: Thank you. William needs his pre-school jabs. I can book an appointment for you.

translations.fa: ممنون. ویلیام واکسن‌های قبل از مدرسه‌اش را لازم داره. می‌تونم براتون وقت بگیرم.

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. When?
What are jabs?

cultureNote.en: Brits often say "jabs" for vaccinations. UK children have free vaccinations on the NHS.
cultureNote.fa: jab یعنی واکسن.

n7.speaker: receptionist
n7.text: Next Tuesday at half past ten, with Nurse Adeyemi. Is that OK?

translations.fa: سه‌شنبهٔ بعد ساعت ده و نیم، با پرستار آدِیمی. خوبه؟

branches.suggestion: Tuesday at ten thirty. Is that OK, Leslie?
branches.suggestionFa: سه‌شنبه ده و نیم. خوبه لزلی؟

branches.suggestion: Can you repeat the time, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه ساعت را تکرار کنید، لطفاً؟

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Perfect! Say thank you!

translations.fa: عالی! بگو ممنون!

branches.suggestion: That's fine. Thank you very much.
Thank you, Tracy. Goodbye!

n9.speaker: receptionist
n9.text: You're welcome. We'll send a text to remind you. Bye now!

translations.fa: خواهش می‌کنم. یه پیامک یادآوری می‌فرستیم. خداحافظ!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: My phone's ringing, but I don't know this number. Can you answer it? I'm scared it's school!

translations.fa: گوشیم داره زنگ می‌زنه، ولی این شماره را نمی‌شناسم. جواب میدی؟ می‌ترسم مدرسه باشه!

branches.suggestion: Hello? Ryan's phone.
Ha! OK. Give it to me.

n2.speaker: courier
n2.text: Hello, is that Mrs Patterson? I've got a parcel for you.

translations.fa: الو، خانم پترسون؟ یه بسته براتون دارم.

branches.suggestion: Sorry, there's no Mrs Patterson here.
I think you've got the wrong number.

recasts.echo: The wrong number? Oh, sorry!
recasts.better: I think you've got the wrong number.

branches.suggestion: No. The last numbers are different.

cultureNote.en: British mobile numbers start with 07 and have eleven digits.
cultureNote.fa: شماره موبایل بریتانیا با ۰۷ شروع می‌شود.

n4.speaker: courier
n4.text: Sorry, mate! I mixed up the numbers. Five and six!

translations.fa: ببخشید رفیق! شماره‌ها را قاطی کردم. پنج و شش!

branches.suggestion: No problem! It happens.
That's OK. Good luck with the parcel!
branches.suggestionFa: اشکال نداره. با بسته موفق باشی!

n5.speaker: courier
n5.text: Cheers! Have a good day. Bye!

translations.fa: ممنون! روز خوبی داشته باشی. خداحافظ!

branches.suggestion: Cheers, bye!
You too, mate.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Who was it? Not school? Phew!

translations.fa: کی بود؟ مدرسه نبود؟ وای خدا را شکر!

branches.suggestion: No, it was a delivery driver. Wrong number!
branches.suggestionFa: نه، یه رانندهٔ پیک بود. اشتباه گرفته بود!

branches.suggestion: It was for Mrs Patterson.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Ha! Mrs Patterson. Lucky her, a parcel. Why are you scared of school calls? I'm not!

translations.fa: ها! خانم پترسون. خوش به حالش، بسته. چرا از تماس مدرسه می‌ترسی؟ من که نمی‌ترسم!

branches.suggestion: You said you were scared!
Did you do something wrong, Ryan?

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Me? Never! Well… I forgot my PE kit. Again. Just don't answer if it's school, OK?

translations.fa: من؟ هرگز! خب… لباس ورزشم را یادم رفت. دوباره. فقط اگه مدرسه بود جواب نده، باشه؟

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: The plumber isn't answering. It's the voicemail. Can you leave a message? I talk too fast!

translations.fa: لوله‌کش جواب نمی‌ده. پیغام‌گیره. تو پیغام می‌ذاری؟ من خیلی تند حرف می‌زنم!

branches.suggestion: Ha! You don't talk too fast, Leslie!
branches.suggestionFa: ها! تو تند حرف نمی‌زنی لزلی!

branches.suggestion: OK. What do I say?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Say your name, the problem and my phone number. Slowly! Here — after the beep.

translations.fa: اسمت، مشکل و شماره‌ام را بگو. آروم! بیا — بعد از بوق.

branches.suggestion: Hello, this is a message for the plumber.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام، این یه پیغام برای لوله‌کشه.

branches.suggestion: Hello. My name is {you}. I'm calling for Leslie Thompson.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام. اسمم {you} است. از طرف لزلی تامپسون زنگ می‌زنم.

cultureNote.en: When leaving a voicemail, say who you are, why you're calling and your number — twice.
cultureNote.fa: در پیغام صوتی نام، دلیل و شماره را بگویید.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Good! Now the problem. The kitchen tap is leaking.

translations.fa: خوبه! حالا مشکل. شیر آشپزخونه چکه می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: The kitchen tap is leaking.
There's water everywhere under the sink.

recasts.echo: The tap is leaking? Right.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Now the number. Oh seven seven double oh, nine double oh, one two three.

translations.fa: حالا شماره. صفر هفت هفت دو تا صفر، نه دو تا صفر، یک دو سه.

branches.suggestion: Can you say it again, please?
Oh seven seven double oh, nine double oh, one two three.
branches.suggestionFa: صفر هفت هفت دو صفر، نه دو صفر، یک دو سه.

cultureNote.en: In phone numbers, Brits often say "oh" for 0 and "double" for two of the same: "double oh".
cultureNote.fa: oh یعنی صفر و double یعنی دوتا.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Perfect! Say it again, slowly. And ask him to call back today.

translations.fa: عالی! دوباره آروم بگو. و ازش بخواه امروز دوباره زنگ بزنه.

branches.suggestion: Please call back today. Thank you!
branches.suggestionFa: لطفاً امروز دوباره زنگ بزنید. ممنون!

branches.suggestion: Could you call us back today, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه لطفاً امروز بهمون زنگ بزنید؟

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Lovely. And say goodbye. Then press the red button.

translations.fa: عالی. و خداحافظی کن. بعد دکمهٔ قرمز را بزن.

branches.suggestion: Thanks. Bye!
Goodbye. Have a nice day!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Brilliant! You sounded very professional. Better than me!

translations.fa: عالی! خیلی حرفه‌ای به نظر رسیدی. بهتر از من!

branches.suggestion: Thank you! I was nervous.
I practised my numbers!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Oh! My phone's ringing already. It's him! The plumber. You see? A good message works!

translations.fa: آه! گوشیم از الان داره زنگ می‌زنه. خودشه! لوله‌کش. دیدی؟ یه پیغام خوب جواب می‌ده!

n1.speaker: callum
n1.text: Morning! What can I get you?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر! چی براتون بیارم؟

branches.suggestion: Can I have a hot chocolate, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه یه هات چاکلت بدید، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: What hot drinks have you got?

n2.speaker: callum
n2.text: Sure. Small, medium or large?

translations.fa: حتماً. کوچیک، متوسط یا بزرگ؟

branches.suggestion: Medium, please.
What size is the small?

n3.speaker: callum
n3.text: Medium. With cream and marshmallows?

translations.fa: متوسط. با خامه و مارشمالو؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please! Both!
Just cream, thanks.

recasts.echo: Both? Lovely!

n4.speaker: callum
n4.text: Great choice. Which milk would you like? We've got normal, oat or soya.

translations.fa: انتخاب عالیه. چه شیری؟ معمولی، جو دوسر یا سویا داریم.

branches.suggestion: Normal milk is fine.
Oat milk, please.

cultureNote.en: British "soya", American "soy". Plant milks are very common in UK cafés.
cultureNote.fa: soya/soy.

n5.speaker: callum
n5.text: Anything to eat? The flapjacks are fresh this morning.

translations.fa: چیزی برای خوردن؟ فلپ‌جک‌ها امروز صبح تازه‌ان.

branches.suggestion: What's a flapjack?
No, thank you. Just the drink.

cultureNote.en: A British flapjack is an oat bar with golden syrup; an American "flapjack" is a pancake!
cultureNote.fa: flapjack بریتانیایی با آمریکایی فرق دارد.

n6.speaker: callum
n6.text: It's an oat bar with butter and syrup. Very sweet. Try one!

translations.fa: یه تیکه شیرینی جو دوسره با کره و شیره. خیلی شیرینه. یکی امتحان کن!

branches.suggestion: OK, I'll have a flapjack too.
It sounds too sweet for me.

n7.speaker: callum
n7.text: Eat in or take away?

translations.fa: اینجا میل می‌کنید یا می‌برید؟

branches.suggestion: Eat in, please.
To take away, please.

cultureNote.en: British "take away" = American "to go".
cultureNote.fa: take away/to go.

n8.speaker: callum
n8.text: Lovely. That's four pounds sixty. Card or cash?

translations.fa: عالی. چهار پوند و شصت میشه. کارت یا نقد؟

branches.suggestion: Card, please.
Cash. Here's a fiver.

n9.speaker: callum
n9.text: Perfect, here's your change. I'll bring it over to your table. Find a seat anywhere!

translations.fa: عالی، اینم بقیهٔ پولتون. میارمش سر میزتون. هر جا خواستید بشینید!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Phew! I need a coffee before the school run. Shall I get you something?

translations.fa: وای! قبل از بردن بچه‌ها به مدرسه یه قهوه لازم دارم. برات چیزی بگیرم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. A tea.
Let me pay today.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: No, no. You paid last time. What kind of tea? They've got lots.

translations.fa: نه، نه. دفعهٔ قبل تو حساب کردی. چه نوع چایی؟ کلی دارن.

branches.suggestion: Just a normal tea, please.
Have they got mint tea?

n3.speaker: callum
n3.text: Hi, Leslie! The usual? A flat white?

translations.fa: سلام لزلی! همیشگی؟ یه فلت وایت؟

branches.suggestion: What's a flat white?
She always has the same!

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Yes, please, Callum. And a mint tea for my friend. To take away.

translations.fa: آره، لطفاً کالوم. و یه چای نعناع برای دوستم. برای بیرون.

branches.suggestion: Thanks, Leslie.
Can I have a lid, please?

n5.speaker: callum
n5.text: Coming up. Do you want a cup holder? Two hot drinks are tricky!

translations.fa: الان میارم. جالیوانی می‌خواید؟ دو تا نوشیدنی داغ سخته!

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. That's helpful.
No thanks, I can carry them.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Oh, have you got a reusable cup? You get a discount!

translations.fa: آه، لیوان چندبارمصرف داری؟ تخفیف می‌گیری!

branches.suggestion: No. I forgot it.
Yes! It's in my bag.

cultureNote.en: Many UK cafés give a small discount if you bring your own reusable cup.
cultureNote.fa: با لیوان شخصی تخفیف می‌دهند.

n7.speaker: callum
n7.text: Here you go. Careful, they're hot! That's six pounds ten, please.

translations.fa: بفرمایید. مواظب باشید، داغن! شش پوند و ده میشه، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Shall I hold the drinks?
Let me get the door for you.
branches.suggestionFa: بذار در را برات باز کنم.

recasts.echo: Shall you hold them? Yes please!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Thank you! You're a star. Bye, Callum!

translations.fa: ممنون! ستاره‌ای. خداحافظ کالوم!

branches.suggestion: Bye! Thanks for the tea.
See you soon, Callum!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: Right. Ten minutes to school. Let's walk fast — and don't spill the tea!

translations.fa: خب. ده دقیقه تا مدرسه. تند راه بریم — و چای را نریز!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Look at all the cakes! Mummy said I can choose one. Which one should I have?

translations.fa: این همه کیک را ببین! مامان گفت می‌تونم یکی انتخاب کنم. کدوم را بخورم؟

branches.suggestion: Which one do you like?
That chocolate one looks nice.
branches.suggestionFa: اون شکلاتیه خوب به نظر میاد.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: The chocolate one or the pink one? I like both!

translations.fa: شکلاتیه یا صورتیه؟ هر دو را دوست دارم!

branches.suggestion: What's the pink one?
Choose this one or that one.
branches.suggestionFa: این یا اون را انتخاب کن.

n3.speaker: baker
n3.text: The pink one is a Battenberg cake. It's got squares inside. Pink and yellow!

translations.fa: صورتیه کیک بتنبرگه. داخلش مربع داره. صورتی و زرد!

branches.suggestion: Squares inside a cake?
That sounds fun, Nicola!

cultureNote.en: Battenberg is a classic British cake with a pink and yellow chequered pattern, wrapped in marzipan.
cultureNote.fa: بتنبرگ کیک شطرنجی بریتانیایی است.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Squares! I want the Battenberg! No, wait… the chocolate! Hmm.

translations.fa: مربع! بتنبرگ می‌خوام! نه، صبر کن… شکلاتی! هوم.

branches.suggestion: Take your time.
You can share with me!

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Share? Yes! You have the chocolate, I have the Battenberg. Then we swap halves!

translations.fa: شریک؟ آره! تو شکلاتی را بگیر، من بتنبرگ. بعد نصف‌ها را عوض می‌کنیم!

branches.suggestion: Good idea!
You're very clever!

n6.speaker: baker
n6.text: Smart girl! One chocolate cake and one Battenberg. Anything to drink?

translations.fa: دختر باهوش! یه کیک شکلاتی و یه بتنبرگ. نوشیدنی چیزی؟

branches.suggestion: A glass of milk for Nicola.
An orange juice, please.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Can I carry the tray? Please! I'm careful!

translations.fa: می‌تونم سینی را بیارم؟ لطفاً! حواسم هست!

branches.suggestion: Use two hands, then.
I'll carry the drinks. You carry the cakes.
branches.suggestionFa: من نوشیدنی‌ها را میارم. تو کیک‌ها را بیار.

match: you carry cakes and i drinks
recasts.echo: You'll carry the drinks? Teamwork!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Teamwork! Mmm… the Battenberg is yummy! The pink squares are the best.

translations.fa: کار گروهی! ممم… بتنبرگ خوشمزه‌ست! مربع‌های صورتی بهترینن.

branches.suggestion: Is it time to swap?
Can I try a bit?

n9.speaker: nicola
n9.text: Here's half! Oh, I ate the pink squares. You can have the yellow ones! Sorry! Ha ha!

translations.fa: بیا نصفش! آه، مربع‌های صورتی را خوردم. تو زردها را بخور! ببخشید! ها ها!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: That was a lovely lunch. Shall we ask for the bill?

translations.fa: ناهار قشنگی بود. صورت‌حساب را بخوایم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. Excuse me!
Let me ask the waitress.

cultureNote.en: British "the bill", American "the check".
cultureNote.fa: bill/check.

n2.speaker: sophie
n2.text: Was everything OK for you today?

translations.fa: امروز همه چیز خوب بود؟

branches.suggestion: It was delicious, thank you.
Yes, lovely. Can we have the bill, please?
branches.suggestionFa: آره، عالی. می‌شه صورت‌حساب را بیارید، لطفاً؟

recasts.echo: The bill? Of course.
recasts.better: Can we have the bill, please?

n3.speaker: sophie
n3.text: Of course. Here you are. It's thirty-two pounds altogether.

translations.fa: البته. بفرمایید. جمعاً سی و دو پونده.

branches.suggestion: Shall we split it?
I'll pay this time.

cultureNote.en: "Going Dutch" or "splitting the bill" is very common among British friends.
cultureNote.fa: تقسیم صورت‌حساب بین دوستان رایج است.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Let's split it. Sixteen pounds each. Is service included?

translations.fa: بیا نصفش کنیم. نفری شونزده پوند. سرویس حساب شده؟

branches.suggestion: Let me look… No, it isn't.
What does "service included" mean?

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: It means a tip. In restaurants we usually leave ten percent.

translations.fa: یعنی انعام. تو رستوران معمولاً ده درصد می‌ذاریم.

branches.suggestion: So about three pounds?
In Iran we leave a tip too.

cultureNote.en: Tipping about 10–12.5% is normal in UK restaurants, but not usual in pubs or cafés at the counter.
cultureNote.fa: انعام ۱۰ تا ۱۲.۵ درصد در رستوران.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Yes, about three. So eighteen each, with the tip. Can we pay by card?

translations.fa: آره، حدود سه. پس با انعام نفری هجده. می‌شه با کارت حساب کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Can we pay separately, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه جدا جدا حساب کنیم، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Two cards, please. Eighteen pounds each.
branches.suggestionFa: دو تا کارت، لطفاً. هر کدوم هجده پوند.

n7.speaker: sophie
n7.text: No problem. Here's the card machine. Tap whenever you're ready.

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست. اینم کارت‌خوان. هر وقت آماده بودید کارت بکشید.

branches.suggestion: Thank you. Done.
It says "approved".

n8.speaker: sophie
n8.text: Lovely. Thank you both, and have a great afternoon!

translations.fa: عالی. از هر دوتون ممنون، و بعدازظهر خوبی داشته باشید!

branches.suggestion: Thank you! You too.
We'll come back soon!

n9.speaker: leslie
n9.text: That was fun. Next time, let's try the Turkish place on the high street. My treat!

translations.fa: خوش گذشت. دفعهٔ بعد، بیا رستوران ترکی خیابون اصلی را امتحان کنیم. مهمون من!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Mummy says I'm in charge of the table tonight! Will you help me?

translations.fa: مامان میگه امشب مسئول میز منم! کمکم می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course! What do we need?
Yes. Where are the plates?

cultureNote.en: British "lay the table", American "set the table".
cultureNote.fa: lay/set the table.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Plates, knives, forks and spoons. The plates are in the cupboard. I can't reach!

translations.fa: بشقاب، چاقو، چنگال و قاشق. بشقاب‌ها تو کابینتن. دستم نمی‌رسه!

branches.suggestion: I'll get the plates for you.
Stand on the step, but be careful.
branches.suggestionFa: روی چارپایه بایست، ولی مواظب باش.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Thank you! How many plates? Mummy, Daddy, Ryan, me, you… and Nana!

translations.fa: ممنون! چند تا بشقاب؟ مامان، بابا، رایان، من، تو… و نانا!

branches.suggestion: That's six plates.
What about William?

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: William has his special bowl! It's got a duck on it. It goes next to Mummy.

translations.fa: ویلیام کاسهٔ مخصوص خودش را داره! روش یه اردکه. کنار مامان میره.

branches.suggestion: Where does the fork go?
The duck bowl is very cute.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: The fork goes on the left. The knife goes on the right. Mrs Ellis taught us!

translations.fa: چنگال سمت چپ میره. چاقو سمت راست. خانم الیس یادمون داد!

branches.suggestion: Well done, Mrs Ellis!
Left and right. I'll remember.

recasts.echo: The fork goes on the left? Yes!
recasts.better: The fork goes on the left.

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Now the glasses. Can you pour the water? The jug is too heavy for me.

translations.fa: حالا لیوان‌ها. می‌تونی آب بریزی؟ پارچ برام خیلی سنگینه.

branches.suggestion: Yes, I'll pour the water.
Hold it with two hands. Let's do it together.
branches.suggestionFa: با دو تا دست بگیرش. با هم انجامش بدیم.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: And napkins! I folded them like triangles. Do you like them?

translations.fa: و دستمال سفره! مثل مثلث تاشون کردم. دوستشون داری؟

branches.suggestion: They're beautiful triangles!
You're a great helper.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: MUMMY! The table's ready! Tea time! Everybody sit down!

translations.fa: مامان! میز آماده‌ست! وقت شامه! همه بشینید!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Ugh. Mum says it's my turn to wash up. There are so many pans!

translations.fa: اوف. مامان میگه نوبت منه ظرف بشورم. این همه قابلمه!

branches.suggestion: I can help you.
Whose turn is it tomorrow?

cultureNote.en: British "wash up" / "do the washing-up" = American "do the dishes".
cultureNote.fa: washing-up/dishes.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Cheers, mate. Tomorrow it's Dad's turn. Do you want to wash or dry?

translations.fa: دمت گرم رفیق. فردا نوبت باباست. می‌خوای بشوری یا خشک کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I'll wash. You dry.
I'll dry the plates.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Great. Here's the tea towel. The plates go in that cupboard.

translations.fa: عالی. اینم حوله آشپزخانه. بشقاب‌ها تو اون کابینت میرن.

branches.suggestion: What's a tea towel?
OK. Pass me the first plate.

cultureNote.en: A "tea towel" is a cloth for drying dishes; Americans say "dish towel".
cultureNote.fa: tea towel/dish towel.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: It's just this cloth. Why don't we use the dishwasher? Because it's broken. Again!

translations.fa: فقط همین پارچه‌ست. چرا از ماشین ظرفشویی استفاده نمی‌کنیم؟ چون خرابه. دوباره!

branches.suggestion: When is the repair man coming?
Washing by hand is fine.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Next week, Mum says. Can you pass the washing-up liquid? It's by the sink.

translations.fa: مامان میگه هفتهٔ بعد. می‌تونی مایع ظرفشویی را بدی؟ کنار سینکه.

branches.suggestion: Here you are.
This green bottle?

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Yep, that one. Ugh, this pan is so dirty. Dad burnt the beans again!

translations.fa: آره، همون. اوف، این قابلمه خیلی کثیفه. بابا دوباره لوبیاها را سوزوند!

branches.suggestion: Leave it to soak.
Use the scrubber on it.

recasts.echo: Leave it to soak? Good idea.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Good shout. I'll leave it in hot water till morning. Dad's problem now! Ha!

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. تا صبح تو آب داغ می‌ذارمش. حالا مشکل باباست! ها!

branches.suggestion: Ha! Poor Tom.
That's a bit naughty, Ryan.

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Done! That was quick with two of us. Thanks, {you}. I owe you one.

translations.fa: تموم شد! با دو نفر سریع بود. ممنون {you}. یکی طلبت.

branches.suggestion: No problem. Any time.
You can help me next time!

n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Deal. Fancy a game of FIFA now? I'll go easy on you. Maybe.

translations.fa: قبول. حالا یه دست فیفا پایه‌ای؟ باهات راه میام. شاید.

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Right, it's William's teatime. Leslie's at a meeting. Can you give me a hand?

translations.fa: خب، وقت شام ویلیامه. لزلی جلسه‌ست. یه دستی بهم میدی؟

branches.suggestion: Sure. What do I do?
Yes. Is he hungry?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: He's always hungry! First, put his bib on. The one with the bus on it. Ha!

translations.fa: همیشه گرسنه‌ست! اول، پیش‌بندش را ببند. اونی که روش اتوبوسه. ها!

branches.suggestion: A bus bib! Of course.
Where's the bib?

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: In the drawer by the fridge. Then put him on his booster seat. Careful with his legs.

translations.fa: تو کشوی کنار یخچال. بعد بذارش رو صندلی بلندکنندهٔ بچه. مواظب پاهاش باش.

branches.suggestion: OK, he's in.
He's wriggling a lot!

n4.speaker: william
n4.text: I'm hungry! Where's my dinner?

translations.fa: گرسنمه! شامم کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: He wants his food!
Patience, William!

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Here's his dinner. Mashed carrot and potato. Then test it. Not too hot!

translations.fa: اینم شامش. پورهٔ هویج و سیب‌زمینی. بعد امتحانش کن. خیلی داغ نباشه!

branches.suggestion: It's warm, not hot.
How do I test it?

recasts.echo: Not too hot? Good.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Good. Now small spoonfuls. Open wide, William! Here comes the bus! Brrrm!

translations.fa: خوبه. حالا قاشق‌های کوچیک. دهنت را باز کن ویلیام! اتوبوس داره میاد! بررم!

branches.suggestion: Here comes the number 38!
He loves it!

n7.speaker: william
n7.text: Here comes the bus! Yum!

translations.fa: اتوبوس داره میاد! به‌به!

branches.suggestion: He loves the bus game!
More carrot, William?

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: He loves buses! Like his dad! Right, then a wipe. His face is orange!

translations.fa: عاشق اتوبوسه! مثل باباش! خب، بعد پاک کردن. صورتش نارنجیه!

branches.suggestion: I'll get a wipe.
He's an orange boy!

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Brilliant job. You're a natural! Wait till Leslie sees his clean plate!

translations.fa: کارت عالی بود. ذاتی بلدی! صبر کن لزلی بشقاب تمیزش را ببینه!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: {you}, we're going to Cornwall for a week. Could you water our plants?

translations.fa: {you}، یه هفته میریم کورنوال. می‌تونی به گلدون‌هامون آب بدی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. How often?
Yes, no problem. Which plants?

cultureNote.en: Cornwall in south-west England is a very popular family holiday place.
cultureNote.fa: کورنوال مقصد محبوب تعطیلات.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Thank you! These ones on the windowsill. Every two days is fine.

translations.fa: ممنون! اینایی که لب پنجره‌ان. هر دو روز یه بار خوبه.

branches.suggestion: Every two days. OK.
How much water do they need?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Just a little. Half a cup each. The cactus doesn't need any. Don't water it!

translations.fa: فقط یه کم. هر کدوم نصف لیوان. کاکتوس اصلاً لازم نداره. بهش آب نده!

branches.suggestion: No water for the cactus.
Why doesn't the cactus need water?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: It's from the desert! Would you mind feeding Goldie too? Nicola's goldfish.

translations.fa: از بیابونه! زحمت غذا دادن به گلدی را هم می‌کشی؟ ماهی قرمز نیکولا.

branches.suggestion: I don't mind at all.
How much food does Goldie eat?

cultureNote.en: Answer "Would you mind…?" with "Not at all" or "No problem" — "Yes" means you DO mind!
cultureNote.fa: جواب منفی یعنی موافقت.

recasts.echo: Not at all? Wonderful!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Just a pinch, once a day. Not more! Nicola will cry if Goldie gets fat.

translations.fa: فقط یه ذره، روزی یه بار. نه بیشتر! اگه گلدی چاق بشه نیکولا گریه می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: A pinch once a day. Got it.
branches.suggestionFa: یه ذره روزی یه بار. فهمیدم.

branches.suggestion: I'll send Nicola a photo of Goldie!
branches.suggestionFa: یه عکس از گلدی برای نیکولا می‌فرستم!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: She'll love that! Here's the spare key. Could you put the bins out on Tuesday too?

translations.fa: عاشقش میشه! اینم کلید یدک. می‌شه سه‌شنبه سطل‌ها را هم بذاری بیرون؟

branches.suggestion: Which bin is it this week?
Sure. I'll put mine out at the same time.
branches.suggestionFa: حتماً. مال خودم را هم همون موقع می‌ذارم.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: The green one, recycling. You're an angel. I'll bring you some fudge from Cornwall!

translations.fa: سبزه، بازیافت. فرشته‌ای. از کورنوال برات فاج میارم!

branches.suggestion: Fudge? Yes, please!
Have a lovely holiday!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Thanks, love. And if there's a problem, Mrs Khan at number fourteen has our number too.

translations.fa: ممنون عزیزم. و اگه مشکلی بود، خانم خان پلاک چهارده هم شماره‌مون را داره.

n1.speaker: ellis
n1.text: Hello! You must be Nicola's neighbour. Welcome to Reception! Would you like a quick look round?

translations.fa: سلام! باید همسایهٔ نیکولا باشید. به کلاس آمادگی خوش اومدید! می‌خواید یه نگاه سریع بندازید؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Thank you.
Is Nicola here today?

cultureNote.en: "Reception" is the first year of primary school in England, for children aged 4–5.
cultureNote.fa: Reception اولین سال دبستان.

n2.speaker: ellis
n2.text: She's outside with the others. This is our classroom. There are twenty-eight children.

translations.fa: با بقیه بیرونه. این کلاس ماست. بیست و هشت تا بچه هستن.

branches.suggestion: Twenty-eight! That's a lot.
Is there a teaching assistant?

n3.speaker: ellis
n3.text: Yes, Mr Shah helps me every morning. There's a reading corner over there, with cushions.

translations.fa: آره، آقای شاه هر صبح کمکم می‌کنه. اون طرف یه گوشهٔ کتابخونی هست، با کوسن.

branches.suggestion: The cushions look comfy.
Are there lots of books?

n4.speaker: ellis
n4.text: Hundreds! And there's a sand tray, a water table and a dressing-up box.

translations.fa: صدها! و یه سینی شن، یه میز آب‌بازی و یه صندوق لباس نمایش هست.

branches.suggestion: What's a dressing-up box?
There's so much to do here!
branches.suggestionFa: اینجا کلی کار برای انجام دادن هست!

recasts.echo: There are books and there's a sand tray.

n5.speaker: ellis
n5.text: It's full of costumes. Nicola loves the dragon one. She roars at everyone!

translations.fa: پر از لباس‌های نمایشیه. نیکولا عاشق لباس اژدهاست. سر همه غرش می‌کنه!

branches.suggestion: That sounds like Nicola!
Is it scary?

n6.speaker: ellis
n6.text: Only a little! Look, there are the children's coat pegs. Each one has a name and a picture.

translations.fa: فقط یه کم! نگاه کن، اینا جالباسی‌های بچه‌هاست. هر کدوم یه اسم و یه عکس داره.

branches.suggestion: Which one is Nicola's?
That helps them find their coats.
branches.suggestionFa: این کمکشون می‌کنه کتشون را پیدا کنن.

n7.speaker: ellis
n7.text: The one with the teddy bear! She asked for that. Here's our class tortoise too, Speedy.

translations.fa: اونی که خرس عروسکی داره! خودش خواسته. اینم لاک‌پشت کلاسمون، اسپیدی.

branches.suggestion: Speedy? Ha! A good name.
Who feeds the tortoise?

n8.speaker: ellis
n8.text: The children take turns. Ah, there's the bell. Come and see them line up!

translations.fa: بچه‌ها نوبتی. آه، زنگه. بیا صف بستنشون را ببین!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: {you}! You came to my school! Guess what we did at playtime!

translations.fa: {you}! اومدی مدرسه‌م! حدس بزن زنگ تفریح چی کار کردیم!

branches.suggestion: What did you do?
Did you play tag?

cultureNote.en: British "playtime" or "break", American "recess".
cultureNote.fa: playtime/recess.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: We played dragons! I was the big dragon. Mia was the knight.

translations.fa: اژدهابازی کردیم! من اژدهای بزرگه بودم. میا شوالیه بود.

branches.suggestion: Who won?
Did Mia catch you?

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Nobody won. We ran and ran, then the whistle went.

translations.fa: هیچ‌کس نبرد. دویدیم و دویدیم، بعد سوت زدن.

branches.suggestion: Then what happened?
You ran a lot!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Then we had fruit. I had an apple. Oliver had a banana. He dropped it!

translations.fa: بعد میوه خوردیم. من سیب خوردم. الیور موز خورد. افتاد زمین!

branches.suggestion: Oh no! Poor Oliver.
Do you have fruit every day?

cultureNote.en: Young children in English state schools get a free piece of fruit or vegetable every day.
cultureNote.fa: میوهٔ رایگان روزانه.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Yes! Every day. Then I fell over and hurt my knee. Look!

translations.fa: آره! هر روز. بعد افتادم و زانوم درد گرفت. ببین!

branches.suggestion: Ouch! Are you OK?
Did you cry?

recasts.echo: You fell over? Poor you!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Only a little bit. Mrs Ellis gave me a sticker. It says "I was brave"!

translations.fa: فقط یه ذره. خانم الیس بهم یه برچسب داد. روش نوشته «من شجاع بودم»!

branches.suggestion: You were very brave!
Can I see the sticker?

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Here! Mummy says I can put it on the fridge. Did you play at school in Iran?

translations.fa: بیا! مامان میگه می‌تونم بچسبونمش رو یخچال. تو ایران تو مدرسه بازی می‌کردی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, we played football.
We played a game like tag.
branches.suggestionFa: یه بازی شبیه گرگم به هوا.

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Football! Ryan likes football. Tomorrow I'm going to be a dragon AND play football!

translations.fa: فوتبال! رایان فوتبال دوست داره. فردا می‌خوام اژدها باشم و فوتبال هم بازی کنم!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Today was pizza day! I love pizza day!

translations.fa: امروز روز پیتزا بود! عاشق روز پیتزام!

branches.suggestion: What's pizza day?
Lucky you!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: On Fridays we have pizza for dinner. At school! Mondays are fish fingers.

translations.fa: جمعه‌ها ناهار پیتزا داریم. تو مدرسه! دوشنبه‌ها فیش فینگره.

branches.suggestion: Is lunch called "dinner" at school?
I like fish fingers too.

cultureNote.en: Many British people call the midday school meal "school dinner", and the lunch staff "dinner ladies".
cultureNote.fa: ناهار مدرسه را «دینر» هم می‌گویند.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Yes, school dinner! The dinner ladies give it to us. Mrs Pat is my favourite.

translations.fa: آره، ناهار مدرسه! خانم‌های ناهار بهمون میدن. خانم پت محبوب منه.

branches.suggestion: Why is she your favourite?
Is she kind?

cultureNote.en: British "favourite", American "favorite".
cultureNote.fa: favourite/favorite.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: She gives me extra custard! Shh, it's a secret. Do you like custard?

translations.fa: بهم کاستارد اضافه میده! هیس، رازه. تو کاستارد دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: I like custard. It's sweet.
I don't like custard very much.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: I don't like peas. They roll off my plate! Do you like peas?

translations.fa: من نخود فرنگی دوست ندارم. از بشقابم قل می‌خورن! تو دوست داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I like peas.
No. I don't like peas either!
branches.suggestionFa: نه. منم نخود فرنگی دوست ندارم!

recasts.echo: You don't like peas? Me neither!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Me neither! But Mummy says peas make you strong. Is that true?

translations.fa: منم نه! ولی مامان میگه نخود فرنگی آدم را قوی می‌کنه. راسته؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, vegetables are good for you.
Eat three peas tomorrow. Just three!
branches.suggestionFa: فردا سه تا نخود فرنگی بخور. فقط سه تا!

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Three peas… OK. And I'll have extra custard for being brave! Deal?

translations.fa: سه تا نخود فرنگی… باشه. و برای شجاعتم کاستارد اضافه می‌خورم! قبول؟

branches.suggestion: Deal!
Ask Mrs Pat, not me!
branches.suggestionFa: از خانم پت بپرس، نه از من!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Ha ha! Next Friday you can come for pizza day. Grown-ups can't though. Sorry!

translations.fa: ها ها! جمعهٔ بعد بیا روز پیتزا. البته بزرگ‌ترها نمی‌تونن. ببخشید!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Thanks for coming to pick Nicola up with me. The doors open at quarter past three.

translations.fa: ممنون که باهام اومدی دنبال نیکولا. درها سه و ربع باز میشن.

branches.suggestion: No problem. It's nice to see the school.
Do you pick her up every day?

cultureNote.en: British "quarter past three", Americans also say "quarter after three".
cultureNote.fa: quarter past/after.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Usually Maggie does it. I teach upstairs, so I finish late. Ah, here they come!

translations.fa: معمولاً مگی میاد. من طبقهٔ بالا درس میدم، دیر تموم می‌کنم. آه، دارن میان!

branches.suggestion: I can see Nicola!
She's waving at us.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Hello, sweetheart! How was your day?

translations.fa: سلام عزیزم! روزت چطور بود؟

branches.suggestion: Ask her what she learnt!
She looks tired.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Good! We learnt the letter S. S for snake! Sssss!

translations.fa: خوب! حرف S را یاد گرفتیم. S برای مار! سسسس!

branches.suggestion: S for {you}? No…
Very good, Nicola!

cultureNote.en: British "learnt", American "learned" (both are fine in the UK).
cultureNote.fa: learnt/learned.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Brilliant! What did you have for dinner?

translations.fa: عالی! ناهار چی خوردی؟

branches.suggestion: Was it pizza day?
I hope she ate the peas!
branches.suggestionFa: امیدوارم نخود فرنگی‌ها را خورده باشه!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Pasta. And I ate THREE peas! Can we go to the park? Pleeease?

translations.fa: پاستا. و سه تا نخود فرنگی خوردم! می‌شه بریم پارک؟ لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Three peas! Well done!
What do you think, Leslie?

recasts.echo: She ate three peas? Amazing!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Only for twenty minutes. Did you bring your book bag home?

translations.fa: فقط بیست دقیقه. کیف کتابت را آوردی؟

branches.suggestion: Here it is. I'm carrying it.
I think it's still in the classroom.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Phew. Right, twenty minutes at the park, then home for tea and a bath. Off we go!

translations.fa: آخیش. خب، بیست دقیقه پارک، بعد خونه برای شام و حموم. بریم!

l1_u32_1.title: A big loaf or a small one?

n1.speaker: baker
n1.text: Morning, love! What can I get you today?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر عزیزم! امروز چی بدم خدمتتون؟

branches.suggestion: A loaf of bread, please.
Have you got white bread?

n2.speaker: baker
n2.text: We've got white, brown and seeded. Large or small?

translations.fa: سفید، سبوس‌دار و دونه‌دار داریم. بزرگ یا کوچیک؟

branches.suggestion: A large white loaf, please.
How big is the large one?

cultureNote.en: In the UK "brown bread" means wholemeal or wheat bread.
cultureNote.fa: brown bread یعنی نان سبوس‌دار.

n3.speaker: baker
n3.text: This big one. It's eight hundred grams. The small one is four hundred.

translations.fa: این بزرگه. هشتصد گرمه. کوچیکه چهارصده.

branches.suggestion: The small one is enough for me.
The big one, please. I've got a big family next door!
branches.suggestionFa: بزرگه، لطفاً. همسایه‌م خانوادهٔ بزرگی داره!

n4.speaker: baker
n4.text: Ha! The Thompsons? Then you need a bigger one! Sliced or unsliced?

translations.fa: ها! تامپسون‌ها؟ پس بزرگ‌تر لازم داری! برش‌خورده یا نبریده؟

branches.suggestion: Sliced, please.
What does "unsliced" mean?

recasts.echo: A bigger one? Here you go.

n5.speaker: baker
n5.text: It means in one piece. You cut it at home. Thick slices or thin?

translations.fa: یعنی یکجا. خودت تو خونه می‌بری. برش ضخیم یا نازک؟

branches.suggestion: Thick slices, please. For toast.
branches.suggestionFa: برش ضخیم، لطفاً. برای نون تست.

branches.suggestion: Thin slices are better for sandwiches.

n6.speaker: baker
n6.text: Thick it is. Anything else? The rolls are small, and the baguettes are long!

translations.fa: ضخیم. چیز دیگه‌ای؟ نون رول‌ها کوچیکن، باگت‌ها بلند!

branches.suggestion: Four small rolls, please.
branches.suggestionFa: چهار تا نون رول کوچیک، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: One long baguette too.

cultureNote.en: Bread rolls have many regional names in Britain: bap, cob, barm cake, bun…
cultureNote.fa: نام‌های محلی نان گرد.

n7.speaker: baker
n7.text: Lovely. That's three pounds forty altogether.

translations.fa: عالی. جمعاً سه پوند و چهل میشه.

branches.suggestion: Here's four pounds.
Can I pay by card?

n8.speaker: baker
n8.text: Course you can. Here's your bag. Mind the baguette — it's longer than the bag!

translations.fa: البته. اینم کیسه‌تون. مواظب باگت باشید — از کیسه بلندتره!

n1.speaker: butcher
n1.text: Hello there! What would you like?

translations.fa: سلام! چی میل دارید؟

branches.suggestion: Can I have some eggs, please?
I need eggs and chicken.

n2.speaker: butcher
n2.text: Free-range eggs. Half a dozen or a dozen?

translations.fa: تخم‌مرغ محلی. نیم دوجین یا یه دوجین؟

branches.suggestion: What's half a dozen?
A dozen, please.

cultureNote.en: British shops often sell eggs by six (half a dozen) or twelve (a dozen).
cultureNote.fa: تخم‌مرغ شش‌تایی یا دوازده‌تایی.

n3.speaker: butcher
n3.text: Half a dozen is six. A dozen is twelve.

translations.fa: نیم دوجین شش تاست. یه دوجین دوازده تا.

branches.suggestion: Six is enough. Half a dozen, please.
branches.suggestionFa: شش تا کافیه. نیم دوجین، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Twelve, then. I eat a lot of eggs.
branches.suggestionFa: پس دوازده تا. من خیلی تخم‌مرغ می‌خورم.

n4.speaker: butcher
n4.text: Righto. Now, chicken. Breasts or thighs?

translations.fa: باشه. حالا مرغ. سینه یا ران؟

branches.suggestion: Two chicken breasts, please.
How much are the thighs?

n5.speaker: butcher
n5.text: Thighs are six pounds a kilo. Breasts are nine pounds a kilo.

translations.fa: ران کیلویی شش پونده. سینه کیلویی نه پوند.

branches.suggestion: Half a kilo of thighs, please.
One kilo of breasts, please.

cultureNote.en: The UK uses kilos in shops, but many older people still think in pounds and ounces.
cultureNote.fa: کیلو و پوند هر دو.

recasts.echo: Half a kilo? Sure.
recasts.better: Half a kilo of thighs, please.

n6.speaker: butcher
n6.text: Is it halal? Yes, everything here is halal. Lots of my customers ask.

translations.fa: حلاله؟ آره، همه چیز اینجا حلاله. خیلی از مشتری‌هام می‌پرسن.

branches.suggestion: Good, thank you.
How did you know my question?

n7.speaker: butcher
n7.text: Just a guess! Do you want me to cut it smaller? For a curry, maybe?

translations.fa: فقط حدس! می‌خوای کوچیک‌ترش کنم؟ مثلاً برای کاری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Small pieces.
No, thanks. Keep it whole.

n8.speaker: butcher
n8.text: There you are. Eggs and chicken. Seven pounds fifty. Careful with the eggs!

translations.fa: بفرمایید. تخم‌مرغ و مرغ. هفت پوند و پنجاه. مواظب تخم‌مرغ‌ها باشید!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Mum sent me for sweets for Nicola's party bags. You pick and mix them here!

translations.fa: مامان فرستادم برای کیسه‌های جشن نیکولا آبنبات بخرم. اینجا خودت قاطی می‌کنی!

branches.suggestion: What's pick and mix?
How many bags do we need?

cultureNote.en: British "sweets", American "candy".
cultureNote.fa: sweets/candy.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: You choose different sweets and they weigh them. We need ten bags.

translations.fa: آبنبات‌های مختلف انتخاب می‌کنی و وزنشون می‌کنن. ده تا کیسه لازمیم.

branches.suggestion: Ten bags is a lot!
Let's start with the jelly ones.

n3.speaker: baker
n3.text: Here's the scoop. That's two hundred grams. Do you want more?

translations.fa: اینم پیمانه. این دویست گرمه. بیشتر می‌خواید؟

branches.suggestion: A bit more, please.
A lot more! It's for ten children.
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی بیشتر! برای ده تا بچه‌ست.

recasts.echo: A bit more? Here you are.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Not too many fizzy ones. Mum says they make kids go mad.

translations.fa: زیاد گازداری نه. مامان میگه بچه‌ها را دیوونه می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: OK, fewer fizzy sweets.
What about chocolate?

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Chocolate melts in the bags. Less chocolate, more jelly.

translations.fa: شکلات تو کیسه‌ها آب میشه. شکلات کمتر، ژله‌ای بیشتر.

branches.suggestion: Less chocolate. Got it.
Jelly snakes, then!

n6.speaker: baker
n6.text: That's six hundred grams now. Is that enough?

translations.fa: الان ششصد گرمه. کافیه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, that's enough.
Maybe a bit less. It's a lot of sugar!
branches.suggestionFa: شاید یه کم کمتر. خیلی شکره!

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Ha, you sound like Mum. It's perfect. Sixty grams each bag.

translations.fa: ها، مثل مامان حرف می‌زنی. عالیه. هر کیسه شصت گرم.

branches.suggestion: How much is it?
Can we pay half each?

n8.speaker: baker
n8.text: Six pounds, please. Have a fab party!

translations.fa: شش پوند، لطفاً. جشن خوبی داشته باشید!

branches.suggestion: Thank you!
Mum gave me the money.

n9.speaker: ryan
n9.text: Sorted. Don't tell Nicola about the snakes. It's a surprise. And don't eat them on the way home!

translations.fa: تمومه. دربارهٔ مارها به نیکولا نگو. سورپرایزه. و تو راه خونه نخوریشون!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Right! Barbecue on Saturday. Twenty people! I'm buying sausages. How many do we need?

translations.fa: خب! باربیکیو شنبه. بیست نفر! سوسیس می‌خرم. چند تا لازم داریم؟

branches.suggestion: Two each? Forty sausages.
branches.suggestionFa: نفری دو تا؟ چهل تا سوسیس.

branches.suggestion: Twenty people is a lot!

cultureNote.en: British barbecues often feature sausages and burgers — and a lot of hoping it won't rain!
cultureNote.fa: باربیکیو و امید به نباریدن باران.

n2.speaker: butcher
n2.text: Forty sausages? Tom, you'll have too many. Not everyone eats two.

translations.fa: چهل تا سوسیس؟ تام، زیادی میشه. همه دو تا نمی‌خورن.

branches.suggestion: Thirty is enough, then.
Ryan eats five!

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Ha! True. OK, thirty-five. And burgers. Is ten enough?

translations.fa: ها! راسته. باشه، سی و پنج. و برگر. ده تا کافیه؟

branches.suggestion: No, ten isn't enough.
Ten is fine.

recasts.echo: Not enough? Fair point.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Fifteen burgers, then. And chicken wings for Maggie. She loves them.

translations.fa: پس پونزده تا برگر. و بال مرغ برای مگی. عاشقشه.

branches.suggestion: Are the sausages pork?
I don't eat pork, Tom.

n5.speaker: butcher
n5.text: Most are pork, but I've got chicken and lamb ones. Halal too.

translations.fa: بیشترشون خوکن، ولی مرغی و برّه‌ای هم دارم. حلال هم هست.

branches.suggestion: Ten lamb ones, please.
Chicken ones for me and Maggie.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Good thinking. Plus marinated kebabs for the grown-ups. Is that too much meat?

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. به علاوه کباب مزه‌دار برای بزرگ‌ترها. گوشت زیادی نیست؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, that's too much meat!
Get some vegetables too.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Vegetables? At a barbecue? You're as bad as Leslie! Fine. Some corn on the cob.

translations.fa: سبزیجات؟ تو باربیکیو؟ عین لزلی هستی! باشه. یه کم ذرت.

branches.suggestion: Corn is good.
And peppers for skewers?

n8.speaker: butcher
n8.text: Peppers I haven't got, Tom. This is a butcher's! Try the greengrocer next door.

translations.fa: فلفل ندارم تام. اینجا قصابیه! سبزی‌فروشی بغل را امتحان کن.

branches.suggestion: Ha! Of course.
That's enough shopping for today!

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: That's enough meat to feed Hackney! Fifty-two pounds… ouch. Leslie's going to kill me.

translations.fa: این گوشت برای سیر کردن کل هکنی بسه! پنجاه و دو پوند… آخ. لزلی منو می‌کشه.

n1.speaker: baker
n1.text: Morning! Welcome to my Saturday stall. Everything's fresh from the oven!

translations.fa: صبح بخیر! به غرفهٔ شنبه‌م خوش اومدی. همه چیز تازه از تنوره!

branches.suggestion: Do you come here every Saturday?
Is the bread fresh today?

cultureNote.en: Broadway Market in Hackney is a famous Saturday street market.
cultureNote.fa: بازار برادوی در هکنی.

n2.speaker: baker
n2.text: Every Saturday, rain or shine! I bake at four in the morning.

translations.fa: هر شنبه، بارون باشه یا آفتاب! ساعت چهار صبح نون می‌پزم.

branches.suggestion: Four in the morning? That's early!
Do you sleep in the afternoon?

n3.speaker: baker
n3.text: I have a nap after lunch! Do you want to try the sourdough? Here's a sample.

translations.fa: بعد از ناهار چرت می‌زنم! می‌خوای نون ساوردو را امتحان کنی؟ بیا یه نمونه.

branches.suggestion: Thank you. Mmm, it's a bit sour.
What is sourdough?

n4.speaker: baker
n4.text: It's bread made slowly, with no yeast. It's a bit sour. Do you like it?

translations.fa: نونیه که آروم درست میشه، بدون مخمر. یه کم ترشه. دوستش داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I like it a lot.
It's like bread in Iran!

recasts.echo: You like it? Lovely!

n5.speaker: baker
n5.text: Is it? Which bread do you have in Iran?

translations.fa: جدی؟ تو ایران چه نونی دارید؟

branches.suggestion: We have sangak. It's long and flat.
Barbari. It's flat with seeds on top.

n6.speaker: baker
n6.text: Sounds delicious. There's an Iranian bakery in Kilburn, you know. Now, what can I get you?

translations.fa: خوشمزه به نظر میاد. می‌دونی، یه نونوایی ایرانی تو کیلبرن هست. خب، چی بدم خدمتت؟

branches.suggestion: One sourdough loaf, please.
Where's Kilburn?

cultureNote.en: London has many Persian shops and bakeries, especially in north-west London.
cultureNote.fa: نانوایی‌های ایرانی در لندن.

n7.speaker: baker
n7.text: Up in north-west London. Here's your sourdough. Four pounds, please.

translations.fa: شمال غربی لندن. بفرما ساوردو. چهار پوند، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Here you are.
It's expensive, but it's worth it.

n8.speaker: baker
n8.text: It IS worth it! Keep it in a paper bag, not plastic. See you next Saturday!

translations.fa: واقعاً می‌ارزه! تو کیسهٔ کاغذی نگهش دار، نه پلاستیکی. شنبهٔ بعد می‌بینمت!

n1.speaker: baker
n1.text: Two for a pound! Croissants, two for a pound! It's nearly closing time!

translations.fa: دو تا یه پوند! کروسان، دو تا یه پوند! نزدیک وقت جمع کردنه!

branches.suggestion: Two for a pound? That's cheap!
How much is one croissant?

n2.speaker: baker
n2.text: One is eighty pence. Two is a pound. Two is cheaper!

translations.fa: یکی هشتاد پنی. دو تا یه پوند. دو تا ارزون‌تره!

branches.suggestion: Then I'll have two.
Can I have four for two pounds?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه چهار تا دو پوند بدید؟

cultureNote.en: At the end of the day, many market traders sell food cheaply so they don't waste it.
cultureNote.fa: فروش ارزان آخر روز.

n3.speaker: baker
n3.text: Four for two pounds. Deal! Do you want pains au chocolat too? Same price.

translations.fa: چهار تا دو پوند. قبول! پن او شکلات هم می‌خوای؟ همون قیمت.

branches.suggestion: What's the difference?
Yes. Two of those, please.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. دو تا از اونا، لطفاً.

n4.speaker: baker
n4.text: A pain au chocolat has chocolate inside. It's a bit more expensive in the morning.

translations.fa: پن او شکلات داخلش شکلات داره. صبح یه کم گرون‌تره.

branches.suggestion: But not now?
Chocolate is better!

recasts.echo: It's cheaper now? Yes!

n5.speaker: baker
n5.text: Not now! Everything is cheaper at four o'clock. The supermarket is more expensive!

translations.fa: الان نه! ساعت چهار همه چی ارزون‌تره. سوپرمارکت گرون‌تره!

branches.suggestion: Your croissants are better than the supermarket's.
branches.suggestionFa: کروسان‌های شما از مال سوپرمارکت بهترن.

branches.suggestion: I'll come at four o'clock every week!

n6.speaker: baker
n6.text: Ha! Not too often, or I'll go broke! Six pastries, three pounds.

translations.fa: ها! نه زیاد، وگرنه ورشکست میشم! شیش تا شیرینی، سه پوند.

branches.suggestion: Here's a five-pound note.
Can I pay with my phone?

cultureNote.en: British "note", American "bill" for paper money.
cultureNote.fa: note/bill.

n7.speaker: baker
n7.text: Course. And here's two pounds change. Take a free cookie for Nicola too.

translations.fa: البته. اینم دو پوند بقیه‌ش. یه کلوچهٔ مجانی هم برای نیکولا ببر.

branches.suggestion: That's so kind. Thank you!
How do you know Nicola?

n8.speaker: baker
n8.text: Everyone round here knows Nicola! She sings to my customers! Enjoy your pastries!

translations.fa: همه این دور و بر نیکولا را می‌شناسن! برای مشتری‌هام آواز می‌خونه! نوش جان!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Look at the flower stall! I want to buy some flowers for Maggie. Just because.

translations.fa: غرفهٔ گل را ببین! می‌خوام برای مگی گل بخرم. همین‌طوری.

branches.suggestion: What a lovely idea.
What flowers does Maggie like?

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Nana likes yellow! Yellow is her favourite colour!

translations.fa: نانا زرد دوست داره! زرد رنگ محبوبشه!

branches.suggestion: Sunflowers are yellow.
What about those yellow roses?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Sunflowers or roses? Hmm. Which do you prefer, {you}?

translations.fa: آفتابگردون یا رز؟ هوم. تو کدوم را ترجیح میدی {you}؟

branches.suggestion: I prefer the sunflowers. They're happy.
branches.suggestionFa: من آفتابگردون را ترجیح میدم. شادن.

branches.suggestion: I prefer roses. They smell nice.
branches.suggestionFa: من رز را ترجیح میدم. بوی خوبی دارن.

recasts.echo: You prefer sunflowers to roses? Me too.
recasts.betterFa: آفتابگردون را به رز ترجیح میدم.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Good point. But sunflowers are big. Maggie's kitchen is small!

translations.fa: نکتهٔ خوبیه. ولی آفتابگردون‌ها بزرگن. آشپزخونهٔ مگی کوچیکه!

branches.suggestion: Then let's get the roses.
Buy a small bunch.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Can we get daffodils too? They're yellow AND small!

translations.fa: می‌شه نرگس هم بخریم؟ هم زردن هم کوچیک!

branches.suggestion: Daffodils! Good thinking, Nicola.
Are daffodils expensive?

cultureNote.en: Daffodils are a symbol of spring in Britain, and the national flower of Wales.
cultureNote.fa: نرگس نماد بهار و گل ملی ولز.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: No, they're only three pounds a bunch. Let's get a bunch of daffodils and two roses.

translations.fa: نه، دسته‌ای فقط سه پوند. یه دسته نرگس و دو تا رز بخریم.

branches.suggestion: Can we wrap them in paper?
Nicola can carry them.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Me! Me! I'll carry them very carefully. Can I give them to Nana?

translations.fa: من! من! خیلی با دقت میارمشون. می‌تونم بدمشون به نانا؟

branches.suggestion: Of course you can.
Don't drop them!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Of course, sweetie. Nana is going to cry happy tears. Let's go before they wilt!

translations.fa: البته عزیزم. نانا از خوشحالی گریه می‌کنه. بریم قبل از اینکه پژمرده بشن!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Right, cake for Sunday. A Victoria sponge. Excuse me, mate! How much is that?

translations.fa: خب، کیک برای یکشنبه. کیک ویکتوریا. ببخشید رفیق! اون چنده؟

branches.suggestion: It says twelve pounds.
That looks delicious.

cultureNote.en: A Victoria sponge is a classic British cake with jam and cream, named after Queen Victoria.
cultureNote.fa: کیک ویکتوریا با مربا و خامه.

n2.speaker: baker
n2.text: Twelve pounds for the big one, Tom. Eight for the small one.

translations.fa: بزرگه دوازده پوند تام. کوچیکه هشت.

branches.suggestion: The big one, Tom. For your family!
The small one is enough.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: The big one. My lot eat a lot! Here's a twenty.

translations.fa: بزرگه. خانواده‌م زیاد می‌خورن! بفرما یه بیستی.

branches.suggestion: Do you need a bag?
Ask for a box, Tom.

n4.speaker: baker
n4.text: Here you go, in a box. And your change. Three pounds.

translations.fa: بفرما، تو جعبه. و بقیهٔ پولت. سه پوند.

branches.suggestion: Sorry, I think there's a mistake.
Three pounds? That's wrong.

cultureNote.en: In Britain, start with "Sorry, I think…" to point out a mistake politely.
cultureNote.fa: با «ببخشید، فکر کنم» مؤدبانه بگویید.

recasts.echo: There's a mistake? Let me check.

n5.speaker: baker
n5.text: Oh? Let me check. Twenty minus twelve…

translations.fa: آه؟ بذار ببینم. بیست منهای دوازده…

branches.suggestion: Twenty minus twelve is eight.
It should be eight pounds change.

n6.speaker: baker
n6.text: Eight! You're right. I'm so sorry, Tom. It's the end of the day. My brain's tired!

translations.fa: هشت! راست میگی. خیلی ببخشید تام. آخر روزه. مغزم خسته‌ست!

branches.suggestion: No problem. It happens.
Don't worry about it.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: No harm done! Good thing {you} is good at maths. I'm a bus driver, not a maths teacher!

translations.fa: ضرری نکردیم! خوب شد {you} ریاضیش خوبه. من راننده اتوبوسم، نه معلم ریاضی!

branches.suggestion: Leslie is the teacher!
You count bus fares every day!
branches.suggestionFa: تو که هر روز کرایه می‌شمری!

cultureNote.en: British "maths", American "math".
cultureNote.fa: maths/math.

n8.speaker: baker
n8.text: Here's another five pounds. And a free jam tart for the trouble!

translations.fa: اینم پنج پوند دیگه. و یه تارت مربایی مجانی بابت زحمت!

branches.suggestion: That's very kind.
Thank you! Have a good evening.

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Free jam tart! Best mistake ever. Actually, {you}, I don't take cash on the bus anymore. Only cards! Ha!

translations.fa: تارت مجانی! بهترین اشتباه عمرم. راستش {you}، دیگه تو اتوبوس پول نقد نمی‌گیرم. فقط کارت! ها!

n1.speaker: doris
n1.text: Excuse me, young man. Do you know the way to the library? I always forget!

translations.fa: ببخشید پسرم. راه کتابخونه را بلدی؟ همیشه یادم میره!

branches.suggestion: Yes. It's near here.
Sorry, I'm new here. Let me check my phone.
branches.suggestionFa: ببخشید، من اینجا تازه‌واردم. بذارید با گوشیم ببینم.

n2.speaker: doris
n2.text: Oh, you're a dear. Is it left or right from the bus stop?

translations.fa: آه، چه نازنینی. از ایستگاه اتوبوس چپه یا راست؟

branches.suggestion: Turn left at the bus stop.
It's on the right.

n3.speaker: doris
n3.text: Left. And then? My legs aren't what they used to be, so not too far, I hope!

translations.fa: چپ. و بعد؟ پاهام دیگه مثل قبل نیستن، امیدوارم خیلی دور نباشه!

branches.suggestion: Then go straight on.
It's about five minutes.

cultureNote.en: British "straight on", American "straight ahead".
cultureNote.fa: straight on/ahead.

recasts.echo: Straight on? Lovely.

n4.speaker: doris
n4.text: Five minutes. I can do that. Is it on this side of the road?

translations.fa: پنج دقیقه. از پسش برمیام. این طرف خیابونه؟

branches.suggestion: No, it's on the other side.
Yes, on this side.

n5.speaker: doris
n5.text: Then I need to cross. Is there a zebra crossing?

translations.fa: پس باید رد بشم. خط عابر پیاده هست؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, by the post office.
Use the traffic lights. It's safer.
branches.suggestionFa: از چراغ راهنما استفاده کنید. امن‌تره.

cultureNote.en: On a zebra crossing, cars must stop for you. Look right first — UK traffic drives on the left!
cultureNote.fa: اول به راست نگاه کنید؛ رانندگی از چپ.

n6.speaker: doris
n6.text: Lovely. Left, straight on, cross by the post office. Can you write it down for me?

translations.fa: عالی. چپ، مستقیم، کنار پست رد شو. می‌تونی برام بنویسیش؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. Here you are.
I can walk with you.

n7.speaker: doris
n7.text: Oh, you are kind. Tom on the 38 says you're a good lad. He's right!

translations.fa: آه، چقدر مهربونی. تام راننده ۳۸ میگه پسر خوبی هستی. راست میگه!

branches.suggestion: You know Tom?
Tom is my neighbour!

n8.speaker: doris
n8.text: Everybody knows Tom! His jokes are terrible, but he always waits for me. Come on, then — library!

translations.fa: همه تام را می‌شناسن! جوک‌هاش افتضاحه، ولی همیشه منتظرم می‌مونه. بیا بریم — کتابخونه!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: You're getting the bus to the Job Centre tomorrow? Do you know the stop?

translations.fa: فردا با اتوبوس میری مرکز کاریابی؟ ایستگاه را بلدی؟

branches.suggestion: No. Where's the bus stop?
Is it the one by the shop?

n2.speaker: tom
