translations.fa: اول کمکم کن جمعش کنم. با احتیاط. خاک‌انداز و جارو را بیار.

branches.suggestion: Here's the dustpan.
Put the big pieces in newspaper.
branches.suggestionFa: تیکه‌های بزرگ را تو روزنامه بذار.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Good idea. OK, she's coming. What do I say?

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. خب، داره میاد. چی بگم؟

branches.suggestion: Say "I'm really sorry, Mum."
Say "It was an accident."

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: What was that noise? Oh… my cat mug.

translations.fa: این صدا چی بود؟ آه… ماگ گربه‌ایم.

branches.suggestion: Ryan has something to say.
It was an accident, Leslie.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Mum, I'm really, really sorry. It slipped. I'll buy you a new one.

translations.fa: مامان، واقعاً واقعاً متأسفم. لیز خورد. یه نو برات می‌خرم.

branches.suggestion: He's really sorry.
He cleaned it up carefully.

recasts.echo: You're sorry you broke it? I know.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Thank you for telling me, Ryan. And for cleaning up. It's only a mug. Accidents happen.

translations.fa: ممنون که بهم گفتی رایان. و که تمیزش کردی. فقط یه ماگه. اتفاق پیش میاد.

branches.suggestion: See? She isn't angry.
That's kind, Leslie.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: But you can buy me a new one. With your Saturday money! Cats, please. Big cats!

translations.fa: ولی می‌تونی یه نو برام بخری. با پول کار شنبه‌ت! گربه‌دار، لطفاً. گربه‌های بزرگ!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Morning! Ooh, what's that smell? Is something burning?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر! اوه، این بو چیه؟ چیزی داره می‌سوزه؟

branches.suggestion: Oh no! The toast!
Sorry, Tom. I burnt the toast.
branches.suggestionFa: ببخشید تام. نون تست را سوزوندم.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Ha! Never mind. Open the window before the smoke alarm goes off.

translations.fa: ها! عیب نداره. قبل از اینکه آژیر دود به صدا دربیاد پنجره را باز کن.

branches.suggestion: Too late! It's beeping!
Where's the window key?

cultureNote.en: Every UK home should have a working smoke alarm. Never take the battery out!
cultureNote.fa: آژیر دود الزامی است.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Wave a tea towel at it! Like this! Wave, wave! There. Quiet!

translations.fa: یه حوله آشپزخونه جلوش تکون بده! این‌جوری! تکون بده، تکون بده! ایناهاش. ساکت شد!

branches.suggestion: Sorry. I'm so embarrassed.
Did I wake everyone up?

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Don't worry about it! No harm done. I do it every week. Leslie calls me "the toast burner".

translations.fa: نگرانش نباش! ضرری نکردیم. من هر هفته این کار را می‌کنم. لزلی بهم میگه «سوزانندهٔ نون تست».

branches.suggestion: Really? Every week?
That makes me feel better.

recasts.echo: Don't worry about it? Thanks, Tom.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Every week! The toaster is too strong. Put it on number three, not five.

translations.fa: هر هفته! توستر زیادی قویه. بذارش رو سه، نه پنج.

branches.suggestion: Number three. OK.
I put it on five!

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Five is for crumpets! Right, try again. Two more slices. I'm watching this time!

translations.fa: پنج برای کرامپته! خب، دوباره امتحان کن. دو تا برش دیگه. این دفعه حواسم هست!

branches.suggestion: What are crumpets?
Thanks for being so nice about it.
branches.suggestionFa: ممنون که این‌قدر باهاش کنار اومدی.

cultureNote.en: Crumpets are soft, spongy British bread rounds, toasted and eaten with lots of butter.
cultureNote.fa: کرامپت.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: You're welcome! Perfect golden toast. See? Everyone burns toast. It's not a big deal.

translations.fa: خواهش می‌کنم! نون تست طلایی عالی. دیدی؟ همه نون تست می‌سوزونن. چیز مهمی نیست.

branches.suggestion: It's perfect now!
Thank you, Tom.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Now — butter, and lots of it. And next time, if I burn it, you can call me "the toast burner" too!

translations.fa: حالا — کره، و زیاد. و دفعهٔ بعد، اگه من سوزوندم، تو هم می‌تونی بهم بگی «سوزانندهٔ نون تست»!

n1.speaker: arthur
n1.text: Next, please! Good morning. What can I do for you?

translations.fa: نفر بعدی، لطفاً! صبح بخیر. چه کمکی از دستم برمیاد؟

branches.suggestion: Can I have a stamp, please?
I'd like some stamps, please.

n2.speaker: arthur
n2.text: Of course. Is it for a letter or a card? In the UK?

translations.fa: البته. برای نامه‌ست یا کارت؟ داخل بریتانیا؟

branches.suggestion: A birthday card, in London.
A letter to my bank.

n3.speaker: arthur
n3.text: Lovely. How many would you like? They come in books of eight too.

translations.fa: عالی. چند تا می‌خواید؟ دفترچه‌های هشت‌تایی هم داریم.

branches.suggestion: Just one, please.
A book of eight, please.

recasts.echo: Eight stamps? A book, then!

n4.speaker: arthur
n4.text: Good thinking. Stamps never go out of date. Now, the size. Is it a big envelope?

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. تمبرها هیچ‌وقت تاریخ‌گذشته نمیشن. حالا، اندازه. پاکتش بزرگه؟

branches.suggestion: No, it's a normal envelope.
It's a big one, A4 size.

cultureNote.en: Royal Mail prices depend on size: "Letter" (small) and "Large letter" (like A4) cost different amounts.
cultureNote.fa: قیمت بر اساس اندازه.

n5.speaker: arthur
n5.text: A big one is a "large letter". Let me check it in the slot. It fits!

translations.fa: بزرگه میشه «نامهٔ بزرگ». بذار تو شکاف امتحانش کنم. جا میشه!

branches.suggestion: What's the slot?
How much is a large letter?

n6.speaker: arthur
n6.text: This plastic slot measures it. If it fits, it's a large letter. Anything else today?

translations.fa: این شکاف پلاستیکی اندازه‌ش را می‌گیره. اگه جا بشه، نامهٔ بزرگه. امروز چیز دیگه‌ای؟

branches.suggestion: No, that's all, thanks.
Do you sell envelopes?

n7.speaker: arthur
n7.text: We do — just there, by the cards. That's all? Card or cash?

translations.fa: می‌فروشیم — همون‌جا، کنار کارت‌ها. همینه؟ کارت یا نقد؟

branches.suggestion: Card, please.
Here's a ten-pound note.

n8.speaker: arthur
n8.text: Thank you. Here are your stamps. Stick it top right, love. Have a nice day!

translations.fa: ممنون. بفرمایید تمبرهاتون. بالا سمت راست بچسبونیدش عزیزم. روز خوبی داشته باشید!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: I need to post this card to my sister in Leeds. It's her birthday on Thursday!

translations.fa: باید این کارت را برای خواهرم تو لیدز پست کنم. پنجشنبه تولدشه!

branches.suggestion: Is there a postbox near here?
Will it arrive by Thursday?

cultureNote.en: British "post" and "postbox", American "mail" and "mailbox".
cultureNote.fa: post/mail.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: There's a postbox outside. The red one. Have you got a pen? I need to write the address.

translations.fa: بیرون یه صندوق پست هست. قرمزه. خودکار داری؟ باید آدرس را بنویسم.

branches.suggestion: Here's a pen.
Where does the address go?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: In the middle of the envelope. Name, house number, street, town and postcode.

translations.fa: وسط پاکت. اسم، شمارهٔ خونه، خیابون، شهر و کد پستی.

branches.suggestion: And the stamp goes top right.
branches.suggestionFa: و تمبر بالا سمت راست میره.

branches.suggestion: Do I write my address too?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Yes, on the back. In case it comes back. Ooh, look at the box. What time is the last collection?

translations.fa: آره، پشتش. اگه برگشت. اوه، صندوق را ببین. آخرین جمع‌آوری کیه؟

branches.suggestion: It says 5.30 p.m.
What's a collection?

cultureNote.en: Every UK postbox shows its collection times — when the post is taken away.
cultureNote.fa: ساعت جمع‌آوری روی صندوق.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: When the postman empties the box. It's four o'clock now. We're before the last collection.

translations.fa: وقتی پستچی صندوق را خالی می‌کنه. الان ساعت چهاره. قبل از آخرین جمع‌آوری هستیم.

branches.suggestion: Great. It goes today, then.
Will it get there by Thursday?

match: will it get there at thursday
recasts.echo: By Thursday? Hopefully!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: It should arrive on Wednesday or Thursday. First class is quicker, but this has a second-class stamp.

translations.fa: باید چهارشنبه یا پنجشنبه برسه. درجه یک سریع‌تره، ولی این تمبر درجه دو داره.

branches.suggestion: Second class is fine.
Let's buy a first-class stamp, to be safe.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا یه تمبر درجه یک بخریم، برای اطمینان.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Good idea — just in case. Can you pop it in the box? Mind your fingers!

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه — محض احتیاط. می‌تونی بندازیش تو صندوق؟ مواظب انگشتات باش!

branches.suggestion: Done! It's in the box.
Happy birthday to your sister!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Thank you! She'll love it. Nicola drew a horse on it. Well — she says it's a horse. It looks like a potato!

translations.fa: ممنون! عاشقش میشه. نیکولا روش یه اسب کشید. خب — اون میگه اسبه. شبیه سیب‌زمینیه!

n1.speaker: arthur
n1.text: Hello again! Another letter? First or second class?

translations.fa: دوباره سلام! یه نامهٔ دیگه؟ درجه یک یا درجه دو؟

branches.suggestion: What's the difference?
Which is faster?

n2.speaker: arthur
n2.text: First class usually arrives the next day. Second class takes two or three days.

translations.fa: درجه یک معمولاً روز بعد می‌رسه. درجه دو دو سه روز طول می‌کشه.

branches.suggestion: Is first class more expensive?
So second class is slower.

n3.speaker: arthur
n3.text: Yes, first class is more expensive. Second class is cheaper. Is it urgent?

translations.fa: آره، درجه یک گرون‌تره. درجه دو ارزون‌تره. فوریه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, it's urgent. It's for my visa.
No, it isn't urgent.

recasts.echo: It's cheaper? Yes, it is!

n4.speaker: arthur
n4.text: For important papers, I'd use Special Delivery. It's the fastest and the safest.

translations.fa: برای مدارک مهم، من از ارسال ویژه استفاده می‌کنم. سریع‌ترین و امن‌ترینه.

branches.suggestion: Is it more expensive than first class?
Why is it safer?

cultureNote.en: For important documents, use "Special Delivery Guaranteed" — it's tracked and must be signed for.
cultureNote.fa: ارسال ویژه با رهگیری.

n5.speaker: arthur
n5.text: It's tracked, and somebody signs for it. And it arrives before one o'clock tomorrow.

translations.fa: رهگیری میشه، و یکی تحویلش را امضا می‌کنه. و فردا قبل از ساعت یک می‌رسه.

branches.suggestion: OK. Special Delivery, please.
How do I track it?

n6.speaker: arthur
n6.text: Wise choice. Here's your receipt. The tracking number is at the top. Keep it safe!

translations.fa: انتخاب عاقلانه. اینم رسیدتون. شمارهٔ رهگیری بالاشه. خوب نگهش دارید!

branches.suggestion: Thank you. I'll check it online.
Is the tracking number this one?

n7.speaker: arthur
n7.text: That's the one. Forty years here, and Special Delivery has never let me down. Good luck!

translations.fa: همینه. چهل سال اینجام، و ارسال ویژه هیچ‌وقت ناامیدم نکرده. موفق باشید!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Nana got a card from the postman. "Sorry we missed you." Can you collect her parcel?

translations.fa: نانا یه کارت از پستچی گرفت. «متأسفیم که نبودید.» می‌تونی بسته‌ش را تحویل بگیری؟

branches.suggestion: Sure. Where do I go?
What does the card say?

cultureNote.en: When nobody is home, Royal Mail leaves a red "Sorry we missed you" card.
cultureNote.fa: کارت قرمز «متأسفیم که نبودید».

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: It says it's at the post office on the high street. You need the card and ID.

translations.fa: میگه تو ادارهٔ پست خیابون اصلیه. کارت و مدرک شناسایی لازمه.

branches.suggestion: Whose ID? Mine or Nana's?
branches.suggestionFa: مدرک کی؟ مال من یا نانا؟

branches.suggestion: Can I take my passport?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Nana has signed the back of the card. So take your ID and her card.

translations.fa: نانا پشت کارت را امضا کرده. پس مدرک خودت و کارتش را ببر.

branches.suggestion: She's signed it. Good.
Has she written my name?

n4.speaker: arthur
n4.text: Hello! Collecting? Can I see the card and your ID, please?

translations.fa: سلام! تحویل گرفتن؟ می‌شه کارت و مدرکتون را ببینم، لطفاً؟

branches.suggestion: Here's the card and my passport.
It's for my neighbour, Mrs Thompson.

n5.speaker: arthur
n5.text: Let me look… Ah yes, it's arrived. It's quite heavy! Has she ordered bricks? Ha!

translations.fa: بذار ببینم… آه بله، رسیده. یه کم سنگینه! آجر سفارش داده؟ ها!

branches.suggestion: Ha! I don't know what it is.
I think it's wool for knitting.

recasts.echo: It's arrived? Yes, here it is!

n6.speaker: arthur
n6.text: Knitting wool! That's Maggie for you. Sign here, please, to say you've got it.

translations.fa: کاموای بافتنی! این همون مگیه. لطفاً اینجا امضا کنید که تحویل گرفتید.

branches.suggestion: Here's my signature.
Where do I sign?

n7.speaker: arthur
n7.text: Perfect. Give her my best. Tell her the scarf she made me last year is still keeping me warm!

translations.fa: عالی. سلام منو بهش برسونید. بهش بگید شال‌گردنی که پارسال برام بافت هنوز گرمم نگه می‌داره!

branches.suggestion: I will!
She knitted you a scarf?

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Nana knits for half of Hackney! Ha! Thanks for collecting it. Let's open it together — I bet it's purple wool.

translations.fa: نانا برای نصف هکنی بافتنی می‌بافه! ها! ممنون که تحویل گرفتی. بیا با هم بازش کنیم — شرط می‌بندم کاموای بنفشه.

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: The Christmas tree is here! Daddy got it from the market! Can you help me decorate it?

translations.fa: درخت کریسمس رسید! بابا از بازار گرفتش! کمکم می‌کنی تزئینش کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! What do we put on it?
It's so big!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Daddy says lights first, then baubles. Can you hold this end?

translations.fa: بابا میگه اول چراغ، بعد گوی‌ها. می‌تونی این سرش را بگیری؟

branches.suggestion: I'm holding it.
What are baubles?

cultureNote.en: "Baubles" are the round shiny balls you hang on a Christmas tree.
cultureNote.fa: bauble گوی درخت کریسمس.

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: The shiny balls! Big ones at the bottom, small ones at the top.

translations.fa: توپ‌های براق! بزرگا پایین، کوچیکا بالا.

branches.suggestion: Big ones at the bottom.
Can I hang this red one?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم این قرمزه را آویزون کنم؟

recasts.echo: At the bottom? Yes!
recasts.better: The big ones go at the bottom.

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Now tinsel! It's sparkly! Put it round and round the tree.

translations.fa: حالا ریسه! برق می‌زنه! دور تا دور درخت بپیچش.

branches.suggestion: Round and round. Like this?
It's very sparkly!

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: And this is my special one. I made it at school. It's a snowman!

translations.fa: و این مال مخصوص منه. تو مدرسه درستش کردم. آدم‌برفیه!

branches.suggestion: It's beautiful, Nicola.
Where shall we put it?

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: In the middle! Now the star. It goes on top! But I'm too small.

translations.fa: وسط! حالا ستاره. بالای درخت میره! ولی من خیلی کوچیکم.

branches.suggestion: I'll lift you up.
Stand on the chair. Carefully!

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Up, up! There! The star is on top! Switch on the lights! Ready…

translations.fa: بالا، بالا! ایناهاش! ستاره بالاست! چراغ‌ها را روشن کن! آماده…

branches.suggestion: Three, two, one…
Switching on now!

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Ooooh! It's MAGIC! It's the best tree in the world! Do you have Christmas trees in Iran?

translations.fa: اوووه! جادوییه! بهترین درخت دنیاست! تو ایران درخت کریسمس دارید؟

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Look at all the presents under the tree! I'm going to find mine.

translations.fa: این‌همه کادو زیر درخت را ببین! می‌خوام مال خودم را پیدا کنم.

branches.suggestion: Don't open them yet!
Which ones are yours?

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: I'm only looking! This big one says "To Ryan, love from Santa".

translations.fa: فقط دارم نگاه می‌کنم! این بزرگه نوشته «به رایان، با عشق از طرف بابانوئل».

branches.suggestion: Santa? Really?
What do you think it is?

cultureNote.en: British children often call Santa "Father Christmas".
cultureNote.fa: Father Christmas همان بابانوئل.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Ha! Santa has Mum's handwriting. I think it's a football shirt. Shake it!

translations.fa: ها! بابانوئل خط مامان را داره. فکر کنم پیراهن فوتباله. تکونش بده!

branches.suggestion: It doesn't make a noise.
It's soft. I think it's clothes.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: Clothes! Yes! Whose is this little one? It's got your name on it!

translations.fa: لباس! آره! این کوچیکه مال کیه؟ اسم تو روشه!

branches.suggestion: For me? Really?
Who is it from?

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: "To {you}, from Nicola". She wrapped it herself. Look at all the tape!

translations.fa: «به {you}، از طرف نیکولا». خودش کادوش کرده. این‌همه چسب را ببین!

branches.suggestion: Ha! It's very… sticky.
That's so kind of her.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: When do you open presents in Iran? At Nowruz?

translations.fa: تو ایران کی کادو باز می‌کنید؟ تو نوروز؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. At Nowruz, we give money and gifts.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. تو نوروز، پول و هدیه میدیم.

branches.suggestion: Older people give children new money.
branches.suggestionFa: بزرگ‌ترها به بچه‌ها پول نو میدن.

recasts.echo: You give money at Nowruz? Lucky!

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Money?! I want Nowruz too! Here, we open presents on Christmas morning. Mum says not before seven!

translations.fa: پول؟! منم نوروز می‌خوام! اینجا صبح کریسمس کادو باز می‌کنیم. مامان میگه نه قبل از ساعت هفت!

branches.suggestion: Seven o'clock! That's early!
Nicola will wake up at five!

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Five? Last year it was half four! Right, put that back. If Mum sees us, no presents for anyone!

translations.fa: پنج؟ پارسال چهار و نیم بود! خب، اونو بذار سر جاش. اگه مامان ببینه، به هیچ‌کس کادو نمی‌رسه!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: It's Easter Sunday! We're having an egg hunt in the garden. Will you help me hide the eggs?

translations.fa: یکشنبهٔ عید پاکه! تو حیاط تخم‌مرغ‌بازی داریم. کمکم می‌کنی تخم‌مرغ‌ها را قایم کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! What's an egg hunt?
Are they chocolate eggs?

cultureNote.en: At Easter, British children look for small chocolate eggs hidden in the garden.
cultureNote.fa: شکار تخم‌مرغ شکلاتی.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Little chocolate eggs. We hide them, and the kids find them. Put one under that flowerpot.

translations.fa: تخم‌مرغ‌های شکلاتی کوچیک. ما قایمشون می‌کنیم، بچه‌ها پیداشون می‌کنن. یکی زیر اون گلدون بذار.

branches.suggestion: One under the flowerpot.
Shall I put one in the tree?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Yes, in the tree, not too high. Nicola can't reach. And two behind the shed.

translations.fa: آره، تو درخت، نه خیلی بالا. دست نیکولا نمی‌رسه. و دو تا پشت انباری.

branches.suggestion: Behind the shed. Done!
How many eggs are there?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Twenty. Ten for Nicola, ten for Mia. Ryan says he's "too old". But I saw him eating one!

translations.fa: بیست تا. ده تا برای نیکولا، ده تا برای میا. رایان میگه «زیادی بزرگه». ولی دیدم داره یکی می‌خوره!

branches.suggestion: Ha! Nobody is too old for chocolate.
branches.suggestionFa: ها! هیچ‌کس برای شکلات زیادی بزرگ نیست.

branches.suggestion: Should we hide some for Ryan?

match: nobody is too old of chocolate
recasts.echo: Too old for chocolate? Never!
recasts.better: Nobody is too old for chocolate.
recasts.betterFa: هیچ‌کس برای شکلات زیادی بزرگ نیست.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Can we start? Can we START? I've got my basket!

translations.fa: می‌تونیم شروع کنیم؟ می‌تونیم شروع کنیم؟ سبدم را آوردم!

branches.suggestion: Ready, steady, go!
Look under the flowerpot!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: I found one! And another one! There's one behind the shed! Mia, there's one in the tree!

translations.fa: یکی پیدا کردم! و یکی دیگه! پشت انباری یکی هست! میا، تو درخت یکی هست!

branches.suggestion: Well done, girls!
Don't eat them all now!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Too late! Chocolate faces! Ha! Happy Easter, everyone. Do people have chocolate eggs in Iran?

translations.fa: دیر شد! صورت‌های شکلاتی! ها! عید پاک مبارک همه. تو ایران تخم‌مرغ شکلاتی دارید؟

branches.suggestion: No, but we paint eggs at Nowruz!
branches.suggestionFa: نه، ولی تو نوروز تخم‌مرغ رنگ می‌کنیم!

branches.suggestion: We have painted eggs on the haft-sin.
branches.suggestionFa: رو سفرهٔ هفت‌سین تخم‌مرغ رنگی داریم.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Painted eggs! Next spring, let's do both — painted eggs AND chocolate eggs. Best of both worlds!

translations.fa: تخم‌مرغ رنگی! بهار بعد، بیا هر دو را انجام بدیم — تخم‌مرغ رنگی و شکلاتی. بهترین هر دو دنیا!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Two minutes to midnight! Everybody, get your drinks! The fireworks are on the telly!

translations.fa: دو دقیقه به نیمه‌شب! همه، نوشیدنی‌هاتون را بردارید! آتش‌بازی تو تلویزیونه!

branches.suggestion: I've got my juice!
Where are the fireworks?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: By the river, at Big Ben. Millions of people watch it. Ten seconds! Count with me!

translations.fa: کنار رودخونه، کنار بیگ بن. میلیون‌ها نفر نگاش می‌کنن. ده ثانیه! با من بشمرید!

branches.suggestion: Ten, nine, eight…
Three, two, one…

cultureNote.en: On New Year's Eve, London's fireworks over the Thames start when Big Ben strikes midnight.
cultureNote.fa: آتش‌بازی سال نو لندن.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: HAPPY NEW YEAR! Happy New Year, love! Happy New Year, {you}!

translations.fa: سال نو مبارک! سال نو مبارک عزیزم! سال نو مبارک {you}!

branches.suggestion: Happy New Year, Tom!
Happy New Year, everyone!

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Now — New Year's resolutions! What are you going to do this year?

translations.fa: حالا — تصمیم‌های سال نو! امسال می‌خوای چی کار کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I'm going to speak better English.
I'm going to find a job.

cultureNote.en: New Year's resolutions are promises to yourself — like doing more exercise. Most are forgotten by February!
cultureNote.fa: تصمیم‌های سال نو.

recasts.echo: You're going to find a job? Brilliant!
recasts.better: I'm going to find a job.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Brilliant! Mine is… I'm going to tell fewer jokes.

translations.fa: عالی! مال من… می‌خوام کمتر جوک بگم.

branches.suggestion: No, Tom! We love your jokes!
That's a good one!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Ha! He says that every year. Mine is to drink less coffee.

translations.fa: ها! هر سال همینو میگه. مال من اینه که کمتر قهوه بخورم.

branches.suggestion: That's hard, Leslie!
Good luck with that!

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Now we hold hands and sing "Auld Lang Syne". It's Scottish. Nobody knows the words!

translations.fa: حالا دست همدیگه را می‌گیریم و «اولد لنگ ساین» می‌خونیم. اسکاتلندیه. هیچ‌کس کلماتش را بلد نیست!

branches.suggestion: I don't know the words either!
Just hum, then!

cultureNote.en: At midnight, people cross arms, hold hands and sing "Auld Lang Syne", an old Scottish song.
cultureNote.fa: آهنگ اولد لنگ ساین.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Perfect! When is your New Year, {you}? Nowruz, in March? Then we can celebrate twice. Two New Years!

translations.fa: عالی! سال نو تو کیه {you}؟ نوروز، تو مارس؟ پس می‌تونیم دو بار جشن بگیریم. دو تا سال نو!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Morning, neighbour! Kettle's on. Here's a funny thing — I don't know much about your country.

translations.fa: صبح بخیر همسایه! کتری روشنه. یه چیز جالب — من زیاد دربارهٔ کشورت نمی‌دونم.

branches.suggestion: I'm from Iran. From Tehran.
Ask me anything!

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Tehran! Is it a big city? Bigger than London?

translations.fa: تهران! شهر بزرگیه؟ بزرگ‌تر از لندن؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, it's very big. About nine million people.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، خیلی بزرگه. حدود نُه میلیون نفر.

branches.suggestion: It's big and very busy. Lots of traffic!
branches.suggestionFa: بزرگ و خیلی شلوغه. ترافیک زیاد!

recasts.echo: Very big? Wow!

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Traffic! Don't talk to me about traffic. I drive the 38 bus! Where is Iran, exactly?

translations.fa: ترافیک! از ترافیک برام نگو. من اتوبوس ۳۸ را می‌رونم! ایران دقیقاً کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: It's in the Middle East, next to Turkey.
It's in Asia, south of the Caspian Sea.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Ah, I see. Is it hot there? It's never hot here. Well, one day in July.

translations.fa: آها. اونجا گرمه؟ اینجا هیچ‌وقت گرم نیست. خب، یه روز تو ژوئیه.

branches.suggestion: It's hot in summer and cold in winter.
Tehran has snow in winter! And mountains.
branches.suggestionFa: تهران زمستون برف داره! و کوه.

cultureNote.en: British people love talking about the weather. It's an easy way to start a chat.
cultureNote.fa: بریتانیایی‌ها عاشق حرف زدن دربارهٔ هوا هستند.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Snow and mountains? Brilliant. What is Iran famous for?

translations.fa: برف و کوه؟ عالیه. ایران به چی معروفه؟

branches.suggestion: It's famous for carpets and pistachios.
Old cities, poetry and good food.
branches.suggestionFa: شهرهای قدیمی، شعر و غذای خوب.

recasts.echo: Famous for carpets? Lovely.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Pistachios! I love them. Leslie hides them from me. What do people eat for breakfast?

translations.fa: پسته! عاشقشم. لزلی ازم قایمشون می‌کنه. مردم صبحونه چی می‌خورن؟

branches.suggestion: Bread, cheese and tea. Sometimes eggs.
branches.suggestionFa: نون، پنیر و چای. گاهی تخم‌مرغ.

branches.suggestion: Flat bread with butter and jam. And tea!
branches.suggestionFa: نون صاف با کره و مربا. و چای!

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Tea for breakfast! Same as us. Do you drink it with milk?

translations.fa: چای برای صبحونه! مثل ما. با شیر می‌خورید؟

branches.suggestion: No, no milk! We drink it with sugar.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، شیر نه! با قند می‌خوریم.

branches.suggestion: No milk. Black tea in a small glass.
branches.suggestionFa: بی‌شیر. چای سیاه تو استکان کوچیک.

cultureNote.en: Most British people drink tea with milk. Ask "Milk?" before you make someone a cup.
cultureNote.fa: بیشتر بریتانیایی‌ها چای را با شیر می‌نوشند.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: In a glass? No milk? Don't tell my mum. She'll faint! Here — one tea, British style. Try it.

translations.fa: تو لیوان؟ بی‌شیر؟ به مامانم نگو. غش می‌کنه! بیا — یه چای، به سبک بریتانیایی. امتحانش کن.

branches.suggestion: Mmm. It's… different. But nice!
branches.suggestionFa: ممم. یه‌کم… فرق داره. ولی خوبه!

branches.suggestion: Thanks, Tom. Next time, I'll make Persian tea.
branches.suggestionFa: ممنون تام. دفعهٔ بعد، من چای ایرانی درست می‌کنم.

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Deal! Persian tea next time. And bring pistachios. Don't tell Leslie!

translations.fa: قبول! دفعهٔ بعد چای ایرانی. و پسته بیار. به لزلی نگو!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Hello! Mummy says you speak TWO languages. Is that true?

translations.fa: سلام! مامان میگه تو دو تا زبان حرف می‌زنی. راسته؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. I speak Persian and English.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. فارسی و انگلیسی حرف می‌زنم.

branches.suggestion: Yes! Persian is my first language.

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: Wow! I only speak English. And a bit of French. Bonjour!

translations.fa: واو! من فقط انگلیسی حرف می‌زنم. و یه کوچولو فرانسوی. بونژور!

branches.suggestion: Bonjour, Nicola! Very good!
You speak French? Clever girl!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: We learn it at school. How do you say "hello" in Persian?

translations.fa: تو مدرسه یاد می‌گیریم. «سلام» را فارسی چی میگن؟

branches.suggestion: We say "salaam".
"Salaam". Can you say it?

recasts.echo: How do you say it? Salaam!

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Sa-laam! Salaam! I can speak Persian now! What about "thank you"?

translations.fa: سَ-لام! سلام! حالا من فارسی بلدم! «ممنون» چی؟

branches.suggestion: "Merci". Like French!
We say "mamnoon" or "merci".

cultureNote.en: Many languages share words. Persian uses "merci" for thanks, just like French.
cultureNote.fa: زبان‌ها واژه‌های مشترک دارند.

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: Merci?! That's French! Persian is easy-peasy! Do you speak English at home?

translations.fa: مرسی؟! این فرانسویه! فارسی خیلی آسونه! تو خونه انگلیسی حرف می‌زنی؟

branches.suggestion: No. I speak Persian to my mum on the phone.
branches.suggestionFa: نه. پشت تلفن با مامانم فارسی حرف می‌زنم.

branches.suggestion: I live alone, so I talk to the telly!
branches.suggestionFa: تنها زندگی می‌کنم، پس با تلویزیون حرف می‌زنم!

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Ha! Daddy talks to the telly too. When there's football. Is English hard?

translations.fa: ها! بابا هم با تلویزیون حرف می‌زنه. وقتی فوتباله. انگلیسی سخته؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, a bit. Spelling is very hard!
Sometimes. People speak very fast here.
branches.suggestionFa: گاهی. مردم اینجا خیلی تند حرف می‌زنن.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Spelling IS hard. "Knife" has a K! Why? Nobody knows. Not even Miss Ellis.

translations.fa: املا واقعاً سخته. «نایف» یه K داره! چرا؟ هیچ‌کس نمی‌دونه. حتی خانم الیس.

branches.suggestion: English is a funny language.
Can you teach me some new words?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونی چندتا کلمهٔ جدید یادم بدی؟

n8.speaker: nicola
n8.text: Yes! I'll teach you English, and you teach me Persian. Every day! Salaam! Merci! I'm so clever.

translations.fa: آره! من بهت انگلیسی یاد میدم، تو بهم فارسی. هر روز! سلام! مرسی! من خیلی باهوشم.

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Come and sit down. I've just made some toast. So, tell me about your family back home.

translations.fa: بیا بشین. تازه نون تست درست کردم. خب، از خانواده‌ات تو ایران بگو.

branches.suggestion: Thanks. Well, I've got a mum, a dad and a sister.
branches.suggestionFa: ممنون. خب، یه مامان، یه بابا و یه خواهر دارم.

branches.suggestion: I've got a big family! Two brothers and a sister.
branches.suggestionFa: خانوادهٔ بزرگی دارم! دو تا برادر و یه خواهر.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Lovely. Do they all live in Tehran?

translations.fa: چه خوب. همه‌شون تهران زندگی می‌کنن؟

branches.suggestion: My parents live in Tehran. My sister lives in Shiraz.
branches.suggestionFa: پدر و مادرم تهران زندگی می‌کنن. خواهرم شیراز.

branches.suggestion: Yes, they all live in the same street!
branches.suggestionFa: آره، همه‌شون تو یه خیابون زندگی می‌کنن!

recasts.echo: Your parents live in Tehran?
recasts.betterFa: پدر و مادرم در تهران زندگی می‌کنند.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: My sister lives in Leeds, so I know the feeling. What does your dad do?

translations.fa: خواهر من لیدز زندگی می‌کنه، پس این حس را می‌شناسم. بابات چی کاره‌ست؟

branches.suggestion: He's a teacher. He teaches maths.
He's retired now. He was an engineer.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: A teacher, like me! And your mum?

translations.fa: معلم، مثل من! مامانت چی؟

branches.suggestion: She's a nurse. She works at a hospital.
She works at home. She's the boss of the family!
branches.suggestionFa: تو خونه کار می‌کنه. رئیس خانواده‌ست!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Ha! Every family has a boss. In this house it's Nana Maggie. Do you miss them?

translations.fa: ها! هر خانواده‌ای یه رئیس داره. تو این خونه نانا مگیه. دلت براشون تنگ میشه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, very much. I call them every Sunday.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، خیلی. هر یکشنبه بهشون زنگ می‌زنم.

branches.suggestion: Yes. I miss my mum's cooking most!
branches.suggestionFa: آره. بیشتر از همه دلم برای دست‌پخت مامانم تنگ میشه!

cultureNote.en: In Britain, "Nana" or "Nan" is a warm name for a grandmother.
cultureNote.fa: Nana یا Nan نام محبت‌آمیز مادربزرگ است.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Of course you do. Have you got any photos? I'd love to see them.

translations.fa: معلومه. عکس داری؟ دوست دارم ببینم.

branches.suggestion: Yes, here on my phone. This is my sister and her baby.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، اینجا تو گوشیم. این خواهرمه با بچه‌اش.

branches.suggestion: This is my mum and dad in their garden.
branches.suggestionFa: این مامان و بابامن تو باغچه‌شون.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Oh, how gorgeous! Look at those roses! You look just like your mum, you know.

translations.fa: وای، چه قشنگ! اون گل‌های رز را ببین! می‌دونی، خیلی شبیه مامانتی.

branches.suggestion: Everybody says that!
Really? My sister says I look like Dad.

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Well, you're welcome here any time. You're part of the family now. Next Sunday, call them from our kitchen!

translations.fa: خب، هر وقت بخوای اینجا قدمت روی چشمه. حالا دیگه جزو خانواده‌ای. یکشنبهٔ بعد از آشپزخونهٔ ما بهشون زنگ بزن!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Alright? Mum says you came to England this year. What was your first week like?

translations.fa: چطوری؟ مامان میگه امسال اومدی انگلیس. هفتهٔ اولت چطور بود؟

branches.suggestion: It was strange! Everything was new.
branches.suggestionFa: عجیب بود! همه چی جدید بود.

branches.suggestion: It was hard, but exciting.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Strange how? Like, the food?

translations.fa: عجیب یعنی چی؟ مثلاً غذا؟

branches.suggestion: The food, the weather, and driving on the left!
branches.suggestionFa: غذا، هوا، و رانندگی از سمت چپ!

branches.suggestion: Everything. The buses, the shops, the money!

recasts.echo: On the left? Yeah, it's weird.
recasts.betterFa: مردم از سمت چپ رانندگی می‌کنند.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Ha, yeah. Did you get lost? I got lost in Westfield once. For two hours.

translations.fa: ها، آره. گم شدی؟ من یه بار تو وست‌فیلد گم شدم. دو ساعت.

branches.suggestion: Yes! I took the wrong bus on my first day.
branches.suggestionFa: آره! روز اول اتوبوس اشتباه سوار شدم.

branches.suggestion: No, I used the map on my phone.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، از نقشهٔ گوشیم استفاده کردم.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: The wrong bus! Did you tell Dad? He'll say it was the 38. It's always the 38.

translations.fa: اتوبوس اشتباه! به بابا گفتی؟ میگه ۳۸ بوده. همیشه ۳۸ه.

branches.suggestion: No! I didn't tell anyone.
It wasn't the 38. It was the 55!

recasts.echo: You didn't tell him? Smart.

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Smart. What did you eat that first week? Please say not just beans on toast.

translations.fa: زرنگ. اون هفتهٔ اول چی خوردی؟ تو رو خدا نگو فقط لوبیا با نون تست.

branches.suggestion: I ate fish and chips. It was great!
branches.suggestionFa: ماهی و سیب‌زمینی خوردم. عالی بود!

branches.suggestion: I cooked rice every day. I didn't know the shops.
branches.suggestionFa: هر روز برنج پختم. مغازه‌ها را نمی‌شناختم.

cultureNote.en: Fish and chips is a classic British takeaway, often eaten on Fridays.
cultureNote.fa: ماهی و سیب‌زمینی غذای بیرون‌بر کلاسیک بریتانیاست.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Respect. What was the weirdest thing?

translations.fa: دمت گرم. عجیب‌ترین چیز چی بود؟

branches.suggestion: People say "sorry" all the time!
Everyone queues. Even at the bus stop!
branches.suggestionFa: همه صف وایمیستن. حتی تو ایستگاه اتوبوس!

cultureNote.en: Queuing is very important in Britain. Pushing in is very rude.
cultureNote.fa: صف ایستادن در بریتانیا خیلی مهم است.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Sorry about that. Ha! See, I did it. Was anyone nice to you?

translations.fa: ببخشید بابتش. ها! دیدی، منم گفتم. کسی باهات مهربون بود؟

branches.suggestion: Your mum and dad. They invited me for tea.
branches.suggestionFa: مامان و بابات. منو برای عصرونه دعوت کردن.

branches.suggestion: Nicola gave me a drawing. It was a cat!
branches.suggestionFa: نیکولا یه نقاشی بهم داد. یه گربه بود!

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: A cat? That was you, mate. She draws everyone as a cat. Anyway — welcome to Hackney!

translations.fa: گربه؟ اون تو بودی رفیق. همه را گربه می‌کشه. به هر حال — به هاکنی خوش اومدی!

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Morning. You look tired. What did you do last night?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر. خسته به نظر میای. دیشب چی کار کردی؟

branches.suggestion: I watched a film and stayed up late.
branches.suggestionFa: یه فیلم دیدم و تا دیروقت بیدار موندم.

branches.suggestion: I worked late and then cooked dinner.
branches.suggestionFa: تا دیروقت کار کردم و بعد شام درست کردم.

cultureNote.en: British vs American: film (UK) = movie (US); the cinema (UK) = the movies (US).
cultureNote.fa: film (بریتانیا) = movie (آمریکا).

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Same. I played FIFA till two. Mum shouted at me twice! Did you enjoy your film?

translations.fa: منم. تا ساعت دو فیفا بازی کردم. مامان دوبار سرم داد زد! از فیلمت لذت بردی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I really enjoyed it. It was funny.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، خیلی لذت بردم. خنده‌دار بود.

branches.suggestion: Not really. It was boring, so I stopped it.
branches.suggestionFa: نه زیاد. خسته‌کننده بود، پس قطعش کردم.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Fair enough. On Saturday I helped Dad in the garden. We cleaned the shed. It was minging!

translations.fa: منصفانه‌ست. شنبه به بابا تو باغچه کمک کردم. انباری را تمیز کردیم. حال‌به‌هم‌زن بود!

branches.suggestion: What does "minging" mean?
Did you find anything interesting?

cultureNote.en: "Minging" is British slang for very dirty or disgusting. Don't use it with your boss!
cultureNote.fa: «minging» عامیانهٔ بریتانیایی برای خیلی کثیف است.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: It means really dirty. We found Dad's old guitar! He played it for us. Badly.

translations.fa: یعنی خیلی کثیف. گیتار قدیمی بابا را پیدا کردیم! برامون زد. افتضاح.

branches.suggestion: Ha! Did he sing too?
That's lovely. Did he use to play in a band?
branches.suggestionFa: چه قشنگ. قبلاً تو گروه موسیقی می‌زد؟

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: He tried! Nicola covered her ears. Then on Sunday I visited my mate Josh.

translations.fa: سعی کرد! نیکولا گوش‌هاش را گرفت. بعد یکشنبه رفتم پیش رفیقم جاش.

branches.suggestion: What did you do at Josh's?
Did you walk there?

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: We walked to the park and played football. Then it rained, so we watched telly at his.

translations.fa: پیاده رفتیم پارک و فوتبال بازی کردیم. بعد بارون اومد، پس خونه‌اش تلویزیون دیدیم.

branches.suggestion: Typical British weekend!
Did you finish your homework too?

recasts.echo: Did you finish it?

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Homework? Er… I started it. Don't tell Mum, yeah?

translations.fa: تکلیف؟ اِم… شروعش کردم. به مامان نگی، باشه؟

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Oh, this is nice. I don't often have a day off! Did you have a good week?

translations.fa: آه، چه خوب. من زیاد روز تعطیل ندارم! هفتهٔ خوبی داشتی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I had a great week, thanks.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، هفتهٔ خیلی خوبی داشتم، ممنون.

branches.suggestion: It was busy. I went to work every day.
branches.suggestionFa: شلوغ بود. هر روز رفتم سر کار.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Me too. On Wednesday I saw a play with my sister in town. It was brilliant.

translations.fa: منم. چهارشنبه با خواهرم تو شهر یه نمایش دیدم. عالی بود.

branches.suggestion: What did you see?
I love the theatre. Where did you go?

cultureNote.en: British spelling: theatre and centre. American: theater and center.
cultureNote.fa: املای بریتانیایی theatre و centre است.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: We went to the Royal. Then we ate at a little Italian place and I had far too much pudding!

translations.fa: رفتیم تئاتر رویال. بعد تو یه رستوران کوچیک ایتالیایی غذا خوردیم و من زیادی دسر خوردم!

branches.suggestion: What did you have?
Pudding is the best part!

cultureNote.en: In Britain "pudding" often just means dessert: "What's for pudding?"
cultureNote.fa: در بریتانیا pudding اغلب یعنی دسر.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Tiramisu. Then I bought Nicola some new shoes. She grew two sizes this year!

translations.fa: تیرامیسو. بعد برای نیکولا کفش نو خریدم. امسال دو سایز بزرگ شد!

branches.suggestion: Children grow so fast.
Did she like the shoes?

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: She loved them. She wore them to bed! What did you do on Saturday?

translations.fa: عاشقشون شد. با کفش خوابید! تو شنبه چی کار کردی؟

branches.suggestion: I went to the market and bought some fruit.
branches.suggestionFa: رفتم بازار و یه کم میوه خریدم.

branches.suggestion: I met a friend and we had lunch.
branches.suggestionFa: یه دوست را دیدم و ناهار خوردیم.

recasts.echo: You bought some?

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: That sounds lovely. Ooh — Callum's bringing our coffees. Thank you, Callum!

translations.fa: چه خوب. اوه — کالوم داره قهوه‌هامون را میاره. ممنون کالوم!

branches.suggestion: Thanks, Callum!
Perfect timing!

n7.speaker: callum
n7.text: There you go, ladies. One flat white, one latte. Did you two have a good weekend?

translations.fa: بفرمایید خانم‌ها. یه فلت‌وایت، یه لاته. آخر هفته خوش گذشت؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, thanks. It was lovely.
Not bad. How was yours?
branches.suggestionFa: بد نبود. مال تو چطور بود؟

n8.speaker: callum
n8.text: Grand, thanks. I went to Brighton and got sunburnt — in October!

translations.fa: عالی، ممنون. رفتم برایتون و آفتاب‌سوخته شدم — تو اکتبر!

n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Mr Bennett found this old photo in the local history section. Look — that's me, in 1972!

translations.fa: آقای بنت این عکس قدیمی را تو بخش تاریخ محلی پیدا کرد. ببین — این منم، سال ۱۹۷۲!

branches.suggestion: Wow! You were so young!
Where was this photo taken?

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: That was outside the old cinema on the High Street. It isn't there any more — it's a gym now!

translations.fa: جلوی سینمای قدیمی خیابون اصلی بود. دیگه نیست — الان باشگاهه!

branches.suggestion: What was the High Street like then?
branches.suggestionFa: خیابون اصلی اون موقع چطور بود؟

branches.suggestion: That's a shame. I love old cinemas.

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: There were lots of little shops — a butcher, a fishmonger, a sweet shop. We used to buy sweets in paper bags.

translations.fa: پر از مغازه‌های کوچیک بود — قصابی، ماهی‌فروشی، آب‌نبات‌فروشی. قبلاً آب‌نبات را تو پاکت کاغذی می‌خریدیم.

branches.suggestion: How much were sweets back then?
Did you use to go there every day?

cultureNote.en: British vs American: sweets (UK) = candy (US).
cultureNote.fa: sweets (بریتانیا) = candy (آمریکا).

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Pennies! And we didn't have a telly at first. We used to listen to the radio every evening.

translations.fa: چند پنی! و اولش تلویزیون نداشتیم. هر شب رادیو گوش می‌دادیم.

branches.suggestion: Was it boring without a telly?
What did you listen to?

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: Not at all! We played cards, we sang songs, and my dad told stories. They were happy days.

translations.fa: اصلاً! ورق بازی می‌کردیم، آواز می‌خوندیم و بابام قصه می‌گفت. روزهای خوشی بودن.

branches.suggestion: Your family sounds lovely.
branches.suggestionFa: خانواده‌تون خیلی خوب به نظر میان.

branches.suggestion: Were you a good student at school?

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: Ha! I was terrible at maths, but I loved reading. That's why I come to the library now, dear.

translations.fa: ها! تو ریاضی افتضاح بودم، ولی عاشق کتاب خوندن بودم. واسه همینه که الان میام کتابخونه عزیزم.

branches.suggestion: What do you like reading now?
I was bad at maths too!
branches.suggestionFa: من هم تو ریاضی بد بودم!

cultureNote.en: British vs American: maths (UK) = math (US).
cultureNote.fa: maths (بریتانیا) = math (آمریکا).

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: Murder mysteries! Agatha Christie, mostly. Now, would you like to see more photos?

translations.fa: داستان‌های جنایی! بیشتر آگاتا کریستی. حالا، می‌خوای عکس‌های بیشتری ببینی؟

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Hello again! Did you watch the match on Saturday?

translations.fa: دوباره سلام! شنبه مسابقه را دیدی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I did. What a game!
No, I didn't. Who won?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: We lost, two-one. I went with Ryan. We didn't score until the ninetieth minute!

translations.fa: باختیم، دو-یک. با رایان رفتم. تا دقیقهٔ نود گل نزدیم!

branches.suggestion: That's bad luck. Did Ryan enjoy it?
Did you go to the stadium?

cultureNote.en: Brits say "two-one" for 2–1 and "nil" for zero: "We won one-nil."
cultureNote.fa: بریتانیایی‌ها برای صفر می‌گویند «nil».

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Yeah, we got the train to the ground. It was freezing! Ryan didn't bring a coat, of course.

translations.fa: آره، با قطار رفتیم ورزشگاه. یخ‌بندون بود! رایان طبق معمول کت نیاورد.

branches.suggestion: Did he get cold?
Teenagers never bring coats!

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: He borrowed my scarf. Then he spilt his Bovril all over it!

translations.fa: شال‌گردن منو قرض گرفت. بعد بوریلش را ریخت روش!

branches.suggestion: What's Bovril?
Oh no! Did it wash out?
branches.suggestionFa: ای وای! با شستن پاک شد؟

cultureNote.en: Bovril is a hot, salty beef drink — a classic at British football grounds in winter.
cultureNote.fa: Bovril یک نوشیدنی داغ و شور گوشتی است، کلاسیک ورزشگاه‌های بریتانیا.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Leslie washed it twice. It still smells a bit beefy! Did you do anything nice at the weekend?

translations.fa: لزلی دوبار شستش. هنوز یه کم بوی گوشت میده! تو آخر هفته کار جالبی کردی؟

branches.suggestion: I didn't do much. I stayed at home and rested.
branches.suggestionFa: کار زیادی نکردم. خونه موندم و استراحت کردم.

branches.suggestion: I went to a museum. It was free!

cultureNote.en: Many big museums in Britain are free, like the British Museum and the Natural History Museum.
cultureNote.fa: بسیاری از موزه‌های بزرگ بریتانیا رایگان‌اند.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Good for you. Right, here's your stop. Next Saturday, come to the match with us!

translations.fa: آفرین. خب، اینم ایستگاهت. شنبهٔ بعد با ما بیا مسابقه!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Right, let's test you! You need to post a parcel. How do you ask the way to the post office?

translations.fa: خب، بیا امتحانت کنیم! باید یه بسته پست کنی. چطوری راه اداره پست را می‌پرسی؟

branches.suggestion: Excuse me, where's the post office, please?
Excuse me, how do I get to the post office?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Perfect. And I say: go straight on, past the bakery, then turn left at the traffic lights.

translations.fa: عالیه. و من می‌گم: مستقیم برو، از نونوایی رد شو، بعد سر چراغ راهنمایی بپیچ چپ.

branches.suggestion: Straight on, past the bakery, then left.
branches.suggestionFa: مستقیم، رد شدن از نونوایی، بعد چپ.

branches.suggestion: Sorry, could you say that again, please?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Good! It's on the right, opposite the church, next to the chemist. You can't miss it.

translations.fa: خوبه! سمت راسته، روبروی کلیسا، کنار داروخونه. نمی‌شه نبینیش.

branches.suggestion: Opposite the church. Got it!
What does "you can't miss it" mean?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: It means it's easy to find. Brits say it a lot — even when it's very easy to miss!

translations.fa: یعنی پیدا کردنش آسونه. بریتانیایی‌ها زیاد می‌گن — حتی وقتی خیلی راحت می‌شه ندیدش!

branches.suggestion: Ha! I'll remember that.
Is it far from here?

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: About five minutes on foot. Now you try. I'm a tourist. Where's the train station?

translations.fa: حدود پنج دقیقه پیاده. حالا تو امتحان کن. من توریستم. ایستگاه قطار کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: Go straight on and take the second right.
branches.suggestionFa: مستقیم برو و دومین خیابون سمت راست را برو.

branches.suggestion: It's at the end of this road, on the left.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Brilliant! And if you're not sure, just say "Sorry, I'm not from round here."

translations.fa: عالی! و اگه مطمئن نیستی، فقط بگو «ببخشید، من اهل اینجا نیستم.»

branches.suggestion: Sorry, I'm not from round here.
That's a useful phrase. Thanks!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: You're a natural. Come on, let's actually go to the post office now!

translations.fa: تو استعدادشو داری. بیا، حالا واقعاً بریم اداره پست!

n1.speaker: arthur
n1.text: Next, please! Morning. What can I do for you today?

translations.fa: نفر بعدی لطفاً! صبح بخیر. امروز چه کمکی می‌تونم بکنم؟

branches.suggestion: I'd like to send this parcel to Iran, please.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌خوام این بسته را بفرستم ایران لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Can I post this parcel, please?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم این بسته را پست کنم لطفاً؟

cultureNote.en: Queue patiently at the post office. Pushing in is one of the rudest things you can do in Britain!
cultureNote.fa: در اداره پست با صبر در صف بایست. خارج از نوبت رفتن خیلی بی‌ادبی است!

n2.speaker: arthur
n2.text: Right you are. Pop it on the scales. Hmm, two kilos. What's inside?

translations.fa: باشه. بذارش روی ترازو. هوم، دو کیلو. داخلش چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Some clothes and a few books.
Just presents for my family.

n3.speaker: arthur
n3.text: Any liquids? Batteries? Food? I have to ask, I'm afraid.

translations.fa: مایعات؟ باتری؟ غذا؟ متأسفانه باید بپرسم.

branches.suggestion: No, there isn't any food.
Just a little tea. Is that OK?
branches.suggestionFa: فقط یه کم چای. اشکال داره؟

n4.speaker: arthur
n4.text: A little tea is fine. How many books are there? It affects the customs form.

translations.fa: یه کم چای اشکال نداره. چندتا کتاب هست؟ روی فرم گمرک اثر داره.

branches.suggestion: There are three books.
Not many — only two.

n5.speaker: arthur
n5.text: Lovely. Standard or tracked? Standard is cheaper but it takes about two weeks.

translations.fa: عالی. معمولی یا با رهگیری؟ معمولی ارزون‌تره ولی حدود دو هفته طول می‌کشه.

branches.suggestion: How much is tracked?
Standard is fine, thanks.

n6.speaker: arthur
n6.text: Tracked is thirty-two pounds forty. Standard is twenty-four ninety.

translations.fa: با رهگیری سی‌ودو پوند و چهل. معمولی بیست‌وچهار و نود.

branches.suggestion: I'll take tracked, please.
That's a lot of money! Standard, please.

n7.speaker: arthur
n7.text: No problem. Card machine's there. Need any stamps while you're here?

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست. دستگاه کارت اونجاست. تا اینجایی تمبر لازم داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, can I have some first-class stamps?
branches.suggestionFa: آره، می‌شه چندتا تمبر درجه‌یک بدید؟

branches.suggestion: No, that's everything, thanks.

cultureNote.en: British stamps are "first class" (faster) or "second class" (cheaper).
cultureNote.fa: تمبرهای بریتانیا درجه‌یک (سریع‌تر) یا درجه‌دو (ارزان‌تر) هستند.

n8.speaker: arthur
n8.text: Smashing. There's your receipt — keep it safe for tracking. Ta-ra, now!

translations.fa: عالی. اینم رسیدت — برای رهگیری نگهش دار. خدانگهدار!

n1.speaker: doris
n1.text: Hello, duck! You look lost again. Where are you off to today?

translations.fa: سلام عزیزم! باز گم‌شده به نظر میای. امروز کجا می‌ری؟

branches.suggestion: I'm going to the hospital. Which bus is best?
branches.suggestionFa: دارم می‌رم بیمارستان. کدوم اتوبوس بهتره؟

branches.suggestion: I need to get to the train station.

n2.speaker: doris
n2.text: Ooh, you can take the 38 or the 12. The 38 is quicker, but the 12 is cheaper.

translations.fa: اوه، می‌تونی ۳۸ یا ۱۲ را سوار شی. ۳۸ سریع‌تره، ولی ۱۲ ارزون‌تر.

branches.suggestion: Why is the 12 cheaper?
I'm in a hurry, so the quicker one.

n3.speaker: doris
n3.text: It's a smaller company. But the seats on the 38 are more comfortable. And Tom drives it!

translations.fa: شرکتش کوچیک‌تره. ولی صندلی‌های ۳۸ راحت‌ترن. و تام رانندگیش می‌کنه!

branches.suggestion: Then the 38 is better!
Is Tom a better driver?

n4.speaker: doris
n4.text: Much better than the young lad on the 12. He drives faster than a racing car!

translations.fa: خیلی بهتر از اون پسر جوون اتوبوس ۱۲. از ماشین مسابقه هم تندتر می‌رونه!

branches.suggestion: That sounds scary!
Is the 38 more expensive?

n5.speaker: doris
n5.text: A little. Two pounds instead of one eighty. But it's safer. Have you got a bus pass?

translations.fa: یه کم. دو پوند به جای یک و هشتاد. ولی امن‌تره. کارت اتوبوس داری؟

branches.suggestion: No. Is a bus pass cheaper?
I pay with my phone.

cultureNote.en: You can tap a contactless card or phone on most UK buses. Weekly passes are cheaper if you travel a lot.
cultureNote.fa: در بیشتر اتوبوس‌های بریتانیا می‌توان با کارت بدون تماس یا گوشی پرداخت کرد.

n6.speaker: doris
n6.text: Much cheaper if you travel every day. And at my age, it's free! Lovely, isn't it?

translations.fa: اگه هر روز سفر کنی خیلی ارزون‌تره. و به سن من که برسی، مجانیه! خوبه، نه؟

branches.suggestion: Free? That's the best thing about getting older!
branches.suggestionFa: مجانی؟ بهترین چیز پیر شدن همینه!

branches.suggestion: That's very fair.

n7.speaker: doris
n7.text: Ha! Here comes the 38 now. Wave your hand, love — he won't stop if you don't!

translations.fa: ها! ۳۸ داره میاد. دستت را تکون بده عزیزم — اگه تکون ندی وای نمیسته!

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Right, I'm taking you to London for the day! Have you ever been on a British train?

translations.fa: خب، امروز می‌برمت لندن! تا حالا سوار قطار بریتانیا شدی؟

branches.suggestion: No, never. Is it expensive?
Yes, once. It was very crowded.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، یه بار. خیلی شلوغ بود.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: It can be the most expensive thing in Britain! Let's ask Maya. She knows the cheapest tickets.

translations.fa: می‌تونه گرون‌ترین چیز بریتانیا باشه! بیا از مایا بپرسیم. ارزون‌ترین بلیت‌ها را می‌شناسه.

branches.suggestion: Who's Maya?
Great idea. Let's ask her.

n3.speaker: maya
n3.text: Hiya, Tom! Off to London? The cheapest option is an off-peak return. It's after half nine.

translations.fa: سلام تام! لندن می‌رید؟ ارزون‌ترین گزینه بلیت رفت‌وبرگشت غیرپیکه. بعد از نه و نیم.

branches.suggestion: What does off-peak mean?
Which is the fastest train?

cultureNote.en: Off-peak means outside the busiest times. Tickets are often half the price.
cultureNote.fa: off-peak یعنی خارج از شلوغ‌ترین ساعات؛ بلیت‌ها اغلب نصف قیمت‌اند.

n4.speaker: maya
n4.text: Off-peak is the quietest time, not the rush hour. The fastest train is the 9:42. It's direct.

translations.fa: غیرپیک یعنی خلوت‌ترین زمان، نه ساعت شلوغی. سریع‌ترین قطار ساعت ۹:۴۲ه. مستقیمه.

branches.suggestion: Two off-peak returns, please.
Which platform is it?

n5.speaker: maya
n5.text: Platform four. Have you got a railcard? It's the best way to save money.

translations.fa: سکوی چهار. کارت تخفیف قطار داری؟ بهترین راه برای پس‌انداز پوله.

branches.suggestion: No. What's a railcard?
Yes, I've got a sixteen-to-twenty-five railcard.

n6.speaker: maya
n6.text: It's a discount card — a third off every ticket. It's the smartest thing you'll buy this year!

translations.fa: یه کارت تخفیفه — یک‌سوم تخفیف روی هر بلیت. هوشمندانه‌ترین خریدِ امساله!

branches.suggestion: I'll buy one today.
A third off? That's brilliant.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Told you she's the best! Come on, the train's in. Mind the gap!

translations.fa: گفتم که بهترینه! بیا، قطار رسید. مواظب فاصله باش!

n1.speaker: sal
n1.text: Alright, Ryan's mate! Sit yourself down. What are we going to do today?

translations.fa: سلام رفیق رایان! بشین. امروز چی کار کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Just a trim, please. Not too short.
branches.suggestionFa: فقط یه کم کوتاه، لطفاً. نه خیلی کوتاه.

branches.suggestion: I'm going to try something new. Any ideas?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌خوام یه چیز جدید امتحان کنم. ایده‌ای داری؟

n2.speaker: sal
n2.text: Lovely. Ryan's going to have a skin fade for his prom. Are you going to the prom too?

translations.fa: عالی. رایان قراره برای جشن پرامش فِید بزنه. تو هم میای پرام؟

branches.suggestion: No, I'm going to a wedding next week.
What's a prom?

cultureNote.en: A "prom" is a formal party at the end of school, with suits, dresses — and very nervous teenagers.
cultureNote.fa: پرام جشن رسمی پایان مدرسه است.

n3.speaker: sal
n3.text: A wedding! Lovely. Whose wedding is it? Are you going to wear a suit?

translations.fa: عروسی! چه خوب. عروسی کیه؟ می‌خوای کت‌وشلوار بپوشی؟

branches.suggestion: My cousin's. Yes, I'm going to wear a suit.
A friend's. I'm going to buy a new suit.
branches.suggestionFa: یه دوست. می‌خوام کت‌وشلوار نو بخرم.

n4.speaker: sal
n4.text: Then you need to look smart. I'm going to take a bit off the sides and keep the top long.

translations.fa: پس باید شیک باشی. یه کم از کناره‌ها می‌زنم و بالا را بلند نگه می‌دارم.

branches.suggestion: That sounds good.
Can you keep the sides long too?
branches.suggestionFa: می‌شه کناره‌ها را هم بلند نگه داری؟

n5.speaker: sal
n5.text: No problem. So, are you going to do anything nice this weekend?

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست. خب، این آخر هفته کار جالبی می‌خوای بکنی؟

branches.suggestion: I'm going to visit the coast with the Toms.
branches.suggestionFa: قراره با تامزها برم کنار دریا.

branches.suggestion: I'm going to relax. I'm exhausted.

n6.speaker: sal
n6.text: Lucky you. I'm going to watch the football and eat my body weight in crisps!

translations.fa: خوش به حالت. من می‌خوام فوتبال ببینم و هم‌وزن خودم چیپس بخورم!

branches.suggestion: Ha! Sounds perfect.
Who are you going to support?

n7.speaker: sal
n7.text: There we go. Have a look in the mirror. What do you reckon?

translations.fa: تموم شد. تو آینه نگاه کن. نظرت چیه؟

branches.suggestion: It looks great. Thank you!
Perfect. How much is it?

n8.speaker: sal
n8.text: Fifteen quid, mate. You're going to be the smartest person at that wedding!

translations.fa: پونزده پوند رفیق. تو اون عروسی شیک‌ترین آدم میشی!

n1.speaker: hughes
n1.text: Good morning, Smile Dental Practice, Mrs Hughes speaking. How can I help?

translations.fa: صبح بخیر، مطب دندان‌پزشکی اسمایل، هیوز هستم. چه کمکی از دستم برمیاد؟

branches.suggestion: Hello, I'd like to book an appointment, please.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام، می‌خواستم یه وقت بگیرم لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Hi, could I see a dentist this week?
branches.suggestionFa: سلام، می‌تونم این هفته دندون‌پزشک را ببینم؟

cultureNote.en: On the phone Brits say "Mrs Hughes speaking" or "It's Mehdi here" — not "I am Mehdi".
cultureNote.fa: پشت تلفن می‌گویند «Mehdi here» نه «I am Mehdi».

n2.speaker: hughes
n2.text: Of course. Are you registered with us? Is it a check-up or are you in pain?

translations.fa: حتماً. تو مطب ما ثبت‌نام کردید؟ معاینهٔ معمولیه یا درد دارید؟

branches.suggestion: I'm registered. It's just a check-up.
I'm not registered yet. I've got toothache.

n3.speaker: hughes
n3.text: Right. Could I take your name and date of birth, please?

translations.fa: خب. می‌تونم اسم و تاریخ تولدتون را داشته باشم؟

branches.suggestion: It's Mehdi Rahimi, the third of May, 1996.
Sure. Shall I spell my surname?

n4.speaker: hughes
n4.text: Yes, please spell it. Lovely, thank you. I've got Thursday at ten past two, or Friday morning.

translations.fa: آره لطفاً هجی کنید. عالی، ممنون. پنجشنبه دو و ده دقیقه دارم، یا جمعه صبح.

branches.suggestion: Thursday at ten past two is perfect.
branches.suggestionFa: پنجشنبه دو و ده دقیقه عالیه.

branches.suggestion: Could I have Friday morning, please?

n5.speaker: hughes
n5.text: That's booked. Can I take a mobile number? We'll send you a text reminder.

translations.fa: رزرو شد. شمارهٔ موبایلتون را بدید؟ یه پیامک یادآوری می‌فرستیم.

branches.suggestion: It's oh-seven-seven-double-oh, nine-one-two…
Could you email me instead?

n6.speaker: hughes
n6.text: No problem. Please arrive ten minutes early. And if you can't come, please ring us 24 hours before.

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست. لطفاً ده دقیقه زودتر بیاید. اگه نمی‌تونید بیاید، ۲۴ ساعت قبل زنگ بزنید.

branches.suggestion: I will. Is there a charge if I miss it?
Ten minutes early. Thank you very much.

cultureNote.en: NHS dental treatment isn't free for most adults — there are fixed price bands. Missed appointments can be charged.
cultureNote.fa: درمان دندان NHS برای بیشتر بزرگسالان رایگان نیست.

n7.speaker: hughes
n7.text: There may be a small charge, yes. Lovely. See you on the day. Goodbye now!

translations.fa: ممکنه هزینهٔ کمی داشته باشه، بله. عالی. روز موعود می‌بینیمتون. خداحافظ!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Mia's here! Mia, this is my friend from Iran. Shall we play shops?

translations.fa: میا اینجاست! میا، این دوستم از ایرانه. بیاید مغازه‌بازی کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Hello, Mia! Nice to meet you.
Yes! Shall I be the shopkeeper?

n2.speaker: mia
n2.text: Hello! Nicola talks about you all the time. Would you like to see my new doll?

translations.fa: سلام! نیکولا همش دربارهٔ تو حرف می‌زنه. دوست داری عروسک نوم را ببینی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, please! What's her name?
I'd love to. She's lovely!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Her name's Daisy! Mummy, can Mia stay for tea? Pleeease?

translations.fa: اسمش دیزیه! مامان، میا می‌تونه برای شام بمونه؟ تو رو خدا؟

branches.suggestion: Let's ask Mia's mum first.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا اول از مامان میا بپرسیم.

branches.suggestion: That's a nice idea. What shall we eat?

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: Fish fingers! And then shall we make a den in the living room? With all the cushions!

translations.fa: ماهی‌سوخاری انگشتی! بعد بیاید تو نشیمن یه کلبه بسازیم؟ با همهٔ کوسن‌ها!

branches.suggestion: Good idea! Shall I get some blankets?
What's a den?

cultureNote.en: British vs American: fish fingers (UK) = fish sticks (US).
cultureNote.fa: fish fingers (بریتانیا) = fish sticks (آمریکا).

n5.speaker: mia
n5.text: A den is a secret house! Would you like to come in our den? You have to say the password.

translations.fa: den یه خونهٔ مخفیه! دوست داری بیای تو کلبه‌مون؟ باید رمز را بگی.

branches.suggestion: What's the password?
Is it "Mr Buttons"?

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Yes! How did you know? You're so clever! Shall we have a sleepover next week, Mia?

translations.fa: آره! از کجا فهمیدی؟ خیلی باهوشی! میا، هفتهٔ بعد بیای پیش ما بخوابی؟

branches.suggestion: A sleepover? That sounds fun!
Ask your mummy first, Nicola.

n7.speaker: mia
n7.text: Yes! I'm going to bring my pyjamas with unicorns on. Best day ever!

translations.fa: آره! پیژامهٔ تکشاخی‌ام را میارم. بهترین روز دنیا!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: We're having a barbecue on Saturday. Would you like to come? About two o'clock?

translations.fa: شنبه کباب‌پزی داریم. دوست داری بیای؟ حدود ساعت دو؟

branches.suggestion: I'd love to. Thank you!
I'd love to, but I'm working on Saturday.
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی دوست دارم، ولی شنبه کار می‌کنم.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Oh, that's a shame. What about Sunday lunch instead? We're going to do a roast.

translations.fa: آه، حیف شد. ناهار یکشنبه چطوره؟ قراره کباب یکشنبه درست کنیم.

branches.suggestion: Sunday is perfect. What time?
Thank you, that's very kind.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: One o'clock. Shall I invite your friend from the café as well? The more the merrier!

translations.fa: ساعت یک. دوستت از کافه را هم دعوت کنم؟ هرچه بیشتر، شادتر!

branches.suggestion: Yes, please! He'd love that.
What does "the more the merrier" mean?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: It means more people make it more fun. Is there anything you don't eat?

translations.fa: یعنی آدم‌های بیشتر یعنی خوش‌گذرونی بیشتر. چیزی هست که نخوری؟

branches.suggestion: I don't eat pork.
I eat everything. Except Marmite!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: No problem — we'll do chicken. Shall I write it in the calendar? Sunday, one o'clock.

translations.fa: مشکلی نیست — مرغ درست می‌کنیم. تو تقویم بنویسم؟ یکشنبه، ساعت یک.

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Shall I bring anything?
Perfect. I'll be there!

cultureNote.en: When invited to a British home, bring something small: flowers, chocolates or a bottle.
cultureNote.fa: وقتی به خانه‌ای دعوت می‌شوی، چیز کوچکی ببر: گل یا شکلات.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Just bring yourself! Well, maybe a pudding. Nana makes a lovely crumble, but she won't share the recipe!

translations.fa: فقط خودت را بیار! خب، شاید یه دسر. نانا کرامبل خیلی خوبی درست می‌کنه، ولی دستورش را به کسی نمی‌ده!

n1.speaker: callum
n1.text: Hiya! What can I get you?

translations.fa: سلام! چی براتون بیارم؟

branches.suggestion: Can I get a cappuccino, please?
I'll have a pot of tea, please.

n2.speaker: callum
n2.text: Lovely. Small, regular or large? And is it to have in or take away?

translations.fa: عالی. کوچیک، معمولی یا بزرگ؟ اینجا میل می‌کنید یا می‌برید؟

branches.suggestion: Regular, to have in, please.
A large one to take away.

cultureNote.en: British vs American: take away (UK) = to go (US). A "takeaway" is also food you order home.
cultureNote.fa: take away (بریتانیا) = to go (آمریکا).

n3.speaker: callum
n3.text: Any milk? We've got oat, soya and normal.

translations.fa: شیر بزنم؟ جو، سویا و معمولی داریم.

branches.suggestion: Oat milk, please.
Normal is fine, thanks.

cultureNote.en: British spelling: soya. American: soy.
cultureNote.fa: املای بریتانیایی soya است.

n4.speaker: callum
n4.text: Anything to eat with that? The scones are fresh this morning.

translations.fa: چیزی هم میل دارید؟ اسکون‌ها امروز صبح تازه پخته شدن.

branches.suggestion: Yes, a scone with jam and cream, please.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، یه اسکون با مربا و خامه لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: How much is a scone?

cultureNote.en: Devon or Cornwall? In Devon you put cream first, then jam. In Cornwall, jam first! People argue about it.
cultureNote.fa: در دوون اول خامه، در کورنوال اول مربا!

n5.speaker: callum
n5.text: Two forty. Jam first or cream first? Careful — it's a big debate round here!

translations.fa: دو پوند و چهل. اول مربا یا اول خامه؟ مواظب باش — اینجا بحث بزرگیه!

branches.suggestion: Jam first, definitely.
I don't mind. You choose!

n6.speaker: callum
n6.text: A Cornish fan! Right, that's five pounds sixty altogether. Card or cash?

translations.fa: طرفدار کورنوال! خب، روی هم پنج پوند و شصت. کارت یا نقد؟

branches.suggestion: Card, please.
Can I pay by phone?

n7.speaker: callum
n7.text: Course you can. Grab a seat and I'll bring it over. Cheers!

translations.fa: معلومه. بشینید، براتون میارم. ممنون!

n1.speaker: priya
n1.text: Hiya, you again! Need much today?

translations.fa: سلام، باز تویی! امروز زیاد چیزی لازم داری؟

branches.suggestion: Not much. Just a few things.
Quite a lot, actually. I'm cooking for friends.
branches.suggestionFa: راستش نسبتاً زیاد. برای دوستام آشپزی می‌کنم.

n2.speaker: priya
n2.text: Ooh, a dinner party! How many people are coming?

translations.fa: اوه، مهمونی شام! چند نفر میان؟

branches.suggestion: Six people. That's a lot of cooking!
Not many — only three.

n3.speaker: priya
n3.text: What are you making? We haven't got many vegetables left, sorry. Delivery's tomorrow.

translations.fa: چی درست می‌کنی؟ ببخشید، سبزی زیادی برامون نمونده. بار فردا میاد.

branches.suggestion: A rice dish. Have you got any saffron?
How much rice have you got?

n4.speaker: priya
n4.text: A little saffron — it's very expensive! And plenty of rice. How much do you need?

translations.fa: یه کم زعفرون — خیلی گرونه! و برنج هم زیاد. چقدر لازم داری؟

branches.suggestion: Two kilos of rice, please.
Just a little saffron is fine.

n5.speaker: priya
n5.text: Here you go. Anything else? We've got lots of crisps on offer — two for a pound!

translations.fa: بفرما. چیز دیگه؟ کلی چیپس تخفیفی داریم — دوتا یه پوند!

branches.suggestion: Two bags of crisps, then!
No, thanks. I don't eat many crisps.

n6.speaker: priya
n6.text: Fair enough. Do you need a bag? You've got a lot to carry!

translations.fa: باشه. کیسه لازم داری؟ کلی چیز داری که ببری!

branches.suggestion: Yes, please. Just one.
No, I've brought my own bag.

n7.speaker: priya
n7.text: Good on you. That's twelve pounds fifty. Have a lovely dinner party!

translations.fa: آفرین. دوازده پوند و پنجاه میشه. مهمونی شام خوبی داشته باشی!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: I'm too tired to cook tonight. How about a takeaway?

translations.fa: امشب خسته‌تر از اونم که آشپزی کنم. غذای بیرون‌بر چطوره؟

branches.suggestion: Great idea! What do you fancy?
Why don't I cook instead?
branches.suggestionFa: چرا به جاش من آشپزی نکنم؟

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: That's sweet, but you deserve a night off too. Let's get Indian or fish and chips?

translations.fa: لطف داری، ولی تو هم لیاقت یه شب استراحت را داری. هندی بگیریم یا فیش‌اند‌چیپس؟

branches.suggestion: Let's get Indian. I love curry!
How about fish and chips? It's Friday!

cultureNote.en: Fish and chips on Friday is an old British tradition.
cultureNote.fa: فیش‌اند‌چیپس جمعه‌ها یک سنت قدیمی بریتانیایی است.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Ooh, good choice. Ryan, what do you want? Ryan? He's got his headphones on again.

translations.fa: اوه، انتخاب خوبیه. رایان، چی می‌خوای؟ رایان؟ باز هدفونش رو گذاشته.

branches.suggestion: I'll go and ask him.
Why don't we text him?

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Ha! Good idea, it's quicker. Shall we order online or ring them?

translations.fa: ها! فکر خوبیه، سریع‌تره. آنلاین سفارش بدیم یا زنگ بزنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Let's order online. It's easier.
How about ringing? I can practise my English!
branches.suggestionFa: زنگ زدن چطوره؟ می‌تونم انگلیسیم را تمرین کنم!

cultureNote.en: British spelling: "practise" is the verb, "practice" is the noun. Americans use "practice" for both.
cultureNote.fa: در بریتانیا practise فعل و practice اسم است.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Brave! Go on then. Ask for a large cod, two small chips, and mushy peas for Nana.

translations.fa: شجاع! بفرما. یه ماهی کاد بزرگ، دوتا سیب‌زمینی کوچیک و نخود له‌شده برای نانا بخواه.

branches.suggestion: What are mushy peas?
A large cod, two small chips, mushy peas. Got it!
branches.suggestionFa: یه کاد بزرگ، دوتا چیپس کوچیک، نخود له‌شده. فهمیدم!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Mashed green peas — Nana loves them. Why don't you lay the table while we wait?

translations.fa: نخودفرنگی له‌شده — نانا عاشقشه. چرا تا منتظریم میز را نچینی؟

branches.suggestion: Sure. Plates or just the paper?
Let's eat on the sofa tonight!
branches.suggestionFa: بیا امشب رو مبل غذا بخوریم!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Ha, you're turning British! Proper chippy night — straight out of the paper, on the sofa.

translations.fa: ها، داری بریتانیایی میشی! یه شب فیش‌اند‌چیپسی واقعی — مستقیم از کاغذ، رو مبل.

n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Mate, this is wrong. I ordered a hot chocolate and this is a coffee. I hate coffee!

translations.fa: رفیق، این اشتباهه. من شکلات داغ سفارش دادم و این قهوه‌ست. از قهوه متنفرم!

branches.suggestion: Let's ask them politely to change it.
branches.suggestionFa: بیا مؤدبانه ازشون بخوایم عوضش کنن.

branches.suggestion: Don't worry, I'll speak to the waitress.
branches.suggestionFa: نگران نباش، من با پیشخدمت حرف می‌زنم.

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: OK, you do it. Brits never complain — we just say "it's fine" and then moan at home!

translations.fa: باشه، تو انجامش بده. بریتانیایی‌ها هیچ‌وقت شکایت نمی‌کنن — فقط می‌گن «اشکالی نداره» و بعد تو خونه غر می‌زنن!

branches.suggestion: Ha! I'll be polite but clear.
What should I say?

cultureNote.en: Polite British complaints start soft: "Sorry, I think there's been a mistake…"
cultureNote.fa: شکایت مؤدبانهٔ بریتانیایی نرم شروع می‌شود: «ببخشید، فکر کنم اشتباهی شده…»

n3.speaker: sophie
n3.text: Everything alright here, lads?

translations.fa: همه چی خوبه بچه‌ها؟

branches.suggestion: Sorry, I think there's been a mistake. He ordered a hot chocolate.
branches.suggestionFa: ببخشید، فکر کنم اشتباهی شده. ایشون شکلات داغ سفارش داده بودن.

branches.suggestion: I'm afraid this isn't what we ordered.
branches.suggestionFa: متأسفانه این چیزی نیست که سفارش دادیم.

newWords.fa: همه چیز رو به راه است

n4.speaker: sophie
n4.text: Oh no, I'm so sorry! That's my fault. I'll make you a fresh one right away.

translations.fa: ای وای، خیلی متأسفم! تقصیر منه. همین الان یه تازه‌اش را درست می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: No problem. Thanks very much.
That's very kind of you.

n5.speaker: sophie
n5.text: There you go — one hot chocolate, with extra marshmallows to say sorry!

translations.fa: بفرمایید — یه شکلات داغ، با مارشمالوی اضافه برای عذرخواهی!

branches.suggestion: Brilliant, thank you!
You didn't have to do that!
branches.suggestionFa: لازم نبود این کار را بکنی!

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Result! Extra marshmallows. You're good at this. Next time you can complain about my maths teacher!

translations.fa: ایول! مارشمالوی اضافه. تو این کار واردی. دفعهٔ بعد می‌تونی از معلم ریاضیم شکایت کنی!

n1.speaker: ellis
n1.text: Good morning! You must be Nicola's friend. She talks about you all the time.

translations.fa: صبح بخیر! شما باید دوست نیکولا باشید. همش دربارهٔ شما حرف می‌زنه.

branches.suggestion: Good morning! Yes, I'm staying with the Toms.
branches.suggestionFa: صبح بخیر! بله، پیش تامزها زندگی می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: Nice to meet you. I hope she says nice things!
branches.suggestionFa: از آشنایی‌تون خوشبختم. امیدوارم چیزهای خوبی بگه!

n2.speaker: ellis
n2.text: Only nice things! Could you give her this letter? It's about the school trip.

translations.fa: فقط چیزهای خوب! می‌تونید این نامه را بهش بدید؟ دربارهٔ اردوی مدرسه‌ست.

branches.suggestion: Of course. I'll give it to her mum.
Sure. Where are you taking them?

n3.speaker: ellis
n3.text: We're taking them to the farm next Friday. Can you remind Leslie to send us the form?

translations.fa: جمعهٔ بعد می‌بریمشون مزرعه. می‌تونید به لزلی یادآوری کنید فرم را برامون بفرسته؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I'll remind her tonight.
Does she need to pay for it?

n4.speaker: ellis
n4.text: Just three pounds for the coach. Nicola's very excited. She wants to see the lambs.

translations.fa: فقط سه پوند برای اتوبوس. نیکولا خیلی هیجان‌زده‌ست. می‌خواد بره‌ها را ببینه.

branches.suggestion: She loves animals. She told me about them yesterday.
branches.suggestionFa: عاشق حیوون‌هاست. دیروز دربارهٔ اونا بهم گفت.

branches.suggestion: What's "the coach"?

cultureNote.en: British vs American: a coach (UK) = a long-distance bus. A "bus" is for short journeys.
cultureNote.fa: coach در بریتانیا اتوبوس بین‌شهری است.

n5.speaker: ellis
n5.text: A big bus for trips. Oh, and Nicola lost her hat. Have you seen it? It's red.

translations.fa: یه اتوبوس بزرگ برای سفر. آه، نیکولا کلاهش را گم کرده. شما دیدینش؟ قرمزه.

branches.suggestion: No, I haven't seen it. I'll look for it at home.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، ندیدمش. تو خونه دنبالش می‌گردم.

branches.suggestion: Is it in the lost property box?

n6.speaker: ellis
n6.text: Good thinking! Let me check… yes, here it is. Please give it to her with my love.

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه! بذار نگاه کنم… آره، ایناهاش. لطفاً از طرف من بهش بدید.

branches.suggestion: Thank you. She'll be so happy.
I'll put it in her bag now.

n7.speaker: ellis
n7.text: Wonderful. It was lovely to meet you. See you at pick-up time!

translations.fa: عالیه. از دیدنتون خوشحال شدم. موقع تحویل گرفتن بچه‌ها می‌بینمتون!

n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Here's the playground. Look at Nicola — she's running so fast!

translations.fa: اینم حیاط مدرسه. نیکولا را ببین — چقدر تند می‌دوه!

branches.suggestion: She runs really quickly!
She plays very happily with her friends.
branches.suggestionFa: خیلی شاد با دوستاش بازی می‌کنه.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: She does! Oh — that's Mia's mum, Jo. She talks very loudly, so be ready!

translations.fa: آره! آه — اون مامان میا، جوئه. خیلی بلند حرف می‌زنه، پس آماده باش!

branches.suggestion: Ha! I'll listen carefully.
Does she speak quickly too?

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Very quickly. Jo's lovely, though. She organises the school fair every year — really well.

translations.fa: خیلی تند. ولی جو خیلی خوبه. هر سال بازارچهٔ مدرسه را برگزار می‌کنه — خیلی خوب.

branches.suggestion: What happens at the school fair?
She sounds very busy.

cultureNote.en: British spelling: organise, realise. American: organize, realize.
cultureNote.fa: املای بریتانیایی organise است.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Cake stalls, a tombola, games. Last year Tom ran the barbecue — badly! He burnt everything.

translations.fa: غرفهٔ کیک، قرعه‌کشی، بازی. پارسال تام کباب‌پز را اداره کرد — افتضاح! همه چی را سوزوند.

branches.suggestion: Oh no! Poor Tom.
Maybe I can help this year.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Would you? Jo will love you! Can you bake? Everyone bakes for the cake stall.

translations.fa: واقعاً؟ جو عاشقت میشه! بلدی کیک بپزی؟ همه برای غرفهٔ کیک می‌پزن.

branches.suggestion: I can bake quite well.
Not very well, but I can try!
branches.suggestionFa: نه خیلی خوب، ولی امتحان می‌کنم!

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Perfect. Oh, the bell! Everyone's walking in quietly now. Look how sweetly Nicola waves!

translations.fa: عالی. آه، زنگ! همه دارن آروم می‌رن تو. ببین نیکولا چه شیرین دست تکون می‌ده!

branches.suggestion: Bye, Nicola! Have a good day!
branches.suggestionFa: خداحافظ نیکولا! روز خوبی داشته باشی!

branches.suggestion: She waves so happily.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Right — coffee? I need one badly after this morning!

translations.fa: خب — قهوه؟ بعد از امروز صبح شدیداً بهش نیاز دارم!

n1.speaker: patel
n1.text: Thanks for coming in. Leslie couldn't make it, so you're here for Ryan's chat?

translations.fa: ممنون که اومدید. لزلی نتونست بیاد، پس شما برای گفت‌وگوی رایان اینجایید؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, Leslie asked me to come.
That's right. How is he doing?

n2.speaker: patel
n2.text: He's doing better. He's handed in all his homework this month. That's a first!

translations.fa: بهتر شده. این ماه همهٔ تکالیفش را تحویل داده. اولین باره!

branches.suggestion: That's great news.
Has he finished his science project?

n3.speaker: patel
n3.text: Not yet. He's started it, but he hasn't finished it. It's due on Friday.

translations.fa: هنوز نه. شروعش کرده، ولی تمومش نکرده. موعدش جمعه‌ست.

branches.suggestion: I'll help him at home this week.
branches.suggestionFa: این هفته تو خونه کمکش می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: What has he done so far?

n4.speaker: patel
n4.text: He's chosen the topic — volcanoes — and he's made a model. It's very messy, but it works!

translations.fa: موضوع را انتخاب کرده — آتشفشان‌ها — و یه ماکت ساخته. خیلی شلخته‌ست، ولی کار می‌کنه!

branches.suggestion: A volcano model! Has it erupted yet?
branches.suggestionFa: ماکت آتشفشان! تا حالا فوران کرده؟

branches.suggestion: That sounds like Ryan!

n5.speaker: patel
n5.text: Once — in the science lab. We've cleaned it up now! Has he talked to you about college?

translations.fa: یه بار — تو آزمایشگاه علوم. حالا تمیزش کردیم! با شما دربارهٔ کالج صحبت کرده؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, he's mentioned it. He wants to do engineering.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، اشاره کرده. می‌خواد مهندسی بخونه.

branches.suggestion: No, he hasn't said anything yet.

cultureNote.en: In England, many students go to a sixth-form college at 16 for A levels before university.
cultureNote.fa: در انگلستان بسیاری از دانش‌آموزان در ۱۶ سالگی برای A level به کالج می‌روند.

n6.speaker: patel
n6.text: Engineering suits him. Please tell Leslie he's improved a lot. I'm proud of him.

translations.fa: مهندسی بهش میاد. لطفاً به لزلی بگید خیلی پیشرفت کرده. بهش افتخار می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: I will. She'll be really pleased.
Thank you for all your help.

n7.speaker: patel
n7.text: My pleasure. And tell Ryan — no more volcanoes in the lab!

translations.fa: خواهش می‌کنم. و به رایان بگید — دیگه آتشفشان تو آزمایشگاه ممنوع!

n1.speaker: nicola
n1.text: Guess what happened at school today! Guess!

translations.fa: حدس بزن امروز تو مدرسه چی شد! حدس بزن!

branches.suggestion: Did you see a lamb?
I don't know. Tell me!

n2.speaker: nicola
n2.text: No! First, Mrs Ellis brought a hamster to class. It's called Peanut!

translations.fa: نه! اول، خانم الیس یه همستر آورد کلاس. اسمش پینات‌ـه!

branches.suggestion: A hamster! What did it do?
Peanut is a funny name!

n3.speaker: nicola
n3.text: Then it escaped! It ran under the tables and everyone screamed.

translations.fa: بعد فرار کرد! زیر میزها دوید و همه جیغ زدن.

branches.suggestion: Oh no! Did you catch it?
Did you scream too?

n4.speaker: nicola
n4.text: After that, Mia found it in her lunch box! It was eating her grapes!

translations.fa: بعد از اون، میا تو ظرف ناهارش پیداش کرد! داشت انگورهاش را می‌خورد!

branches.suggestion: Ha! A hungry hamster!
Was Mia happy or scared?
branches.suggestionFa: میا خوشحال بود یا ترسیده بود؟

n5.speaker: nicola
n5.text: She laughed and laughed. Then we drew pictures of Peanut. I drew him with a crown.

translations.fa: خندید و خندید. بعد عکس پینات را کشیدیم. من با تاج کشیدمش.

branches.suggestion: Can I see your picture?
Why did you give him a crown?

n6.speaker: nicola
n6.text: Because he's the king of the class! Here it is. Mrs Ellis said it was the best one.

translations.fa: چون پادشاه کلاسه! ایناهاش. خانم الیس گفت بهترینه.

branches.suggestion: It's brilliant! Well done, Nicola.
Let's put it on the fridge.

n7.speaker: nicola
n7.text: Yes! Next to my dinosaur. And tomorrow Peanut is coming to MY table!

translations.fa: آره! کنار دایناسورم. و فردا پینات میاد میز من!

n1.speaker: dawson
n1.text: Hello there. What can I do for you?

translations.fa: سلام. چه کمکی از دستم برمیاد؟

branches.suggestion: Hi. I've got a sore throat and a cough.
I think I've caught a cold.

cultureNote.en: British vs American: chemist / pharmacy (UK) = drugstore (US). "Chemist's" is very common in Britain.
cultureNote.fa: chemist در بریتانیا یعنی داروخانه.

n2.speaker: dawson
n2.text: Oh dear. How long have you had it? Have you got a temperature?

translations.fa: ای وای. چند وقته داریدش؟ تب دارید؟

branches.suggestion: About three days. No temperature, I think.
branches.suggestionFa: حدود سه روز. فکر کنم تب ندارم.

branches.suggestion: Since Monday. I feel a bit hot.
branches.suggestionFa: از دوشنبه. یه کم احساس گرما می‌کنم.

n3.speaker: dawson
n3.text: Right. You should drink lots of water and you should rest. These lozenges will help your throat.

translations.fa: خب. باید زیاد آب بخورید و استراحت کنید. این قرص‌های مکیدنی به گلوتون کمک می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: How often should I take them?
branches.suggestionFa: هر چند وقت یه بار بخورمشون؟
